tei:div.tei:p: byaḥ/bka'agu/ //spya chi/hā sdu 77/2sbya 'jiciXng060jib jing 505533 7 bci kho zhugaX 50 yokhog
nga — sdoji rwa ci ༷lo 〉ཿṭha ci ri /tsho'i blo / rine ci rī tsho che / ༷ ci — rdo mi( 1— 7/〉 2khu wa choX ci no// se ciX wī ciX ci/she ༷༷ /rdori (ro/ sngi ske rdo /rme rdo rte wa (ci ci rī/ /
na 4 44 snye snyigame
bod kyi gnyen srol rags gleng /rgyang 'khor tshe phun gyisabacoms/mirigasadape skrun khang /

sngon 'gro'i gtam/myu/ spyi tshogs kyi grub cha las rtsa ba'i sde tshan ni khyim rgyud yin pa dang /khyim rgyud de nyid kyi grub cha dang / 'phreng ba bstar brgyud bzhin du 'phel rgyas yong bzhin spyi tshogs thog gnyen nye spun mched kyi 'brel ba med pa nas yod pa dang / nyung ba nas mang ba'i phyogs su 'phel rgyas byung ba tshang ma ni pho mo dbar gnyen bsdebs pa las byung bas/ gnyen sgrig ni khyim rgyud kyi rtsa ba'i grub cha yin pa dang / gnyen nye spun mched 'phel rgyas yong ba'i rtsa ba'i rgyu rkyen yang yin la/ 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs rgyun chad med par mu mthud 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i srog rtsa dang / rigs rus 'chol bar mi spyod pa'i byed thabs shig yin/ de yang / srog chags gang 'dra zhig yin rung der pho mo'i 'brel ba byas te skyes 'phel thub pa'i rang byung gi nus pa ldan yod/'on kyang 'gro ba mi'i rigs 'di nyid srog chags gzhan las mchog pa'i dpal yon ldan pa'i srog chags shig yin zhes brjod kyi yod/ de ltar brjod don ni 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyis skyes stobs kyi nus pa de spyi tshogs can dang tshan rig can gyi phyogs su 'phel rgyas btang yod pas yin la/ 6 mi'i rigs rang nyid spyi tshogs can gyi phyogs su 'phel rgyas byung ba'i ches rmang gzhi'i rnam 1

pa ni gnyen sgrig yin/ miXmi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs gdod ma'i spra mi nas rim bzhin 'phel rgyas byung ba'i lo rgyus chu rgyun ring po 'di'i nang gnyen sgrig gi lam srol sna tshogs dar myong la sa khul so so dang mi rigs so so'i spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs dang / dpal 'byor gyi rmang ga'i sogs mi 'dra ba'i rkyen gyis so so'i gnyen sgrig gi lam srol yang 'dra min sna tshogs yod pa ni gor ma chagade bzhin gangs can bod kyi yul 'dir lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring po'i nang mna' ma'am mag pa gtong len gyi goms gshis dang / pho mo gnyen sgrig la 'jug skabs kyi 'jom bya/ gnyen don skor gyi 'du shes dang / gnyen ston gyi goms srol mang dag la mi rigs kyi khyad chos mngon gsal ldan yod la/ de lta'i goms gshis rnams pha tsha bu brgyud kyis rgyun 'dzin byed pa la'ang dgos pa rgyu mtshan re yod nges yin pa dang / da lam gnyen srol gyi gnad don 'gar rig gzhung las rigs khrod yang dag min pa'i brjod tshul mi nyung ba zhig dar khyab che tsam 'dug pas 'dir bdag gis yun ring bod kyi 'tsho ba dngos la lta zhib dang / 'brel yod yig tshang lta klog byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog dmangs srol rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi bya thabs spyad de bod kyi gnyen srol skor gyi gnad don 'gar dpyad pa lam tsam bya rgyu yin//kye yu'u byung an gyis brtsams pa'i 〈krung go'i dmangs srol rig pa 〉thog ngos 202nang gsal/

dkar chagadang po/ gnyen sgrig skor gyi lugs srol rgyun 'dzin byed stangs skor/( 1 )gcig mna' ma mag pa gtong len gyi goms srol dang gnyen sgrig gi 'joms bya/ ( 5 )gnyis/ 'jig rten go bag khab len gyi rnam pa 'ga'/ (23)gnyis pa/ ming 'ga'i 'dogs tshul las 'phros pa'i gnyen sgrig goms srol dang 'brel ba'i 'du shes 'ga'/ (47)gcig mi'i ming gi 'dogs tshul las 'phros pa'i 'du shes/ (47)gnyis/ byi phug gi 'bod tshul 'ga' las 'phros pa'i 'du shes/(54)gsum pa/ phyogs lhung lta ba gnyis0 mtha' dpyod/ (65)gcig gleng gzhi/ (65)gnyis/ tshul min bya spyod gnyen srol du brjod pa'i nor 'khrul lta ba dgag pa/ (/8)

gsum/ phu nus mna' ma mnyam spyod byed pa bod kyi gnyen srol yin tshul bstan pa/ (80)bzhi/ phu nu'i mna' ma mnyam bsu'i gnyen srol dar gnas thub pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan pa/ (89)lnga/ phu nu'i mna' ma mnyam bsu'i gnyen srol skor gyi nor 'khrul gyi lta ba gnyis dgag pa/ (104)bzhi pa/ srolargyun gnyen ston dang gnyen bshad rig rtsed/ (116)gcig srol rgyun gnyen ston gyi don snying brjod pa/ (116)gnyis/ srol rgyun gnyen ston gyi rgyud rim dang po gnyen slong ba'i byed sgo/ (119)gsum/ srol rgyun gnyen ston gyi rgyud rim gnyis pa gnyen lam gyi byed sgo/ (126)bzhi/ gnyen ston dngos gzhi'i mdzad sgo/ (141)lnga/ lta skor dang gnyen 'phrad/ (177)drug gnyen bshad dang gnyen ston rig rtsed las 'phros pa'i bsam gzhigs/ (179)mjug byang / (194)

dang po/ gnyen sgrog skor gyi lugs srol rgyun 'dzin byed stangs skor/4 / nga tshos 'das zin pa'i rang cag gi lo rgyus dag la phyir bltas byed skabs bod kyi lo rgyus deb ther khag nang du rgyal rabs rim byon dang / lo rgyus don rkyen che gras/ chos lugs grub mtha'i byung tshul/ mtho rim mi sna'am bla sprul khag gi rnam thar sogs 'khod pa mang yang gzhi rim ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i bde sdug sogs 'khod pa mthong rgyu dben/ de'ang rang cag gi mkhas pa'i dbang po dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog gis 6 sngon dus kyi srol lugs sogs ji 'dra yin bsam pa'i tshe/ rgyal khams gzhan gyi yi ge bris pa'i lo rgyus sogs la blta ba tsam las rang gi mis rang yul gyi srol lugs 'di 'dra'o zhes zhib tu bris pa zhig shin tu rnyed dka' ba 'di yul kun la 'dra ba yin mi zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ de ltar lags kyang rgyal khams gzhan nam mi rigs gzhan gyi yi ger bkod pa'i dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i bde sdug dag la'ang mgo ma 'tshos klad pa 'dags thal ba'am zer sgros kyi rjes su phyinakhar rang snang gang 'char gyis don dngos la ra mgo lug bsgar gyi bzo bcos snon 'phri byas pa'i skyon gyis 'ching pa mang bar snang / dpe/ na/

19〈〈lo'i 〈bod ljongs zhib 'jug 〉rgya yig dus deb gsum pa'i nang tsa zhe la'i oṃ rgyus rig pa mkhas can shi la'o ta'o tā yis spyi lo 640lor khong gi gsung rtsom nang stod mi'i phung po thag gcod byed stangs bkod yod pa ni 6mi shi rjes gnyen nye rnams skong / de rjes pha (ma )ro tig hrug bzo/ lug sha dang bsres te spun mched kyis mnyam za byed/ mgo lpags bshus te ka lir gser rgyan sgron/ de nyid chang snod byed cing bla na ma mchis par rtsi/ lo ltar de la mchod 'bul byed zhes dang / rjes su 'jar man pa tha ma si cha khi yis dpyad gzhi'i yig cha 'bor chen spyad de de ni bod mi'i lugs srol yin par ra sprod byas yod la yang 'jar phan gyi mkhas pa pad nyo khu cis bcoms pa'i deb nang bshad tshul de nyid la 'dod mthun byas yod mi ces bkod yod pa ma zad/66 de tsho nas skabs de dus bod la mi sha za ba'i srol ngan yod pa mngon thub bo zhes bkod yod/ gong du drangs pa'i dum bu 'di'i nang gnad 'gag mang po zhig sbas skung byas pa ma zad/ don dngos dang 'gal ba'i 'chal gtam rdzun bzo byas pa ni mngon gsal dod po red/ mi rigs rig pa dang dmangs srol rig pa'i gsung tshul ltar na/ mi sha mi yis za ba'i lugs srol ni kla klo'i dus rabs su yin par 'dod kyi yod pa dang / spyi lo 640lo'i dus su bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas bcas dar zhing rgyas pa'i tshad mtho'i shes rig ldan par slebs zin pa'i don dngos kyis ra sprod thub nges yin/ de ltar na gcig nas rang re'i lo rgyus deX zer nang gzhi rim ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i bde sdug 'khod pa

zhung ba dang / yang sgos su rgyal khams gzhan nam mi rigs gzhan gyi yig rigs su 'khod pa dag la dpral bo lha babs kyi skyon che bas tshad mar 'dzin mi 'os pa zhig yin/ 'o na gzhi rim ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi bde sdug dang goms 'dris shes rtogs yong thabs bral ba yin nam zhe na/ de ni min te/nga tshos mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba mngon pa'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig sgyu rtsal la brtag dang gzhigs pa byas tshe mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i skyid sdug dang goms gshes rnam shes thub nges yin/ gang lags zhe na/ rtsom rig ni spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i mtshon byed yin pa dang / dmangs khrod rtsom rig ni 'tsho ba'i nang gi rang bzhin rnam pa dang de bas 'brel che ba zhig yin/ de yang mkhas pa'i dbang po ku'o ar cis gsungs don ltar ngag rgyun du dar khyab song ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig ma shes na ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi lo rgyus dngos de shes mi thub ces dang / sku zhabs zhol khang thub bstan nyi mas dmangs khrod sgrung ni ‘ nga tshos 'das pa'i dus kyi lo rgyus dang / rig gnas/ spyi tshogs 'tsho ba bcas la rgyus ngo dang zhib 'jug byed pa'i rgyu cha gal chen zhig yin mi duzhes gsungs pa dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las mchogagis bod kyi dmangs khrod du dar khyab che la bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi gtsug rgyan lta bur gyur ba'i ge sar sgrung la gdeng 'jog gnang skabs de ni 6 dus skab sa so so'i spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul lag mthil dngos po du bod kyi dmangasakhrod sgrung gtam 〉deb dang po (rgya yig )sngon 'gro shog ngos2pa ra gsal/ 3

ltar ston pa'i gtam rgyud mi 0cig yin zhes gsungs pa rnams la mngon sum don dang ldan/ 'das zin pa'i spyi tshogs 'tsho ba dang / lhag par du lo rgyus deb ther thog rig rgyu dben pa'i rgya che'i ngal rtsol mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i goms gshis dngos la yang dag pa'i sgo nas brtag dpyad dang zhib 'jug byed pa'i dpyad gzhi gal chen zhig ni dmangs khrod rtsom rig yin/ rgya che'i ngal rtsol mang tshogs ni dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi ma yum dngos de yin pa dang / dmangs khrod rtsom rig ni mang tshogs kyi rgyun ldan 'tsho ba dang sha khrag 'dres nas gson pa'i ngal rtsol pa'i sgyu rtsal zhig yin gshis de mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba gsal byed kyi me long ste mi dmangs kyi 6 rig gnas kun btus dpe deb ’ cig yin pas de'i nang mi dmangs kyi lo rgyus cha tshang 'dus yod/gong du nga chos 'das pa'i dus kyi rig gzhung las rigs khrod kyi 'brel yod dngos don de dang dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi tshan rig rang bzhin zur tsam brjod pa'i dgos pa ni gsham du deb chung 'di'i nang dmangs khrod rtsom rigagi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha mang tsam zhig spyad nas bod rigs na gzhon pho mos brtse dung la 'dzin pa'i 'du shes dang bod kyi 'jig rten go bag khab len gyi rnam pa khag la dpyad pa byed rgyu'i ched du yin/ du mkhas dbang dung dkar blobazang 'azin lasakyi gsung 'bum 〉las (dpyad rtsom 〉kyi shog ngos 187/nga gsal/

gcig mna' ma mag pa gtong len gyi goms srol dang gnyen sgrig gi 'dzem bya/bod 'di nyid ni sa rgya che la mi 'bor nyung ba dang / yul lung phan tshun dbar gyi 'grim 'grul stabs bde med pa'i phyi rol yul gyi rgyu rkyen de'i thog bod pa rnams kyis gnyen nye'am nye du bar gnyen sgrig mi byed pa'i gnyen sgrig gi 'jom bya lag bstar nan tan byed pa'i nang rkyen yod pas lung tsho gcig nang phan tshun 'brel gtug yod pa'i gzhon nu pho mo dbar mang po zhig gnyen tshan la 'gro ba dang / yul phyogs gzhan gyi gzhon nu dang 'gro 'ong rtag gtug med pas tsa shog kha'i 'go bdag dpon po dang / bu phrug 'go bdag pha ma yin mi 0zhes dang 6 pha mar 'khri ba phru gu'i 'gro stangs dang / phru gur 'khri ba pha ma'i zhabs 'jug ②zhes pa ltar bu phug gi 'jig rten gtan 'dun gyi 'gro stangs pha mas byed pa'i snang tshul tshabs che tsam dar ba dang / tha na gzhon nu gnyis gnyen sgrig byed skabs gnyen ston thog ngo mjal dang po byung ba'i dngos don yang mi nyung ba 'dren byed rna ba'i yul du mthong thos yod mus yin/ blo bag yangs ba'i pha ma rnams kyis dkar nye 'am khu zhang brgyud bu la mna' ma mngags 'tshol byed pa dang / rtsa ba'i thog dmigs yul gtan ཿ /sbo/ tnañdzashā/snasgorshaḥ5 /shā ṭwāṃ /sgo sgyu/ sna zlozlo shā 'tsho /spya 5sna zlo gtso/ 5

'khel byung rjes bu de bu mo de'i khyim la don dag gang rung la kha g.yar nas bu mor blta bar gtong srol yod la/ bu dang mnyam du mos mthun yod med la gros sdur byed mkhan yang mang po yod/ de ni pha mas bka' bkod byed pa dang rang 'dod ltar dga' 'du byed pa zung du 'brel ba'i rnam par nges/'on kyang bu mo'i ngos nas mtshon na pha mas 'jig rten 'gro stangs bzo skabs bu mo'i bsam tshul la bstun mkhan nyung la 6 mi dga' dga' mdog byed pa de/pho gsar dmag la 'gro ba'i rtags/ mi sdug sdug mdog byed pa de/ mo gsar bag mar 'gro ba'i rtags/’ zhes bu mo pha mas khyim tshang gzhan la mna' mar ster skabs 'gro 'dod med par sems sdug gis ngu shor ba'i gnas tshul byung ba rnams 6 mi sdug sdug mdog mibyas pa'i phyi tshul la brtsis yod/ de yang dper na bod kyi lha mo'i 'khyab gzhung 〈snang sa 'od 'bum gyi rnam thar snyanang ri snang dpon po sgra chen gyis bu mo snang sar kho pa'i tshang gi gzhis 'dzin la e 'gro zhes 'dri skabs snang sas mi 'gro ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan skabs smyo blon po bsod nams dpal skyid des rgyal po'i bla g.yu mthing 'od 'khyil ba de la dar dmar po'i 'dogs lung brgyus pa de dang / mda' dar tshos sna lnga pa zhig dpon po sgra chen pa'i phyag tu phul ba dab lhan cig 'jig rten gyi gtam dper mi dga' dga' mdog byed pa de/ pho gsar dmag la 'gro ba'i rtags/ mi sdug sdug mdog byed pa de/ mo gsar bag mar 'gro ba'i rtags/ zhes zer ba yin pas bu mo 'di la khyim thab 'jig rten la e 'gro zhes dpon pos bkā' 'dri gnang na sems kyi gting nas 'gro 'dod yod kyang mi mang tshogs

sar 'gro 'dod med pa'i spam rdzu los byed mi duces pa lta bu'o/ bod rigs gzhon nu'i lang tsho'i dpal las 'khrungs pa'i bod kyi dmangs khrod mdza' gzhas kyi nang pho mo'i dbar la rang 'dod kyi dasa' 'du byed pa'i rang dbang med pa la zur za dang ngan smras byas pa'i gzhas tshig mang po yod pa ni 6 chung 'dris byams pa lha red/ byams pa'i yab yum bdud red/ nga la bdud kyi bar chad/ gtong ba gnang nas gang yong / 0zhes dang / tsa chung 'dris chung nas gshib pa'i/ chung 'dris sgog pa dkar po/ a mas sgog pags bshu bshu/nga gnyis bral shed ma mthong /’ 0zhes pa ltar yin la rang 'dod ltar dga' 'du yong ba'i re ba yang ston gyi yod pa ni nga rang byams pa 'tshol bar/ pha mas bkag 'gog ma gnang / yab yum dgung lo chung dus/ thugs la dran pa gnang rogs ’ 0zhes pa de rigs nas mngon thub/ 'on kyang sngar bod kyi gnyen srol nang gong smos ji bzhin pha mas btsan po dbang yod kyis bu phrug gi 'jig rten 'gro stangs byas pa yod la/ pho mo'i dbar rang 'dod ltar dga' 'du byas pa'ang mang po yod pa tsam ma zad/ dga' rogs sam gtan grogs btsal skabs gzhi 'dzin sa'i thad rang rigs kyi lugs dang mthun pa'i lta stangs yang mang po yod/ de rnams ni dmangs khrod mdza' gzhas kyi nang gson nyams dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bkod yod/ dper na/ 6 ri mgo mtho la ཿ /shātna : rno/tā dzo/rno shāsbyidngha 3 spyan smras 54la gtso/ཿ /shānda : tāḥ ṭīkasmu panā 11〉kā shā'i dusadeb ba'i par gtso/

ma bltas/ ri byad yag la bltas yod/ bu mo mdzes par ma bltas/ ngang rgyud ring la bltas yod mi duces pa dang / 66'jam ni 'bu ras 'jam byung /mdzes ni ras khra mdzes byung / 'jam po 'bu ras gyon tshe/ ras khra dgongs pa ma tshoms 0zhes pa de rnams nas bod rigs gzhon nu tshos rang rang gi tshe gang gtan grogs 'tshol skabs kyi lta tshul zhig mtshon yod pa ni gtan gyi grogs de'i sems pa bzang min la blta ba las phyi rnam pa mtshar min la blta / // hūṃ kā/da 'byi/ chod/ kyimi sdud sdu mahā / rdo/ pa pazlo sa ༷rdodī // ༵ / ṭā tog ston zla gsum gyi yun red/ thugs sems lha shing shug pa/ mi tshe gcig gi dus red mi0ces pa ltar rang gi snying sdug sems bzang ma gtan gyi grogs su gyur na ni gzhon so dkar nas rgan skra dkar bar gcig phan gcig dang gcig rogs gcig gis byas nas bde zhing skyid pa'i 'tsho ba yong rgyu dang /phyi mtshar nang rtsub dug gi me tog lta bu zhig rang gi gtan grogs su byung na dus tshod ring tsam song rjes 'gyod pa'i gling du tshud nges yin pas rang gi tshe gang gi don chen la mig rgyang ring po'i bsam blo gtong thub kyi yod pa mtshon gyi 'dug la 6 phyi sha pags mdzes pa mdzes pa min/ nang bsam pa mdzes pa mdzes pa yin 0zhes pa ltar gyi lta ba 'dzin gyi yod pa mtshon yod/ 'on kyang ཿ /sbong tt+waṃ /rmādzi/dzo'i sgyug dzārsha rsha rnyi /sra /rmi/sa /shātna : skyushā /lha / shā lta ////shāḥ ཿ 〉〉〉 sbri snanā sdza rsha rmis/ —

'dir nang bsam pa dang phyi rnam pa gnyis bsdur nas brjod pa las phyi rnam pa mdzes pa la ngan smras kyi zur cha tsam yang med/ bod pa rnams kyis kyang kham bu kha la zhim pa dang me tog mig la mdzes pa zhig byung na ni mchog par 'dzin gyi yod pa 'jig rten kun dang 'dra ba'o/ / gzhan yang 6 ngang pa mtsho la 'khor 'khor/ nga gnyis 'khor rgyu byung na/ bza' rgyu 'dam las med kyang /mnyam za mnyam 'thung zhus chog 0ces dang / 6 lcam dang gdung ma gshib gshib/ nga gnyis gshib rgyu byung na/ chu la rtsam pa brgyab nas/ 'thung dgosabyung yang las red mi du lham la lham mthil med na/ lham yu gsar pas gang yong / rtse dung zab mo med na/ rgyal po'i sras kyis gang yong /’ ②zhes pa de tsho nas brtse bas bcings pa'i snying sdug de rang gi gtan grogs la byung na sdug mnyam myong dang skyid mnyam gtong bya rgyu kho na las rgyu dngos kyi srid 'byor la mi lta ba'i bod rigs gzhon nu'i dga' rogs la 'dzin pa'i dwangs gtsang gi brtse dung de mngon thub/ mdor na bu phrug gi 'jig rten go bag khab len gyi 'gro stangs pha mas byas pa shas che la/ rang 'dod kyis dga' 'du byas pa pha mas blo mos byas te sor bzhag byas pa'ang yod pa dang /lha rang dbang ma byung (ba )nyung shas phyi phyogs su bros nas mnyam du sdod pa'ang yod 0zer ba ltar pha mas 'dod mos med bzhin du rang 'dod ltar thab khri /byebye spri /khrokhroXtsho〉 //khro// rdo snyu/

gsar ga'is gsar zin mkhan yang re gnyis yod/spyi lo 2005lor nga tshos lha sa grong khyer mal gro gong dkar rdzong rgya ma shang du dud tshang re re byas te spyi tshogs brtag dpyad byas nas shes gsal la/shang de yongs su bza' tsho 469yod pa'i nang rang mos dga' 'du byas pa 210yod pas bza' tsho spyi'i brgya cha 44 7〈zin pa dang / pha mas 'gro stangs thag gcod byas pa'i khyo shug 254yod pas bza' tsho spyi'i brgya cha 54 16zin pa/ mi gzhan gyis ngo sprod byas pa'i bza' tsho 5yod pas spyi'i brgya cha 1 07min gyi yod/ yang gzhis rtse sa gnas pa snam rdzong bkra shar shang khul gyi dge 'khor rdzong grong tshor 2006lor spyi tshogs brtag zhib byas 'bras su grong tsho yongs la dud tshang 42yod pa'i nang bsdoms bza' tsho 56yod pa dang / de'i khrod rang mos dga' 'du byas pa khyo shug 12yod pas grong tsho de'i bza' tsho spyi'i brgya cha 22 21zin pa dang / pha mas 'gro stangs thag gcod byas pa khyo shug 42yod pas bza' tsho spyi'i brgya cha 76 79zin gyi yod/ rgya ma khul du rang mos dga' 'du byas pa dge 'khor khul las cung mang ba'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni de khul gyi khyo shug gnyis ka grong tsho gcig rang nas yin pa 195tsam yod pa des rgya cha 41 59zin pa dang / gnyen sgrig byed pa'i lo dus kyang mtho tsam yod pas gnyen don thad rang thag gcod pa'i dbang cha'ang cung che bas yin/ dge 'khor khul du grong tsho gcig pa yin pa'i khyo shug 17yod pa des brgya cha 20 26las zin gyi med la sa ma 'brog khul du rdo spyan cung bzang tsam gyi dud tshang de chos phru gu lo nyi shu ma zin gong nas mi

chos byed pa'i goms gshis dar khyab che bas yin/ gong gsal dbus gtsang khul gyi sa khul mi 'dra ba gnyis kyi khyo shug gi zhib phra'i gnas tshul de dag las rang mos gnyen sgrig dag dus rabs 'phel rgyas 'gro ba dang bstun nas je mang du 'gro ba'in yod kyang pha ma'i bka' bkod kyi shugs rkyen nam bag chags zab tsam bsdad yod pa mngon gyi yod/rgya ma shang dud tshang ang 185ste dung pa tshang gi pha rgan rgyal mtshan lags ni khul der shes bya yon tan che shos kyi grong pa'i bza' yon zhig yin la/ da bar rin chen sgang slob chung gi dge rgan gnang mus yin/ khong ni nga tshos 2004lo nas 2005lo bar khul der spyi tshogs brtag zhib byed skabs bcar 'dri zhu yul gtso bo zhig yin/ skabs de dus khong gis nga tshor ngo sprod gnang ba'i khong rang tshang gi gnas tshul zhig nas dmangs khrod du bu phrug gi gnyen don la pha mas zab nan ji ltar byed kyi yod pa mngon thub nges yin pas 'dir mdor bsdus bkod rgyu gsham gsal ltar/pha rgan rgyal mtshan lags kyis gsungs par/ nga lo bco brgyad skabs phun tshogs khang gsar nas dung pa tshang du mag par slebs pa yin/ nga gnyis kyi 'gro stangs tshang ma pha mas bzos byung/ skabs de dus bu dang bu mo blo mos kyis chang sa rgyag mkhan nyung nyung red/ nga'i bza' zla 2002lor grong song /khong la khyon bsdoms phru gu bdun skyes la de rnams kyi rgan 'go ni da lta grong tsho'i kru'u ren byed mkhan rgya mtsho yin/ rgya mtsho'i gnyen sgrig gi 'gro stangs kyang nga tsho pha ma gnyis pos bzos pa yin/ nga dang nga'i sdod rogs ga/sdu ka

khul 'di rang nas yin pas rgya ma'i g.yas g.yon du nga tsho'i spun mched mang po yod/ der brten 'di khul nas blo la bab pa'i bu'i gna' ma zhig rnyed dka' bas/ rgya mtsho lo 26la slebs skabs/ nga tshos ka tshal na yod pa'i spun mched zhig la rgya ma dang bar rgyang ring tsam gyi sa nas bu mo yag pa zhig 'tshol rogs zhes mngags pa yin/ ka tshal gyi spun mched des ring min rtswa zhol byang 'og na bu mo zhig yod pa de 'tsham po yod pa'i lan gnang byung / de 'phral nga dang nga'i co cog de khul la phyin nas mi gzhan brgyud khyim tshang de'i gnas tshul dang khyad par rus rgyud kyi skor dang / bu mo de'i kha ris ngo mdog dang lo rtags bcas dris pa yin/ mi mang pos ngo sprod gnang ba tshang ma mi 'tsham pa mi 'dug pas/ nga tshos bu mo'i pha mar slong chang btang ba yin/ bu mo'i pha mas de sngon nas nga tsho'i khyim tshang gi gnas tshul shes kyi yod pas bu mo nga tsho'i bu'i gna' mar ster rgyu'i zhal bzhes lam sang gnang byung la/ nam rgyun yin na slong chang thengs ma gnyis gsum gtong dgos kyi yod na'i lam thag ring bas slong chang thengs ma gcig rang gis 'grig ces gsungs byung / de dus nga chos slong chang dang slong ja/ slong mar/ nu rin bcas phul ba ma zad mna' ma bsu rgyu'i dus tshod kyang gtan 'khel byas rjes nyi ma nyi shu lhag tsam nas bu mo bde skyid g.yang 'dzoms mna' mar bsus pa yin/ de'i gong la kho gnyis ngo tsam yang thug myong med na'ang bu mo mna' mar slobs rjes kho gnyis 'cham po 'dug12nga tshos slar yang khong la phru gu chung ba drug gi gnyen don thad 'char gzhi

gang yod dam zhes 'dri skabs/ khong gis nga tshor rgya mtsho ni phru gu'i nang gi rgan 'go yin pas gzhis 'dzin mkhan de yin/ phru gu gzhan rnams kho rang tshor blo mthun pa byung na ngo rgol mi byed/ 'on kyang nga'i phru gu rnams de'i thad rang 'gul zhan tsam yin/ gal srid dus tshod nar 'gyang byas na ngas 'gro stangs bzo rgyu yin zhes gsungs byung / —dung pa tshang gi pha rgyal mtshan lags kyis bu phrug gi gnyen don thad bzhed pa'i dgongs tshul dang gnang stangs de lta bu ni bod kyi dmangs khrod du tshang mas brtsi bkur dang lag len byed pa'i yongs khyab rang bzhin ldan pa'i gnang stangs shig yin pa nga tshos lan mang gzhi rim du brtag zhib byed skabs gsal por shes byung /bod kyi yul du bu mo mna' mar ster ba'i srol yod la skyes pa mag par gtong ba'i goms gshes kyang yod/ bag ma dang mag pa zer ba ni phyogs gcig nas phyogs gzhan pa der ster ba'i bu 'am bu mo'i zla bo la zer ba yin/bod kyi srol rgyun la skyes pa'i khyim du bud med mna' mar blangs ste khyim gzhis skyong ba la bag ma'am mna' ma len pa zer ba dang / skyes pa bud med kyi khyim du bu mo'i sdod rogs su blangs nas khyim gzhis skyong ba la mag pa len pa zer/dmangs khrod du bag ma len mkhan yod la mag pa len mkhan yang yod pa ma zad/ thab gsar gzhis gsar zhes khyo shug gnyis nas khyim gzhis gsar pa bzung mkhan yang mi nyung tsam yod pa bcas bu'am bu mo gtong len byed stangs la rnam pa gsum tsam yod/ gzhi rkang 6 bu mo 'gro sa gnas yu/ byin/

lo gsum 'gor can rang yul yin mi 0zhes pa dang smyo khyod gnas la ster mkhan phu bo red/ 'gro dgos pa bu mo'i 'gro lugs red mi 0ces pa ltar bod kyi dud tshang mang che bas bu mo mna' mar ster ba dang bu la mna' ma bsu ba'i goms gshis yod/ bu mor mag pa bsu mkhan mang che ba ni khyim tshang nang bu med stabs bu mor mag pa bsu ba yin/ de ni rang ljongs kyi grags can sku drag nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/ lha klu tshe dbang rdo rje/ tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul sogs kyi lo rgyus las mngon thub/ ngag dbang 'jigs med dang / tshe dbang rdo rje/ zla bzang dgra 'dul bcas thog ma nga phod dang lha klu/ tsha rong bcas kyi bu rgyud min yang sku drag khyim tshang de gsum la bu med pas de tsho'i bu mo'i mag par slebs pa dang khyim tshang de gsum gyi khrims mthun shul 'dzin mkhan du gyur yod pa dag kun gyis mkhyen gsal ltar dang / de 'dra ba'i khyim tshang la bu med rigs bu mor mag pa bsu mkhan dmangs khrod du yod pa rnams brjod kyis mi lang / gzhan yang khyim tshang nang bu yod bzhin du de mag par ster/ bu mo la mag pa bsu mkhan yang med pa min la de bas 'jom byar bzung gi med/ dper na pa snam rdzong khongs dge 'khor rdzong grong tsho'i dud tshang ang 29ste shar steng tshang la cha mtshon na bu khrid bza' tsho gnyis la bu gsum dang bu mo gnyis skyes pa dang / bu rgan pas thab gsar btsugs nas rang gzhis zin pa phud/ bu chung ba gnyis ka mag par ster/ bu mo rgan lho /spro/ : lha:sna shā/sdo rti/lha ཿswā/hārshatā /shā/ju lhastu//

pa de yang mna' mar ster/ khang pa ma tshang du bu mo chung shos pa sangs mchog skyid la mag pa bsus yod/ de 'dra ba'i dud tshang mi nyung ba zhig gang sar rig rgyu yod/ gsham du nga tshos rgya ma shang dang dge 'khor rdzong grong tsho'i bag ma'am mag pa gtong len gyi zhib phra'i gnas tshul dper drangs rgyu la/ rgya ma shang gi bza' tsho 447(bsdoms bza' tsho 46/yod pa'i nang 22kyi zhib phra'i gnas tshul ma shes )yod pa'i nang bu mag par slebs pa 194yod pas bza' tsho spyi'i brgya cha 42 40zin pa dang / bu mo mna' mar slebs pa 209yod pas bza' tsho spyi'i brgya cha 46 75zin pa/ thab gsar gzhis gsar bzung mkhan dud tshang 44yod pas bza' tsho spyi'i brgya cha 9 84zin gyi yod/'dir 'khod pa'i thab gsar gzhis gsar gyi dud tshang rnams kyang thog ma nyid nas dga' 'du byas te thab gsar pa 'dzin pa ma yin par sngon la dud tshang ma der mna' ma'am mag par slebs/ de rjes grong pa kha gyes pa mang yang de rigs kyis rang gi gnas tshul ngo sprod byed skabs grong pa kha gyes pa de ngo tsha ba'i rgyu ru brtsis nas gnyen sgrig thog ma byed skabs nas gzhis gsar bzung pa yin zhes brjod mkhan mang / de bzhin rdzong grong tsho'i bza' tsho 56yod pa'i nang bu mo mna' mar slebs pa 48yod pa des bza' tsho spyi'i brgya cha /5 71zin pa dang / bu mag par slebs pa g.yod pas bza' tsho spyi'i brgya cha 〈 92rin pa/ thab gsar gzhis gsar bzung mkhan dud tshang 2yod pas bza' tsho spyi'i brgya cha 5 25zin gyi yod/ yul tshan gnyis kyi dmangs khrod kyi dngos yod gnas tshul de las bag ma'am mag pa gtordo byen

byed pa'i rnam pa mi 'dra ba gsum phan tshun bsdur nas bshad na bag ma len mkhan mang ba dang / mag pa len mkhan 'bring tsam/ thab gsar gzhis gsar bzung mkhan nyung shos su snang ngo / /bodakyi gnyen sgrig byas chog pa'i khyab khongs kyi brtsi tshul la sa khul so sor brtsi tshul mi 'dra ba mang po yod kyang spyir yul tshang mar gnyen nye 'gab mthunakhyas tshe de ni ha cang tha shal gyi spyod tshul zhig tu brtsi yi yod/ yul gru mang che bar pha tshan mi rabs bdun brgyud dang ma tshan mi rabs lnga brgyud tshun chad du gnyen sgrig byas mi chog pa dang / gal srid mi rabs bdun nam lnga brgyud tshun chad du gnyen sgrig byas tshe nye du'am gnyen 'dun gnyen sgrig zer ba'am yang na dam nyams kha sbyor zer nas nag nyes chen po yod mkhan la brtsis te khrims 'gal nyes can rnams ltar gnas dbyung gtong ba'i srol yod pa'am yang na ko btums brgyab nas gtsang por bskyur ba'i lugs srol yod skad/ yang yul 'ga' shas su gnyen nye 'gab mthun byas pa'i brtsi tshul gong dang cung mi 'dra ba'i cha yod pa'ang dper na ngam ring rdzong khongs pha la khul gyi 'brog pa rnams kyis pha tshigs bdun dang ma tshigs bzhi ru brtsi srol yod/ de yang pha tshan mi rabs bdun brgyud tshun dang ma tshan ding spo bo deng rmo bo 0tshun chad gnyen sgrig byas na nye 'du gnyen sgrig byas par brtsi la de lta bu'i spyod tshul la 'jug mkhan rnams nag nyes tshabs che na ko btums brgyab stu ngamaringakhulagyi 'brog pa'i 'bodasrol te sgobo'i tsobo dang rmo mo'i rmo mo la zer/

nas chu la bskyur ba dang / yang ba rnams thod par lcags tsha pos rgya gram gyi rtags brgyab nas rgyang 'bud gtong srol yod/ yang 'ga' shas kyis 6 pha rgyud ma rgyud nas gnyen tshan 'gro min thad rtsad gcod nan po byed dgos kyi yod/ pha rgyud thog nas gnyen tshan yin phyin/ mi rabs ga tshad phyin min la ma bltos par gnyen sgrig byed srol med/ ma rgyud nas gnyen tshan gyi 'brel ba yod pa yin na/ tshigs chen gsum dang tshigs 'phreng gsum zhes mi rabs drug ma phyin dbar gnyen sgrig byed srol med/ miXyang dper na gtsang khul gyi yul 'ga' shas su 2 pha tshigs rdzogs mtha' med ma tshigs bdun nas bud ces pha tshan gyi rgyud yin pa tsam gyis gnyen sgrig byas mi chog pa dang ma tshan mi rabs bdun brgyud tshun chad gnyen sgrig byas mi chog pa'i srol yod/ de yang pa snam rdzong khongs dge 'khor yul la cha mtshon na der rus rgyud che ba rgya bu rgyud/ skyid lo rgyud/ spel stod rgyud bcas gsum du dbye srol yod pa rnams so sor dud tshang bcu phrag 'ga' shas sam bcu phrag lhag tsam yod/ de'i nang rus rgyud gcig pa'i dud tshang mang po'i dbar gnyen 'brel 'gro lugs dang dus gang tsam nas gnyen 'brel gyi 'brel ba tshugs pa sogs su la'ang bshad rgyu med kyang rus rgyud gcig yin tshe gnyen sgrig byas mi chog pa dang / rus chud gcig las gyes pa'i bu rgyud rnams kyi rjes skyes dbar gnyen sgrig byas chog gi med/ nga tshos dud tshang yang 4pa ste pha shar tshang gi gnas tshul dpe du bon mi'i yulasrol gomasagashis100〉ashog ngos76la gsal/ 17

mtshon du drangs rgyu la/ dud tshang de'i rus rgyud spel stod rgyud yin pa dang /dge 'khor khul du spel stod rgyud khongs bsdoms dud tshang bcu gsum tsam yod/ pha shar tshang dang rus rgyud gcig pa'i dud tshang gzhan dbar gyi gnyen 'brel 'gro lugs de pa'i pha gon spen dgos lags la bka' 'dri zhu skabs bkragasar dang pad zur tshang gnyis dang de pa'i dbar srun nye por brtsi la gnyen gyi 'gro lugs gsungs rgyu yod pa las gzhan rnams dang gnyen 'brel 'gro lugs gsal po gsung rgyu mi 'dug pha shar tshang dang bkra gsar tshang ni thog mar pad zur tshang gi lhag pa dang phur bu spun gnyis dud tshang de gnyis la mag par ster nas gnyen gyi 'brel ba tshugs pa dang khong gnyis kyi pha nas rtsis pas da bar mi rabs bdun par slobs yod 'on kyang dud tshang de gnyis kyi mi rabs gcig pa'i bu rnams phan tshun jo jo dang o lo (yul skad )ste phu nu'i 'bod phyogs kyis 'bod pa dang / phan tshun gyi bu phrug gis pha rabs rnams la a khu dang a ne zhes 'bod kyi yod la spun mched nye por brtsi yi yod/gnyen nye 'gab mthun byed pa'i mi gtsang spyod pa de bod kyi yul gru tshang ma'i 'jom bya yin la/ gnyen nye'i dbar pho mo'i 'brel ba byung tshe dme byas zhes nag nye bsags pa dang dud 'gro lta bur brtsi ba ma zad phru gu byad mi tshang ba skye yong zhes brjod nas chu ma shor gong la rags rgyag byed pa dang / gnas tshul de rigs lhag pa'i rjes snying rje spangs te bya thabs sna tshogs spyad nas rjes —rabs la slob gso yang gtong gi yod/ dper na/ skyid rong khul du rdzong kha nadi sbyod grong bar gyi lam zur zhig na 'grul bzhud pa rnams kyis mchod rten

zhig rig rgyu yod/ mchod rten de'i ming la ming sring mkhar zhes 'bod srol yod/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni snga dus pha ma gcig pa'i phu bo dang nu mo gnyis dme byas pas yul gyis nyes khrims spyad de kho gnyis mchod rten de'i 'og tu gson sbas btang bas mchod rten gyi ming mdu'ang ming sring mkhar zhes 'bod srol chags yod/ mdor na bod pa rnams kyis rigs rus 'chol bar mi spyod pa dang / rjes skyes kyi bde thang ched du gnyen sgrig byed mi chog pa'i srung bya du ma yod pa'i nang nye du gnyen sgrig byed rgyu gtan 'gog byas pa de ni bya thabs kāzang ngan la ma bltos pa tshan rig dang mthun pa'i spyod bzang kho na lags bod kyi gnyen sgrig gi 'jom bya'i nang yang dag min pa'i rjes lus kyi 'dzem bya byed srol yod pa ni rigs rus mi 'dra ba'i dbar gnyen sgrig bya rgyur 'dzem bya byed pa de yin/ bod ljongs zhing khul du mi la rigs rus mtho dman mchog zhan gyi dbye ba phye ste mgar ba dang / rtogs ldan/ bshan pa sogs rigs rus dman par 'dzin pa dang / yul nyung shas su shing bzo dang / thags las/ mnyed las/ rdza bzo sogs kyi las rigs la 'jug mkhan rnams kyang dman par 'dzin te btsog lta mthong chung gis de rnams dang grong pa phal pa'i dud tshang yin kyang gnyen 'brel mi byed pa dang / zas gos lus gsum bsre mi chog pa'i lta ba zab po yod/ de lta bu'i rigs rus dman par brtsi ba rnams 'dra po 'dra po mnyam sdebs byed rgyu las med la lhag par bu med pa'i rigs dman par brtsi ba'i dud tshang la mag pa slong dgos 19

byung na de bas dka' ngal che ba 'phrad kyi yod/ gang la zer na bod kyi gtam dper mna' ma khungs gtsang nas len/ bu mo skyid sar gtong zhes pa ltar bod pa rnams kyis pha rgyud la rus dang ma rgyud la sha zhes brjod la sha rus gnyis las rus 'gangs che bar 'dzin gyi yod pas yin/ rigs dman pa'i dud tshang rnams las 'byor pa cung che ba yod na grong pa phal pa'i dud tshang gi bu mo mna' mar slong phod la 'ga' res rgyu dngos la bltas nas ster mkhan yang yod/ dper na/ pa snam rdzong dge 'khor khongs kyi pad zur tshang ni spel stod rgyud yin pas de khul du rus rgyud mtho ba'i khongs su gtogs kyi yod/pad zur phur dgos la a ne gsum byung ba las chung shos ming du chog pa 'bod pa de khul de'i bshan pa'i rigs rgyud yin pa'i 'grong zur tshang la mna' mar ster yod/ khong thog mar mna' mar ster ba'i dus su gcig nas dud tshang der bu mo spun gsum yod pas tshang mar ster go rgyan gos dra rgyas po sgrig thabs med pa dang / gnyis nas 'grong zur tshang la ma gzhi khul der btsog lta byed pa dang / rigs dman par brtsi yi yod rung de'i dpal 'byor phyug tsam yod la bu spun gsum po de mi gshis bzang la las la 'jon pa kha kyang yod pas 'grong zur bu gsum gyi pha des bu mo mna' mar slong skabs/chog pa'i pha des rang gi rus rgyud gcig pa'i bgres song rgan shos (skabs de dus )pha shar sri dar la gros dris pas sri dar gyis bu mo chog pa 'grong zur la mna' mar ster rgyur mos mthun byas pa ma zad da dung khong gis 6 rus gyar ba ni ༵ byin/ sha tig kha gcig gyar bar skyon che ba med ’ ces brjod myong yang

yod/ yang bod kyi gtam dpe la ra mtho po mtho po 'dra sdeb byed/ dma' po dma' po 'dra sdeb byed/ med po med po 'dra sdeb byed ’ 0ces bshad srol yod pa ltar bod kyi khul 'dir gnyen sgrig byed skabs bu phyogs dang bu mo phyogs kyi dud tshang gnyis kyi gnas babs dang dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen sogs 'dra po yin pa 'dra sdeb byed srol yod pa dang / lhag par du khyim rgyud che gras rnams kyi khrod gnas tshul de de bas tshabs che ba yod/ 'on kyang khyim rgyud che gras rnams dang phal pa'i dud tshang rnams gnyen sgrig byed rgyu de tshang mas do snang byed pa'i 'jom byar gyur med/ 〈snang sa 'od 'bum gyi rnam thar sminang 6 mtho ba nam mkha'i lam gyi nyi ma dang / dma' ba sa yi steng gi pad ma gnyis/mtho dman thug pa'i khyad par yod na yang / las dbang mthun pas phan tshun mdza' grogs byed/ ring ba'i mda' mo mtshal stong rgod sgro dang / thung ba'i gzhu mo ra rgod 'khyil ba gnyis/ ring thung thug pa'i khyad par yod na yang /las dbang mthun pas phan tshun mdza' grogs byed/ che ba mtha' yi rgya mtsho chen po dang / chung ba lto dkar nya chung gser mig gnyis/ che chung thug pa'i khyad par yod na yang / las dbang mthun pas phan tshun mdza' grogs byed/dbang chen dpon po grags pa bsam grub dang / phal pa'i bu mo snang sa 'od 'bum gnyis/ mnga' thang mi mnyam khyad par yod na yang / las dbang yod pas cis kyang bag mar 'gro/ ②zhes pa'i dpe don dum bu 'di las gcig ཿ 'i rdo : /tshi lhayi kta'i rnyitnaX gatstsha sa gsungs/ 21

nasakhyim rgyud che gas rnams 'dra po mnyam sdeb byed pa mtshon yod la gnyis nas rigs ngan du brtsi ba rnams phud phyug po rnams kyis phal pa'i dud tshang gnyen 'brel byed skabs kyi 'jom byar 'dzin gyi med pa bstan yod do/ /gzhan yang bod kyi gnyen sgrig lugs srol khrod du bu dang bu mo'i lo dang lo rtags thad kyi 'dzem bya la/ zhing 'brog khul du da lta'i bar bu phug gi 'gro stangs pha mas bzo ba'i gnyen sgrig lam lugs shugs che bar mchis la pha mas bu yi mdun thab 'tshol skabs thog mar bu dang bu mo'i lo rtags mthun min blta yi yod/ lo rtags gnyis bdun zur yin tshe de 'dzem byar bzung gi yod/bdun zur yin na khyo shug gnyis slad du 'khon che ba dang 'cham mthun yong dka' ba'i ltas ngan du mngon gyi yod/ de rnams kyi mngon tshul yang 6 khyi 'brug skad kyi bdun zur/ byi rta mig pa'i bdun zur/ stag sprel rtsal gyi bdun zur/ phag sbrul tshang gi bdun zur/ glang lug rdung ba'i bdun zur/bya yos zas kyi bdun zur mi zhes pa ltar yin/ de min bu la mna' rim 'tshol ba'am bu mor mag pa 'tshol skabs bu mo'i lo de bu las chung ba 'tshol ba dang /lhag par du bu mo de bu las lo gcig gis che ba yod na gcig snon zhes mi shis pa yong rgyur mngon nas 'dzem byar bzung gi yod pa dang / 6 bcu dgu'i bu mo gdong nag ma/ mgo gser g.yus rgyan yang ma len cig ces sho bshad nang bshad srol yod pa ltar na bu mo lo bcu dgu'i skabs mna' mar bsu rgyu 'dzem byar bzung gi yod pa'ang mtshon yod do/ /22

gnyis/ 'jig rten go bag khab len gyi rnam pa 'ga'/spyir mi'i rigs kyi gnyen sgrig lam srol gyi khrod go bag khab len byed pa'i rnam pa dag ni pha ma'i bka' bkod ltar gnyen sgrig byed pa dang / pho mo gzhon nu rang mos kyis dga' 'du byed pa'i rnam pa ste rang 'dod dang btsan dbangagi rigs gnyis la mi bsdus pa gang yang med kyang rigs de gnyis kyi nang du'ang yan lag gi rnam pa mi 'dra ba mang po yod/ rang re bod kyi gnyen srol lo rgyus kyi 'phel rim la blta skabs/ dmangs khrod du ya mtshan can gyi gnyen sgrig gi rnam pa sna tshogs byung 'dug pa ni g.yog bsu dang / brje len byed pa/ mngal gnas phru gu'i gnyen sgrig rig pa'i rtsal 'gran nas mna' ma rtsod len byed pa/ drag rtsal 'gran nas mna' ma rtsod len byed pa bcas byung myong la rnam pa gong ma gsum ni pha mas bu phrug gi mi tshe'i 'gro stangs bzos pa'i khongs su gtogs pa dang phyi ma gnyis ni pha ma'i bka' bkod nas rang 'dod ltar dga' 'du byed pa'i phyogs su 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i bar brgal gyi rnam pa 'ba' zhig yin/ gsham la de rnams re re bzhin mdor bsdus kyis mtshams sbyor zhu rgyu yin/'khogabasu'i5kheston sgrigagayog bsu byed pa'i srol de pha mas bka' bkod byas pa'i gnyen sgrig gi khongs su gtogs pa dang / de ni bod kyi dmangs khrod du da lta'i bdī pyer

nas yod pa'i gnyen srol gyi rigs gcig yin/ de ni dud tshang nang bkra mi shis pa'i gnas tshul lhag pa'i skabs spyad pa'i thabs med 'u thug gi bya thabs shig yin/ de yang dud tshang zhig gi nang khyo shug gnyis yod pa las gcig lnga ba'i lam du phebs te ya gcig dang phru gu nar ma son par lus pa'i gnas tshul byung ba'i skabs spyod pa'i bya thabs shig yin/ dud tshang de'i pha'am ma ya gyar des phru gu la mi chos byed pa'i nar ma son gong nas mna' ma'am mag pa snga snar du len pa'i srol yod/ der yul 'ga' shas su g.yog bsu zhes 'bod pa dang / yul 'ga' shas su lugs srol de dar yod rung dmigs bsal gyi tha snyad 'bod srol med/ 'on kyang / snga sdur du bsus pa'i mna' ma'am mag pa de rnams spyir bu'am bu mo las lo rgan pa yod pa dang las sne zin pa sha stag yin/ de'i dmigs yul yang grong pa de'i las ku'i dgos mkho la brten nas bsus pa yin la/ slad du bu'am bu mo nar son yong skabs snga snur du bsus pa'i mna' ma'am mag pa dang ming don mtshungs pa'i khyo shug chags kyi yod/ der brten tha snyad yod med la ma ltos pa lugs srol de nyid ni g.yog bsu'i gnyen sgrig lam srol zhig rang yin/ g.yog bsu byas pa'i dud tshang ches nyung shas nang pha dang bu'i mna' ma'am ma dang bu mo'i mag pa'i bar khrel med byi byas pa'i gnas tshul lhag gi yod pa dang / de lta bu'i dmigs bsal gyi gnas tshul de rigs ni rgyus med can gyis bod kyi dmangs khrod du pha bus mna' ma mnyam spyod byed pa dang ma smad kyis mag pa mnyam spyod byed pa'i gnyelha/ srol yod par 'dzin pa'i nor 'khrul gyi lta ba chags pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo

de yin/ gzhan yang g.yog bsu'i gnyen srol gyi rnam pa gzhan zhig ni sngon nas dud tshang gnyis kyis bu phrug gi gnyen sgrig skad cha byas tshar yod rung /gnyen ston gyi dus tshod slebs nyer bu'am bu mo'i tshang gang rung du mi shi skyon chag byung bas gnyen ston dus thog tu spel ma thub tshe/ mna' ma'am mag pa sngar gyi bag rtsis la gang babs ltar dus thog la ster ba dang / de dus rten 'brel mi byed la/ skal rdzong rnams phyir 'gyang byed/ de rjes 'das po de'i lo mchod yol rjes 6 len byas mi zhes skal rdzong rnams ster la rten 'brel zhig byed srol yod/ de lta bu'i gnyen srol la'ang g.yog bsu zhes 'bod srol yod/bzhe6slon gyisasten sgrigabarje len byed pa'i gnyen srol 'di nyid bod kyi dmangs khrod du dar khyab chen po rang med/ 'di ni pha mas bka' bkod byed pa'i gnyen srol gyi ya rgyal zhig yin/ gnyen sgrig lam srol 'di lta bu lag bstar byed pa'i gtso bo'i dmigs yul ni rgyu nor gyi ched du min par gnyen nye thog gnyen brtsegs yong ba'i ched du yin/ de'i rnam pa'ang dngos su bu mo dang bu mo'am bu dang bu smar rjen du brje len byed pa'i mi rigs gzhan khrod du dar ba'i brje len gyi gnyen srol dang mi 'dra bar mngon chung mig lam du 'gro bde ba zhig yin/spyir dud tshang gnyis gyi bu mo phan tshun mna' mar bsu len byas pa yin rung de la dus kyi snga phyi yod pa dang / ster skal nor dod la zhib rtsis med pa gang sbyin pha ma'i blo 'dod yin pa/ phyi tshul du nye thog gnyen brtsegs yi/ sgril

byed pa mang bar mchis so/ brje len byed pa'i rnam pa la bu mo dang bu mo brje len byed pa dang / bu dang bu brje len byed pa/ yang na dud tshang gcig la bu mo mang po yod pa dang / dud tshang gzhan zhig la bu mang po yod tshe bu dang bu mo brje len byed pa'ang yod/ brje len byed pa'i gnyen srol gyi rigs 'di ni rigs rus dman par 'bod pa'i mgar bshan sogs kyi dud tshang dbar dang / dbul zhing phongs pa'i dud tshang dbar/ yang na dud tshang che gras khag gi khrod du dar shas che ba yod/ 'di las bod kyi go bag khab len byed lugs su rigs rus go gnas mtho dman dang / rgyu nor dbul phyug rang mnyam cha sgrig byed pa shas che ba mtshon yod/mngal5khenas phyagu'i5ltonyen sgrigamangal gnas phru gu'i gnyen sgrig ni bu phrug ma btsas gong nas mngal gnas thog pha mas kho tsho'i 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi gan mna' bzhag ste bu phrug 'tshar longs yong ba'i dus gnyen sgrig byed du 'jug pa'i srol zhig yin/de ni pha ma'i bka' bkod ltar gnyen sgrig byed pa'i gnyen sgrig lam srol gyi khongs su gtogs pa zhig yin/ de lta'i gnyen srol da lta'i dus su mthong thos bral ba zhig yin la gna' dus su dar khyab che ba zhig min/ srol de ni dud tshang che gras khag gi dbar dar ba dang / yang na phyogs gnyis kyi pha'am ma grogs po'am grogs mo yin tshe nye thog gnyen brtsegs yong ched spyod pa'i bya ba~X shig yin/ bod kyi lugs su gnad don mang po zhig la mig rgyang ring

po'i bsam blo btang khul lam yang na bsam tshul de legs bsgrubs yong ched mi'am phyugs sogs ma skyes mngal gnas phru gu'i skabs nas de'i ma 'ongs kyi 'char gzhi bkod pa'i lugs srol yod/ dper na/ bod mi'i ming gi 'dogasasrol la khag sna tshogs yod pa'i nang 2 khog ming mi 'dogs pa'i srol yod pa ni bud med zhig la phru gu skyes pa tshang ma lag gson ma byung ba'am yang na phru gu bu mo sha stag skyes pa las bu skyes son ma byung ba'i skabs mngal gnas phru gur bla ma che khag nas khog ming zhu ba'i srol yod/ gzhan yang 'bri g.yag rta bong sogs rgyud spus legs yin tshe de'i rgyud nyo mkhan mang bas mngal thog nas nyo ba'i srol yod pa dang / da dung bsgyur ba mi gtong ba'i ched du de'i rin gong phyed tsam sngon nas gta' mar 'jog pa'i srol yod la der bsgyur gta' zhes 'bod kyi yod/ bsgyur gta' de gal srid phyugs phrug skye shor byung ba'am 'o thag ma chod gong nas shi ba'i gnas tshul byung ste lag son ma byung tshe bsgyur gta' de phyugs kyi bdag por bdag pa'i srol yang yod/ de min dud tshang so so'i dgos mkho mi 'dra bas mngal gnas kyi phyugs phrug skyes gson byung skabs pho mo'i brje len byed rgyu'i kha chad sngon nas byed srol yang yod/de lta bu'i byed lugs rnams tshang ma don der nan tan gyis 'jug pa'i tshul yin la lhag par du mngal gnas phru gu 'jig rten mthun thab la sbyar ba de pha mas phru gu'i don chen la gzab brling nan po byas khul lags kyang de yang gzab thal du phyin par snang ngo / don gang lags kyang sngon nas bsam gzhigs byed dgos nges yin/ 'on kyang don de ma ran gong nas /stan

'khel byed pa snga thal na phyis su 'gyod pa'i gling du lhung ba'am rnyog 'dzing nang du tshud sla la de las mngal gnas phru gu phyis su gnyen sgrig byed rgyu'i gtan 'khel sngon nas byas pa de ni don med 'gyod rnyog bzos pa kho nar mthong /de ni dmangs khrod gtam rgyud 〈glen pa mgo g.yug dang tshangs pa'i sras mo 〉srizhes pa'i nang gson nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas bkod yod/ gtam rgyud de'i nang don mdor bsdus shig bkod na/ ri bo yar lha sham bu'i 'dabs rol/chu bo yar stod phu chu'i g.yas g.yon/ mkhar btsan yum bu lha mkhar gyi nye bar gna' snga mo stobs 'byor dang mnga' thang rgyas los 'dra 'dra yin pa'i so nam pa'i dud tshang bkra shis khang gsar dang phun tshogs khang gsar zer ba gnyis yod/ de gnyis kyi mna' ma pad ma bde skyid dang sgrol ma gnyis la phru gu skye rgyu yod pa'i skabs khong gnyis kyis 66gal te khyim tshang gcig la bu dang gcig la bu mo skyes na bu mo de bu'i mna' mar ster rgyu'i mi gros byas la de mur 6 khyim tshang gnyis kyi pha ma rgan rabs rnams mnyam du 'dzoms nas mna' gan bzhag pa red/ de nas mi ring bar khong gnyis la bu gcig dang bu mo gcig skyes par khyim tshang gnyis gas btsas ston gzab rgyas byas/ de nas phru gu gnyis rim bzhin 'tshar longs yong ba'i skabs/ 6 bkra shis khang gsar gyi bu ni glen pa lag pas 'khyog tshad cig byung bas skad cha tshig re gnyis bshad pa de'ang lkugs brda brgyab pa las smra gdangs mi gsal bar ma zad byebye (bod ljongasadabus gtsang khul gyi dmangasakhrod gtam rgyud 〉shog ngos 98la gsal/

bzhin mi sdug pas yul de'i mi rnams kyis 8glen pa mgo g.yug mices 'bod kyi yod/ phun tshogs khang gsar gyi bu mo ni mthong ba tsam gyis yid dbang 'phrog pa/ gzugs byad yag la sked skabs phra ba/ bzhin ras dkar la spyan dkyus ring ba/ so gral 'grig la mchu sgros dmar ba/ mgo skyes lan bu nag cing 'jam pa/ gsung dbyangs snyan zhing smra gdangs gsal ba/ ngang rgyud ring zhing blo bag yangs pa/ blo rig gsal zhing kun spyod legs pa/ pha mar gus shing gnyen nyer brtse bas yul mi tshos tshangs pa'i sras mo zhes 'bod kyi yod/mi der brten phun tshogs khang gsar gyi pha ma gnyis nas rang gi bu mo glen pa mgo g.yug gi khab tu sprad 'dod med pas mna' tshig las 'gal te dud tshang nyam chung zhig gi bu 'od zer bya ba mag par bsu rgyu byas pa ma zad slong chang gi rten 'brel yang byas/ don de glen pa mgo g.yug gi pha ma gnyis kyis shes skabs khong khro dang sems sdug cig car du 'phel zhing gzhung gtug rgyag rtsis byas/ don de rnams 'od zer dang khong gi pha dngos grub kyis shes rjes 'od zer gyis 6 rnyog 'dzing de'i nang zhugs rgyu min pa'i tshig thag bcad pa ma zad sems 'dzin dang phrag dog nam yang mi byed pa'i blo bstan/ gnas tshul de lta'i 'og tshangs pa'i sras mo'i pha yis pho rgod pa las gnyid skyid pa dga' sems bzhin 'gyod pa'i ngang bu mo glen pa mgo g.yug la ster rgyu'i mna' gan don thog tu mi 'khyol thabs med thug bshad rgyun de'i thog nas mngal gnas phru gu'i gnyen srol de rigs byung tshul dang gal po che la nan tan byas khul de'ang nan thal du shor ba mtshon yod/ 29

drag rtsalagacir nas mna' ma rtsodacagikhyen pa'iganyen grol/gnyen srol 'di ni bu gnyis sam gsum bzhis bud med gcig rang gi mna' mar rtsod len byed skabs drag po'i rtsal sna tshogs 'gran te rtsal gyi rgyal kha thob mkhan la bud med de thob par brtsi ba'i gnyen srol zhig yin/ de ni mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus thog byung snga ba'i gna' dus kyi gnyen srol zhig yin/'dzam gling thog gi mi rigs mang po zhig gi gnyen sgrig lam srol la drag rtsal bsdur nas mna' ma rtsod len byed pa'i srol dar myong yod la/ de ni mi rigs de'am sa khul de'i mi dmangs rnams drag po'i rtsal la dga' ba'am de pa'i lo rgyus 'phel rim thog zang zing 'khrug cha che ba'i dmag 'khrug du ma langs nas skye bo rnams kyi blo ngor drag rtsal med na 'tsho ba skyel dka' ba ma zad/ rang gi lus srog kyang srung dka' ba'i snang ba 'char ba dang chabs cigabu mo'i tshe gang gi gtan grogs 'tshol skabs kyang pho gsar la drag rtsal yod dgos pa'i re ba zhig thon pa dang / bu mo gcig mna' mar 'dod mkhan nam slong mkhan gyi pho gsar mang po 'dzoms skabs kyang yang snying su yi rtsal che min brtag pa'i ched du drag rtsal bsdur ba gtong ba'i lugs srol de dar bar snyam/ de lta bu'i gnyen sgrig gi lugs srol rang re gangs can pa'i lo rgyus thog byung myong ngam zhe na/ dar khyab che min la ma bltos pa bod kyi lo rgyus chu rgyun ring po'i nang byung myong yod/ gang la zer na/ bod 'di yang 'dzam klidī zlog gi mi rigs kun dang 'dra bar bskal pa ya thog gi dus su sa khul

gcig gi nang spyi yis bla ru bkur ba'i khrims kyi bdag po med pa dang / de yod na'ang spyi kun gnon thub pa'i mthu nus med par brten mi dang mi'i dbar/ khyim rgyud dang khyim rgyud kyi dbar/ grong sde dang grong sde'i dbar/yul lung dang yul lung gi dbar gnad don gang dang ci bad nas gyod gzhi byung ba rnams zhi bde'i sgo nas thag gcod thub dka' bas phyogs gnyis po'i drag rtsal la brten nas thag gcod dgos kyi yod rkyen pho gsar la drag rtsal yod dgos pa'i re ba bcangs pa ni go ba lon bde ba zhig yin/ 〈ne tso'i gtam rgyud go bde kun phan 〉zhes pa'i skyid pa'i lo rgyus bcu'i nang 66khrims yang med pa'i lung pa na/ pha med rku mag jag pa skyid/’ 0ces zer ba ltar khrims med pa'i sa khul du ma rabs rnams ni lha a pho su bzang mi gis rang phan gyi bya spyod la 'jug gi yod pa dang / mi thams cad bag phebs bde lhod kyi skabs med par gsod rdung 'phrog bcom la dogs zon kho na byed dgos rkyen skyes pa pho rnams la dpa' rtsal yod dgos pa dang / chom rkun la phar rgol byed rgyu ni pho nod rnams kyi 'os 'gan red snyam/ de yis ma tshad ha lam dus rabs ga ge mo'i nang chom rkun gyi spyod par 'jug pa'ang tha shal spyod ngan la mi brtsi bar rku 'phrog byed thub pa rang gi 'jon thang la brtsi ba'i dus sheg byung yod tshod 'dug de yang dper na bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam rgyud nang 66gna' snga mo dud tshang zhig gi nang bza' tsho gnyis dang khong tshor bu phrug du de tso'i gtam rgyud go bde kun phan 〉lag brisanang gsal/ 31

'ga' yod/ yul de'i goms gshis la grong tsho phan tshun nor phyugs rku res byed kyi yod pa dang / yul sde gzhan nas phyugs rigs rku thub pa dang / yul tsho gnyis kyi sa mtshams nas rang ngos su slebs pa yin na phyugs rigs de dag rku mkhan la bdag gi yod pa dang / sa mtshams ma 'grol gong nas 'ju thub na phyugs rigs bdag por bdag gi yod/ der brten rku ma rgyag pa'i dus tshod yag shos ni mi nyal khyi nyal mi skad khyi skad med pa'i nam gung gi dus tshod la 'dzin gyi yod/ dud tshang de'i pha des rtag tu nam srod skabs su 6nga rta rku bar 'gro gi yin/ nga g.yag rku bar 'gro gi yin zer gyi yod pa dang / nam gung la slebs dus pha de gnyid la yur nas don thog tu 'khyol gyi med pa red/byas tsang ma des pha der kha nas bshad pa don 'khyol yong gi med par 6srod la rta rku g.yag rku zer/ nam phyed rgya mtsho'i dar las 'jam :zhes zur za byed kyi yod mi bugatam de da lta'i bar kha bshad don 'khyol mi thub mkhan la zur za byed skabs brjod bzhin yod/btsan po srong btsan sgam po srid khrir 'khod nas bod yongs kyi srid kyi kha lo bsgyur ba'i skabs kyang ma gzhi spyi tshogs kyi phyogs yongs la 'gyur ba gnam sa lta bu byung yod kyang dpa' rtsal che ba'i skye bo rnams la gzhan las lhag pa'i brtsi bkur byedakyi yod/ de yang tun hong yig rnying las byung ba'i btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i mdzad rjes mdor bstan du bkod pa'i nang /bye gtsang pa snam dge 'khor khul gyi mig tshe lagasakyisagasungs/ khong da lo dgung lo 70la phebs yod/

6 'jigs pa ni mnan/ bden pa ni bsnyen/ 'dzangs pa ni bstod/ dpa' bo ni bkur/ smon par ni bkol/ mi zhes gsal bar gzhigs na/btsan po sku ngo mas gtso byas dpa' bo la brtsi bkur zhu bar don snying chen po ldan yod pa ste/ mi rigs sam rgyal khab gang 'dra zhig yin rung de dar rgyas phun sum tshogs su gtong rgyu dang / dbang bsgyur ba'i dbang cha sra brtan gtong rgyur dpa' rtsal ldan pa'i dmag gi srung skyob mkhan med thabs med/de yi gal che'i rang bzhin de dpa' mdzangs ldan pa'i btsan po srong btsan sgam pos mkhyen te khrims drug drug so drug gi bstod pa gsum gyi nang 6 dpa' bo la stag gis ma bstod na/ dpa' bo byas pa'i don med mices pa dang /yang smad pa gsum gyi nang snye snar ma la wa zhus ma chad na/ dpa' bo dang sdar ma'i shan mi phyed mices pa'i nang don gsal bar bkod yod/ gzhan yang btsan po 'dus srong mang po rje'i skabs byung ba'i rtsal po che mi bdun gyi rtsal sna'i snyan grags khyab che ba dang / dmangs khrod du dar ba'i pho la rtsal dgu tshang dgos pa'i nang gi 6 bang rkyal sbe mda' rdo mchongs ’ bcas la dang zhen byed lugs bcas tshang ma'i thad nas pho rab la rtsal sna tshogs 'dzoms dgos pa dang / rtsal dang ldan pa'i pho rgod rnams la dga' zhen brtsi bkur zhu ba'i spyi tshogs kyi goms gshis khyab chen po yod pa yongs su mtshon yod/ de lta bu'i bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi spyi'i 'khor yug des sngar nas yod bzhin pa'i drag rtsal bsdur te mna' ma rtsod len byed pa'i gnyen srol de rgyun mthud gnas rgyu'am de'i rnam par 'gyur ba phran bu byung nas gnas rgyur cha rkyen rngadi /na

bskrun yod/ lhag par du btsan po'i rgyal rabs kha 'thor te sil bur gyur ba'i zang zing gi dus skabs de'i nang ha lam lung chung re la dpon chung re chags nas gcig 'og gcig la ma 'dus par phan tshun g.yul 'gyed kyi bya ba'i brtul bzhugs kho na 'dzin pa'i dus su rtsal dang ldan pa'i pho rab la de bas brtsi bkur dang mthong chen byed kyi yod pa nga tshos bod kyi lo rgyus byung ba brjod pa'i snyan rtsom 〈ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung sminang nas mngon thub kyi yod pa ma zad/ drag rtsal bsdur nas mna' ma rtsod len byed pa'i gnyen srol gyi rnam pa de'ang nga tshos mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dang dam la gzab pa dar gyi mdud pa ltar gyi 'brel ba yod pa'i sgrung de las shes thub kyi yod/ de yang mtsho sngon khri ku'i gling sgrung phyogs bsgrigs nang / 'brug mo dang ge sar ngo 'phrad byung zhing mi tshe mnyam skyel gyi kha chad byas yod rung / 'brug mo'i yum gyis ngo rgol byas te 'brug mo ge sar gyi khab tu ma ster bar stag gzig nor gyi rgyal po'i khab la 'gro dgos bshad/ de rjes gling du 'brug mo'i slong chang rten 'brel thog 'brug mo slong bar yong mkhan stag gzig nor gyi rgyal po dang / bha ta hor gyi rgyal po/ gu gu g.yu yi rgyal po bcas drag rtsal bsdur bas ge sar gzhan rnams las rnam par rgyal te 'brug mo ge sar la thob pa'i bshad tshul 'khod yod pa dang / yang gtsang khul gyi dmangs khrod du gling gi dpa' bo rnams dpon mo sing lcam 'brug mo mna' mar rtsod len byed skabs drag po'i rtsal bsdur yod pa ni ri la rta rgyug 'gran pa dang / bya khyung rgod nyi ma'i rog zhang suX 1dul thub min drag rtsal 'gran rjes ge sar rgyal pos gzhan las khyad du

'phags pa'i dpa' rtsal gyis dpon mo seng lcam 'brug mo rtsod len byed thub pa byung yod pa'i bshad srol yod/ de rnams ni gzugs med na grib ma yong don med pa'i dpe ltar bod kyi lo rgyus dus rim nges can zhig gi mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i goms gshes rnams me long du gsal ba yin par rtogs sla/ de lta bu'i gnyen srol deng dus bod kyi spyi tshogs thog cher mngon rgyu med kyang /a mdo khul gyi gnyen ston skabs da lta'ang rta rtsed 'gran srol yod pa ni sngar lugs de'i shul bzhag cig yin nam snyam/ de yang / chu la 'go dang shing la rtsa ba'i dpe ltar lugs srol gang dang ci yin rung de la'ang thog ma'i 'byung rtsa re yong nges pas/ a mdo'i gnyen ston rgyun srol nang rta rtsed 'gran pa de'ang rgyu rkyen gang yang med par spro ba 'phel ched kyi rtsed mo kho na'i dbang gis lugs su dar ba min snyam mo/ /rig labasnurags mna' ma rtsod6gikhyed pa'i5nyen grol/gnyen srol 'di ni bu gnyis sam gsum mam bzhis rig pa'i rtsal 'gran nas mna' ma rtsod len byed pa'i srol zhig yin la gnyen srol 'di rigs 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rigs khri gnyis tsam yod pa'i khrod du dar khyab cung chung ba zhig yin so 'dug 'on kyang gangs can pa'i dmangs khrod srol rgyun la blo dang rig pa'i rtsal 'gran bsdur byas te mi tshe'i gtan grogs 'dem sgrug byed pa'i goms gshes shig byung myong 'dug kyang / 'o cag gi lo rgyus deb ther rnams su don 'di'i skor 'khod pa rig rgyu dben/ 'dikā sdug

'dzin pas dmangs khrod kyi sgrub dang / bshad rgyun/ de bzhin da lta'i goms sashis 'ga'i thog nas gnad don 'dir dbye zhib bya rgyu yin/1 phug ron skor ba yang yang bskor ba'i goms gshes chags tshul gyi sgrung /'ang gu dang pha wang gnyis po mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i rma bya mna' mar len 'dod yod stabs kho gnyis sus nyi ma sngon la shar ba mthong na de yi zla mor rma bya 'gro rgyu byas pa red/ 'ang gus nyi ma shar sa'i shar gyi ri la kha phyogs nas bsdad pa dang / pha wang gis nub ri'i rtse la kha ltas nas bsdad/pha wang gis ri rtser nyi ma shar ba mthong 'phral lam seng 'ang gu la rtsam pa thur ma gang btang nas 6 rtsam gang 'di bskyon nas gsol ja gang mchod dang /mi bshad/ 'ang gus de ltar byas pas de 'phral pha wang gis 6 nyi ma shar ba ngas mthong song / rma bya nga yi zla mo yin ’ zhes brjod/ 'ang gu'i kha rtsam pas gang yod pas ci yang brjod ma thub stabs dngangs tshab langs te kha nas 66'ang gu'ang gu mi zhes pa'i sgra 'don bzhin rang sar skor ba rang dbang med par bskor thal/ de nas bzung 'ang gu sa steng bab nas skad 6 'ang gu 'ang gu 'don cing skor ba yang yang bskor ba'i goms gshis chags pa yin no/ / mi du'adi ni srog chags kyi sgrung zhig yin pa dang / 6 srog chags kyi sgrung ni 3rdoX gtsang pa snam dge 'khor mig tshe lags kyisagasungs/

mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba dang spyi tshogs 'brel ba sogs srog chags kyi lus la 'od ldog 'phros byas thog blo yul du shar ba ltar rdzun bzo byas nas byung ba'i sgrung zhig red/’ 0phug ron gyis skad 'ang gu mizhes 'don pa dang /sa steng du skor ba yang yang bskor ba'i goms gshis chags tshul gyi sgrung 'di ni srog chags kyi sgrung gi nang nas srog chags kyi 'byung khungs sam khyad rtags la 'grel pa dang / gsal bshad kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i sgrung gi khongs su gtogs/ tsa srog chags kyi sgrung 'di rigs kyis srog chags kyi 'byung khungs sam khyad rtags la 'grel pa byas pa 'di 'grel pa'i ched du 'grel pa byas pa zhig min par srog chags kyi gzugs brnyan dang 'byung khungs/ khyad rtags bcas la 'phrul snang gis 'grel bshad brgyab thog 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi 'brel ba sna tshogs khyag khyog gis mtshon yong gi yod/mi zhusang 'di'i nang gi phug ron dang pha wang gi gzugs brnyan du bkod pa dag ni lang tshos dar ba'i zla med kyi gzhon nu gnyis la nges shing / rma bya'i gzugs brnyan du bkod pa dag ni mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i yid 'ong mdzes ma zhig tu nges pa dang / phug ron dang pha wang gis rma bya rtsod len byed skabs nyi ma shar ba sus sngon la tshor min 'gran mthar pha wang blo rig bkra bas nub ri'i rtse la nyi ma shar ba mthong rkyen rig pa rgyal nas rma bya zla mor byung ba'i brjod bya 'dis spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i nang mchis pa'i zla med gzhon nus rig pa ཿ ཿsa ཿཿཿ/ sgyusngu〉ཿshāḥṭā /3shātāḥ/sdo skyushā /sna re/shāḥshānda ): 〉lha sproshā/trīḥsna/ |dhi//

'gran nas mna' ma rtsod len byed pa'i goms gshes dag khyag khyog gis mtshon yod/2 skas shing be/gna' snga mo dud tshang gcig la lang tshos rgyas pa'i sman shar ngo 'bras shin tu mtshar la blo rgya che ba/ gzhung drang ba/ las 'jon stangs che ba pha ma rgan rgon la gus zhabs che zhing kha khu sim pa zhig yod pa de mna' mar slong mkhan lung pa'i phu mdo bar gsum nas 'tshang kha shig shig gis byung ba rnams 'ga' res ni rang tshang gi rgyu stobs ngoms/ 'ga' res ni rang gi bu'i skyes 'bras ngoms/ yang 'ga' res ni skyes khungs ngoms pa sogs rang nyid kyi dge mtshan re ngoms nas bu mo de slong bar yong / dus de'i tshe bu mo'i pha des 6 gal srid bu mo slong mkhan gyi bu des nga'i khyim gyi skas 'dzeg rgyu gang las grub pa shes na de lo bu mo ster ro/’ zhes kun la bshad/ yul de'i grong pa phal pa zhig gi nang pha blo rig shin tu spyang ba gcig la bu glen lkugs gcig yod/phas bu la 6 bu khyed kyis khyim tshang de la phyin te skas ka 'dzegs rjes skas mgo nas skas ka la lta tsam byos/ de nas a tsi shing 'di be red 'dug shod ces mngags bya gnang / bu glen lkugs des bu mo'i khyim nang phyin nas pa'i mngags bya ltar byas pas tshang ma ha las hon thor/ bu mo'i pha ma gnyis kyis shob shob ngang tsa a tsi bu glen lkugs 'dis skas rgyu be yin pa shes song / da de la bu mo ster rgyu red/mi ces brjod pa bu glen lkugs des go bas/ khor dga' snakā rdon po skyes/ be zer ba shing gi rigs gcig yin pa ma shes par de ni

yag po'i don la go nor theb/ de nas bu mo'i pha de bu glen lkugs de'i 'gram du yong skabs khos pha der byad mig yag po zhig bltas nas ra pā lags kyang be red mibarjod/ yang bu mo'i ma de bu glen lkugs de'i 'gram du yong skabs smyo a ma lags kyang be red ’ ces bshad/ de ltar lkugs rtags bstan nas rdzun thub rdol/ za kha nang la yod pa lces 'bud brgyab bo/ /rjo〈skas shing be 〉bya ba 'di ni 'tsho ba'i sgrung zhig yin pa dang srog chags kyisnang dang bsdur na de bas don dngos 'tsho ba'i khyad rtags mngon thub pa zhig yin/ de ltar brjod pa'ang 'tsho ba'i sgrung gi brjod bya rnams dngos su byung myong ba'i lo rgyus red ces brjod pa min la/ de bas kyang srog chags kyi sgrung lta bus don dngos 'tsho ba mtshon thub kyi med ces brjod pa min/ mi sna gtso bo de skye bo phal pas byas pa dang / rgyun gtan 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi bya bas brjod bya gtso bo byas pa'i 'tsho ba'i sgrung dag la 'tsho ba'i nyams 'gyur chen po ldan yod/ (skas shing be 〉la'ang dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i nyams 'gyur gyis phyug yod/ sgrung 'di'i snying don nam dmigs yul ni mang tshogs la 6 khram dang rdzun ma mjug ma thung miba'i gnas lugs rgyu mtshan nan bshad byas pa zhig yin rung / sgrung nang skas 'dzeg gi shing rgyu gang yin pa shes min 'gran nas bu mo'i gtan grogs 'tshol ba'i rnam pa bkod pa 'di ni don du bu mo'i gtan grogs su 'dod pa rnams rig pa'i rtsal 'gran nas bu mo rtsod len byed pa'i du gtsang pa snam dge 'khor mig tshe lagasakyisagasungs/ 39

goms gshis gsal ba zhig yin/ /2 rgya bza'arkangajo mna' mar slong skabs0 bshad rgyan/bod kyi yul gru kun la sa khyab rdo khyab tu song ba'i dmangs khrod lha mo'i 'khrab gzhung 〈rgya bza' bal bza'i rnam thar 〉zer ba zhig yod pa ni rang cag kun gyis mkhyen gsal red/ 'khrab gzhung 'di ni dmangs khrod lo rgyus bshad rgyun las brjod bya blangs pa zhig yin la bshad rgyun gyi brjod bya gtso bo ni lo rgyus thog dngos su byung myong ba'i thang bod dbar gyi mdza' mthun 'brel ba'i zam pa lta bur gyur ba'i don chen zhig red/ btsan po srong btsan sgam pos blon po mgar ba mngags te rgya bza' khab tu bsu ba'i gtso bo'i brjod bya lo rgyus rnal mar bzhag thog zhib phra'i brgyud rim rnams bod lugs dang sbyar nas sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa spyad de che ba brjod pa'i bshad rgyun 'di ni lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa'i don der dran gso zhu ched du yin/ bshad rgyun nang gsal la bod kyi blon po mgar ba rgya nag khrang an bkra shis khri sgor slebs pa'i dus rgya gar dang ge sar/ ta zig bha ta hor bcas mi rigs mi 'dra ba'i rta pa lnga brgya kong jo mna' mar slong du 'dzoms/ de'i dus yab rgyal po dang / yum btsun mo/ sras rgyal bu/ lha gcig kong jo bcas gros byas pas bod la phyogs mkhan ni gcig kyang ma byung / 'on kyang yab rgyal po'i thugs bsam la bod rgyal pos bskur ba'i bka' shog gi shog sgril gsum po de 'khor zhing thugs mi bde bar nga'i bu mo 'di 'dod mkhan mang yang mthar bod kyi rgyal po la // dgos pa 'dra bsams/ de nas rgyal pos gnya' bo blon po rnams rig

pa 'gran nas rig pa gang rno ba gcig la ster rgyu byas/ snga rjes su rig pa thengs bdun 'gran/ blon po mgar gyi khyad du 'phags pa'i blo rig gis gzhan las rnam par rgyal te gnya' bo gzhan rnams kha nang mdzub mo bcug nas bsdad dgos bzos yod/ de'i nang rta ma brgya bu brgya ma bu ngo shes pa byed rgyu dang / lug lnga brgya nyin gcig la bshas zin pa/ sha zos zin pa/pags pa mnyed zin pa byed rgyu/ chang ban brgya tham pa nyin gcig la btung zin pa/ ma bo ba/ ma bzi ba byed rgyu sogs kyi brjod bya rnams la bod rigs kyi khyad chos chen po ldan yod/ rta ma bu ngo shes byed rgyu dang / lug bsha' rgyu/pags pa mnyed rgyu sogs ni 'brog las thon skyed kyi nyams myong du nges la sha za lugs dang chang btung stangs ni nam rgyun bod pa rnams za btung gi longs spyod la 'jug skabs yid 'jog byed pa'i don du nges pa ma zad las la 'jon thang che la za shugs 'thung shugs che zhing 'ju thub mkhan la ra zas nas yong ba khyung dkar gyi mdzo pho/ las nas yong ba khyung dkar gyi mdzo pho ’ zhes bstod mngags kyang byed srol yod/ des na bod kyi spyi tshogs thog rig pa'i rtsal 'gran nas mna' ma rtsod len byed pa'i gnyen srol de yod pas dmangs khrod bshad rgyun nang du'ang gnya' bo blon po rnams rig pa 'gran pa'i brjod bya de byung ba las gzugs med grib dang me med du ba yong don med pa'i dpe ltar dngos yod 'tsho ba'i nang du med pa'i gong smos kyi gnyen sgrig lugs srol dag dmangs khrod rtsom rig nang du thon dka' ba zhig yin no/ /lugs srol ci 'dra zhig yin rung de dar ba la spyi tshogs kyi cha rkyenā /ma

rmangagazhi nges can zhig yod dgos pa ji bzhin gna' dus bod kyi spyi tshogs thog rig pa 'gran nas mna' ma rtsod len byed pa'i lugs srol dar ba de la'ang spyi tshogs kyis cha rkyen nges can bskrun yod/ lugs srol 'di rigs ni rig rtsed 'phel rgyas che ba'i mi rigs sam sa gnas la dar ba las/ rig gnas shes byar rmongs la rig rtsed byed sgo dben pa'i rjes lus can gyi mi rigs sam sa gnas la dar thabs med pa'i gnyen srol zhig yin/ mi rigs shigagam sa khul zhig la mi dmangs rnams kyis rig gnas 'tsho bar do snang dang / dmangs kyi khrod du rig rtsed byed sgo dar khyab chen po yod tshe mang tshogs kyi bya spyod gang ci'i thad de'i shugs rkyen chen po thebs nges yin/ 'o na bod mi rigs kyi lo rgyus thog byung ba'i rig pa'i rtsal 'gran nas mna' ma rtsod len byed pa'i goms gshis dar ba'i rgyu mtshan yang / bod mis khyab pa'i yul gru kun tu rig gnas dar khyab che la lo rgyus ring ba'i rig rtsed phun sum tshogs po mchis shing / phun sum tshogs pa'i rig rtsed byed sgo des mi dmangs kyi 'tsho bar ngo mtshar ba'i phan yon bskrun stabs mi dmangs kyi 'tsho bar rig rtsed kyi shugs rkyen chen po thebs pa ni sus kyang rtogs nus/ der brten rig gnas shes byar do snang byed pa dang / rig gnas shes bya dang ldan pa'i skye bo rnams la mthong chen gus bkur byed pa'i spyi tshogs kyi lta tshul zhig chags yod/dper na/ mdzangs mi bdun gyi mtshan snyan bod kyi lo rgyus thog grags che ba dang / khong tshor rjes rabs rnams kyis brtsi bkur byed pa de shes rig la mardodī chen byas pa mtshon/ yang dper na tsa pho rab gcig gi bsdad sa ru/

shog ro dang smyug ro nyil li yod/ pho 'bring gcig gi bsdad sa ru/ skud ro dang lhan ro nyil li yod/ pho tha ma gcig gi bsdad sa ru/ shig sro ma'i rgyud ro nyil li yod ces dmangs khrod du brjod srol yod pa dang / yang pho rtsal sna dgu ste 6 gtam yig rtsis gsum dang / mda' rdo mchong gsum/ bang rkyal spe gsum bcas dgu mi ru brjod srol yod pa rnams las 4 shog ro dang smyug ro nyil li yod pa ni shes bya la brtson pa tshad med byas pa'i mtshon rtags yin pa dang / 6 gtam yig rtsis gsum mi ni dmangs khrod du shes bya yon tan gyi tha snyad gzhan zhig la ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pas shes bya yon tan ni pho rtsal yin pa dang / shes bya yon tan gyis phyug pa'i skyes pa ni pho rab tu bkur gyi yod/ de ltar spyi tshogs kyi lta tshul 'di yi rmang gzhi'i thog bu mor mag pa bsu ba'am bu mo mna' mar ster skabs khyo bo der shes bya yon tan yod dgos pa'i re ba zhig thon pa ma zad/ bu mo slong mkhan gyi skyes pa rnams rig pa'i rtsal 'gran te rig pa rno ba'am yon tan che ba la bu mo mna' mar sbyin pa'i srol de dar ba yin no/ /rig pa 'gran nas mna' ma rtsod len byed pa'i gnyen srol 'di la dmangs srol kun dang 'dra bar 'gyur ba byung yod rung / chu yi 'ol ka 'gyur ba ltar gyi 'gyur ba ni yong thabs med pa cig yin/ de yang / goms srol gang dang ci yin rung dus gang 'tshams la chu yi 'ol ka 'gyur ba lta bu'i 'gyur ba 'gro mi thub par mi dmangs kyi dpal 'byor 'tsho ba dang / mi dmangs kyi bsam pa/ de bzhin spyi tshogs khor yug gi cha rkyen bcas la dīsnar

ba byung ba'i rjes de dang bstun nas rim bzhin 'gyur ba 'gro ba 'ig yin/'gyur ba de'i rnam pa ni mang bar mchis mod kyang / gtso bo ni lugs srol gzhan gyis lugs srol rnying pa'i tshab byas nas rim bzhin lugs srol rnying pa ming gi lhag mar 'gro ba dang yang na lugs srol rnying pa'i grub cha kha shas med par gyur ba/ lugs srol de la rim pas 'gyur ba 'gro ba bcas yod par snyam/ 'o na/ rig rtsal 'gran nas mna' ma rtsod len byed pa'i bod kyi gnyen srol der 'gyur ba gang 'dra zhig byung yod dam zhes na/ kho bo'i bsam par rim par 'gyur ba byung ba de 'dra zhig yin/ de yang / thog mar rig pa 'gran nas mna' ma rtsod len byed skabs 〈phug ron gyi sgrung nyidang 〈skas shing be 〉yi nang gsal ltar rig pa 'gran pa po ni bu mo mna' mar 'dod mkhan gyi pho gsar do bdag de yin dgos pa dang/ de la rim bzhin 'gyur ba byung nas rig pa 'gran pa po ni 〈rgya bza' kong jo'i bshad rgyun sminang gsal ltar bu mo slong mkhan gyi gnya' bo ste bu yi sku tshab rnams yin dgos pa/ de la'ang 'gyur ba byung nas dbus gtsang khul gyi zhing 'brog sa khul du dar khyab yod pa'i gnyen ston mdzad sgo de yin/ gnyen ston gyi mdzad sgo'i nang bu mo'i dbu la gtsug g.yu btsugs skabs dang / mna' ma bzhugs gral nas gdan 'dren skabs/ bu mo pha khyim nas thon dus sgo bkag btang skabs/ de min bu mo'i bzhon rta bcas kyi bshad pa tshang ma mna' ma bsu mkhan gyis btang dgos pa dang / mna' ma bu'i khyim gyi sgo 'gram du slebs skabs 'bab steg dngaslo / dkar tho/ nag tho/ sgo skas bcas kyi bshad pa mna' ma skyel mkhan

gyis gtong dgos pa/ ka gzhu gdung dang / 'dzugs khog gro so phye mar/khrung snod la sogs khang pa'i sgrig chas/ bu dang mna' ma/ bu'i yab yum/gnya' bo'am bar mi sogs mdzad sgo'i mi sna gtso gras rnams la bshad pa phul mkhan ni rten 'brel la phebs pa'i sku mgron rnams yin dgos pa bcas dang /gnyen ston nang khrung 'dren ma dang sku mgron phan tshun khrung bkag nas glu la rtsod srol yod pa dang / da dung bu mo'i sku tshab pa dang bu yi sku tshab rnams mchod chang ma mchod par skam thog phan tshun shags brgyab ste rig pa'i rtsal 'gran srol yod pa de yin/ de bzhin mnga' ris khul du dar ba'i phyi gnya' dang nang gnyas len pa'i gnya' glu phreng ba bstar brgyud ltar phun sum tshogs po yod pa rnams dang mtsho sngon yul gru 'gar dmangs kyi ngag rgyun du ring nas dar zhing khyab pa'i glu gzhas 〈g.yang dkar lug glu 〉zhes pa'i snyan zhing 'jibs pa rna ba'i bdud rtsi lta bu zhig yod pa de ni gtso bo bag ston gyi skabs 6 mgron pos lug snyog pa (slong ba )dang gzhi bas lug rnyed dka' ba'i tshul byas nas dri ba dris lan gyi tshul du snyan pa'i dbyangs la drangs nas ku re byed pa'i glu ’ zhig yin/ de ltar phan tshun shags 'gyed kyis dri ba dris lan byas nas rig pa 'gran pa 'di yang sngar lugs su mchis pa'i rig pa'i rtsal 'gran nas mna' ma rtsod len byed pa'i srol de las 'gyur ba byung ba'am de'i shul bzhag yin par ngos 'dzin bya mi rung ba gang yang mi 'dug snyam mo/ /rig pa bsdur nas mna' ma rtsod len byed pa tsam ma zad bod kyi sngar srol la bya spyod mang po zhig gi bden rdzun gyi spangs blangs dag rig pa/ /la

dang blo gros kyi thabs la brten nas thag gcod bya ba'i goms gshes yod/kun gyi mkhyen mus yin pa'i dpe mtshon zhig ni chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi sku dus su ston rtsen rtsod pa 'gyed du bcug nas ha shang pham par gyur te rtsen min pa'i lugs ltar bod pa rnams chos la 'jug dgos pa'i bka' stsal ba lta bu yin/

gnyis pa/ ming 'ga'i 'dogs tshul las 'phros pa'i gnyen sgrig goms srole dang 'brel ba'i 'du shes 'ga'/gcig mi'i ming gi 'dogs tshul las 'phros pa'i 'du shes/gna' rabs bod mir rus ming yod na'ang dus phyis rus ming spyod pa'i goms gshes de phal cher ming gi lhag ma tsam du gyur nas bod rigs kyi phru gu'i ming bla ma'i drung nas zhu ba'am yang na pha ma'am rgan rabs kyis phru gur ming 'dogs pa'i srol dar nas yod/ phru gur ming 'dogs skabs chos lugs kyi don dang ldan pa'i ming dang / bkra shes pa'i don mtshon pa'i ming /yang na phugs re mtshon pa'i ming dang phru gu skyes dus kyi gza' tshes mtshon pa'i ming sogs 'dogs srol yod/ de las phugs re mtshon pa'i ming 'di rigs ni pha ma'i 'dod don 'grub rgyu'i re smon la gzhigs te btags pa zhig yin pas/ de'i thog nas pha ma'i re 'dod dam 'du shes de yongs su mngon thub kyi yod/ de yang dper na/ mtshams gcod dang / chog pa/ chung bdag lta bu ni pho mo gnyis gar 'jug cing skye mtshams 'jog 'dod mtshon pa'i ming yin pa dang / bu khrid dang / bung chog gsum chog bzhi chog lnga chog lta bu ni bu mo mi skye ba'i re 'dod mtshon pa'i bu mo'i ming yin pa/ bu chog )nga /

lnga chung / bu drug bu bdun zer ba rnams skye mtshams 'jog 'dod mtshon pa'i bu'i ming yin/ ming de dag 'dogs dgos don gyi rgyu mtshan gsal po yong ched 'dir dbus gtsang gnyis las yul tshan re re zur 'then gyis mi'i ming de rigs la dbye zhib rags tsam byed rgyu yin/dbus khul lha sa grong khyer mal gro gong dkar rdzong rgya ma khul du skye mtshams 'jog 'dod mtshon pa'i mi'i ming gtso bo mtshams gcod/ mtshams/bu chung bcas 'dogs srol yod pa dang / spyi lo 2005lor nga tshos khul der brtag zhib byed skabs shang yongs la dud tshang 15'azur 'then gyis de rnams kyi bu phrug gi nang gong gsal ming de rigs thogs pa bsdoms mi grangs 12yod pa dang / de'i nang bu gsum dang bu mo bcu yod pa dang / de dag las gcen gcung gi khrod du ang rim bzhi pa bzung ba mi gsum dang / ang rim lnga pa bzung ba mi bzhi/ ang rim drug pa bzung ba mi gcig yang rim bdun pa bzung ba mi gsum/ ang rim brgyad pa bzung ba mi gnyis bcas yod pa shes rtogs byung / de rnams kyi zhib phra'i gnas tshul ni gsham gsal re'u mig ltar /48

gtsang khul pa snam rdzong bkra shar shang dge 'khor rdzong grong tshor 2006lor spyi tshogs brtag zhib byed skabs shes rtogs byung bar/ grong tsho der dud tshang 42la mi grangs 240yod pa'i nang bud med 162yod pa dang skyes pa 17/yod/ skye mtshams 'jog 'dod mtshon pa'i ming btags pa bsdoms mi grangs 85yod pa'i nang bud med 〈'dang bu 5las med/bud med rnams las ming du bu khrid thogs pa 27dang / chog pa thogs pa 1ramatshams gcod thogs pa 7 bung chog thogs pa ji gsum chog thogs pa 4chung bdag thogs pa / bung chung thogs pa 2bcas dang / bu rnams las chog pa thogs pa 2dang bu chung thogs pa 2yod/de dag las nga tshos gsal por rtogs thub pa ni phru gu bu skyes na dga' ba dang / bu mo skyes na dman par brtsi ba'i 'du shes mngon gsal yin/lhag par gtsang khul gyi mi'i ming las bza' tsho'i phru gu rgan 'go de bu mo yin na de'i ming zur la bu khrid ces btags mkhan mang ba dang / des rjes su bu zhig khrid yong na snyam pa ste bu zhig skye ba'i re smon gsal por mtshon yod/gong gsal ming du bu khrid thogs pa'i bu mo 27las spun mched khrod rgan 'go bzung ba 22yod pa dang / khul der da dung bza' tshor phru gu rgan 'go bu skyes na de'i ming zur du dgos pa de skyes byung zer ba'i don mtshon chen du dgos skyes zhes 'dogs mkhan yang mi nyung ba zhig yod pa des gong gsal gyi 'du shes de de bas gsal por mngon thub/ gsham du nga tshos don de gsal po /sdu yong ched dge 'khor rdzong grong tsho'i dud tshang 'ga'i zhib phra'i gnas

tshul dpe mtshon du drangs rgyu la/ dud tshang ang 1ste rgya bod tshang ni sngar khul de'i rgya 'ung tshang zer ba bod 'brog gnyis su kha gyes pa las byung ba dang /khul de'i grong pa rnying gras shig yin/ dud tshang de'i rmo bo lags kyi mtshan la rdo rje bu khrid zer ba dang / khong ni phu grong tsho'i skyid lo tshang nas dus rabs gong ma'i lo rabs drug cu'i nang rgya bod tshang gi tshe ring sogs bu spun gsum gyi mna' mar slebs pa red/ khong gi ma tshang du pha gcig spun phrug gsum yod pa las rang nyid rgan 'go de yin pa dang / gzhan gnyis gcung po yin pas mtshan la bstan 'dzin don grub dang dbang rgyal zhes btags yod/ rdo rje bu khrid rgya bod tshang du slebs rjes bsdoms bu phrug bdun skyes pa las rgan pa gsum ni bu yin pa dang / de tsho'i ming la spen pa rgyal po dang / bstan 'dzin/ rig 'dzin bcas btags yod pa dang / bzhi pa dang lnga pa gnyis bu mo yin pas ming du phur bu chog pa dang mtshams chung zhes btags pa/drug pa de bu yin pas ming la ngag dbang btags pa/ bdun pa de bu mo yin pas ming du lhag pa chung bdag ces btags nas yod/ yang dud tshang de'i bu bzhi la dus rabs gong ma'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i nang grong tsho de rang gi dud tshang ang 4pa ste pha shar tshang gi bu mo sgrol ma chog pa mna' mar slebs pa dang / khong la phru gu bzhi skyes pa las dang po de bu mo yin pas ming du bkra shes bu khrid btags pa dang / gnyis pa de bu yin pas ming du rin chen dbang 'dus zhes btags pa/ gsum pa dang bzhi pa gnyis bu mo yin pas sri thar dang bde skyid lha mo zhes ming du btags nas yod/ sgrol ma chog ༵ snang

dud tshang 4pa'i nang phru gu bdun nang gi ang lnga pa de yin pa dang / khong gi gcen po rgan 'go de'i ming la pa rdor zhes btags pa dang / gnyis pa dang gsum pa gnyis gcen mo yin pas ming du bu khrid dang bung chog ces btags nas yod/ yang dper na dud tshang ang 20ste longs spyod tshang la mtshon na/dud tshang de ni sngar gyi khul de'i dud tshang che shos a zhang tshang nas gyes pa zhig yin pa dang / dud tshang de'i da lta'i ma yi mtshan la nyi ma chog pa zer ba dang /khong la phru gu bu gnyis dang bu mo gsum byung ba'i nang rgan 'go dang gnyis pa de bu mo yin pas ming du mig dmar bu khrid dang spen pa bu khrid ces btags yod pa dang / gsum pa de bu yin pas dgra 'dul zer ba/ bzhi pa de bu mo yin pas gsum chog ces btags pa/ lnga pa de bu yin pas pa sangs zhes btags nas yod/ yang dud tshang ang 42ste rgya zur tshang la mtshon na/ dud tshang de ni sngar gyi rgya zhung tshang zer ba las gyar ba'i dud tshang zhig yin pa dang /de'i spo bo'i mi rabs la gcen gcung bzhi yod pa las rgan 'go de bu yin pas mtshan la nyi ma dgos skyes zer ba dang / gnyis pa de yang bu yin pas mtshan la blo bzang btags/ gsum pa de bu mo yin pas mtshan la nyi ma bu khrid du btags/ bzhi pa de pha ma'i re 'dun ltar bu zhig skyes pas mtshan la don grub ces btags nas yod/ gong gi gcen gcung bu spun gsum po la dus rabs gong ma'i lo rabs lnga bcu'i nang sa skya rdzong khongs nas mna' ma zhig mnyam bsu byas/ der phru gu lnga byung ba'i rgan 'go de res gza' pa sa~X la skyes pa dang bu zhig yin pas ming la pa sangs dgos skyes su btags/

rgan 'og de'ang re gza' spen par skyes pa dang bu zhig yin pas de'i ming la spen pa rdo rje zhes btags/ gsum pa de bu mo zhig skyes pas de'i ming la sgrol ma chog pa zhes btags/ bzhi pa de bu zhig yin pas sri thar tshe ring zhes btags/ lnga pa de bu mo yin khar gza' spen pa la skyes pas ming la spen pa bu khrid ces btags/ des pha ma'i re 'dod ltar bu zhig khrid yong bas phru gu drug pa de'i ming la phur bu chog tshe btags/ bu rgan pa gnyis la dus rabs gong ma'i lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang slar yang sa skya rdzong khongs nas mna' ma zhig mnyam bsu byas/ der phru gu bdun byung ba'i rgan 'go de re gza' spen pa la skyes pa dang bu mo zhig yin pas ming la spen pa bu khrid du btags/ rgan 'og de'ang bu mo zhig yin pas de'i ming la bung chog ces btags/ gsum pa de gzhi nas bu zhig skyes pas de'i ming la spen pa dgos skyes su btags/bzhi pa de slar bu mo zhig skyes pas ming la spen pa mtshams gcod du btags/lnga pa de bu zhig skyes pas ming la dgra 'dul zhes btags/ drug pa de bu mo zhig skyes pas de yi ming la bzhi chog ces btags/ bdun pa de bu zhig skyes pas ming la bu chung zhes btags nas yod/(gong gsal dud tshang de tsho'i khyim rgyud dam spun mched kyi 'phel stangs ri mo dang zhib phra'i mi'i ming rnams rgyab kyi shog grangs 63nas 66bar zur du gsal ba ltar ro/)gong gsal depe mtshon de rnams kyi nang skye mtshams 'jog 'dod mtshon pa'i pho mo'i ming gi 'dogs stangs la bltas na/ khyo shug gi phru gu rgan 'go de bu mo skyes na ming du bu khrid btags mkhan shad che bas/ des rjes sor 5tā gu

bu zhig skyes na bsam pa'i phugs re mtshon par byas pa dang / bu mo gnyis tsam skyes na gnyis pa de'i ming la bung chog ces btags nas rjes sor bu mo mi skye ba'i re 'dun mtshon par byas pa dang / bu mo gsum mam bzhi'am lnga skyes na de tsho'i ming du rim pa bzhin gsum chog dang / bzhi chog lnga chog zer ba dang mtshams gcod sogs 'dogs mkhan mang bas/ de dag gi thog nas bu mo mang po dgos pa med pa'i bsam 'dun mngon yong gi yod/ de bzhin gong du drangs pa'i rgya zur tshang ltar rgan 'go de bu zhig skyes pa'am bu mo re gnyis skyes pa'i rjes su bu zhig skyes na pha mar dgos pa de skyes byung bas dgos skyes sam don grub ces ming du btags mkhan yang mi nyung ba zhig yod pa dang / bu skyes pa la skye sgo bkag 'dod mtshon pa'i ming btags pa ha cang nyung la/ de lta'i ming btags pa rnams kyang khyo shug gnyis la phru gu bu bzhi yan skyes na/ gzhi nas nyung shas kyis bu chung dang / chog pa/ lnga chung / bu drug gam bu chog ces 'dogs srolta yod/gnyis/ byi drug gi 'bod tshul 'ga' las 'phros pa'i 'du shes/bod ljongs dbus gtsang khul du byi phug gi snang tshul cung mang tsam yod pa dang / mi rnams kyis byi phrug la mthong chung byed pa'i goms gshes mngon gsal med la byi phrug dor ba'i snang tshul ni de bas mthong rgyu med/ spyir byi phruX ༵ khyim tshang nang phru gu gzhan dang 'dra ba'i thob thang dang go bab yod

na'ang byi phug byung ba'i rjes de'i ma yi gnyen sgrig gi don chen la gnod skyon phog pa ma zad byi phrug de rang gi mdun lam la'ang shugs rkyen ngan pa zhig thebs kyi yod/spyir bod khyon yongs su gnyen sgrig ma byas gong pho mo 'gab mthun byas nas skyes pa'i phru gu la byi phrug dang / nal le/ nal bu bcas su 'bod srol yod/ da lam kho bos spyi tshogs brtag dpyad byed yul dbus kyi rgya ma shang dang gtsang gi pa snam rdzong dge 'khor rdzong grong tsho ste dbus gtsang gi sa khul gnyis la byi phug gi ming du rtol le'am rtol gog dang rtol po rtol mo zhes 'bod srol yod/ rtol zer ba ni rgyud 'dres sdeb sbyor byas nas skyes pa'i phyugs zog gi rigs shig yin zhing / de'i ma mdzo mo yin pa dang pha ni glang ngam g.yag yin/ rtol gyi ma ste mdzo la mtshon na'ang / de ni glang dang 'bri'am/ g.yag dang ba mo bsdebs pa las skyes pa'i phyugs zog cig yin la/glang dang 'bri bsdebs pa las skyes pa la 'bri mdzo dang / g.yag dang ba mo bsdebs pa las skyes pa la ba mdzo zhes 'bod srol yod/ mdzo pho la skye 'phel gyi nus pa med stabs mdzo mo dang g.ya/ gam glang sdeb sbyor byed kyi yod/mdzo mo dang g.yag sdeb sbyor byas pa las skyes pa la bzang rtol dang / glang dang sdeb sbyor byas pa las byung ba la ngan rtol du 'bod srol yod/ don du byi phrug gi 'bod srol snolas mang tshogs kyis byi phrug ni lugs mthun gyis pho mo 'dus pa las skyes pa zhig yin par mi brtsi la/ der lkog tu mthong chung dang ngan smras byed kyi yod pa'ang mtshon thub/ lhag par byi phrug byung ba'i buX byed
