dang / byi phug do bdag gi dngos yod 'tsho ba'i nang 'phrad pa'i dka' ngal mang po zhig gi thog nas kyang pho mo 'gab mthun dang byi phrug gi gnad don la 'dzin pa'i 'du shes de gsal po rtogs nges yin/rgya ma shang du spyi tshogs brtag dpyad byed ring nga tshos khul de'i dud tshang lnga brgya lhag tsam yod pa'i nang ma dang bu mos khyo bo gcig mnyam du spyod mkhan dud tshang gcig rang yod pa shes rtogs byung / nga tshos dud tshang ang 149de dang / de de ltar gyi tshul min spyod la 'jug pa'i zhib phra'i gnas tshul la brtag 'ib byed skabs/ de ni mi rabs gnyis byi phrug mnga' ba'i dbul zhing phongs pa'i dud tshang zhig yin pa shes rtogs byung / nga tshos bcar 'dri zhu yul ni dgung lo 42la phebs pa'i dud tshang de'i ma ga ge mo yin/khong gis nga tshor ngo sprod gnang bar/ ga ge mo'i ma de dgung lo 22skabs chang sa ma brgyab bzhin du ga ge mo skyes/ de rjes lo bcu gnyis tsam ma smad gnyis kher du 'tsho la skyal nas bsdad/ ga ge mo lo bcu gnyis skabs khong gi ma dang ma de rang las lo bcu yis chung ba'i pho reng du gyar ba'i bu che ge mo 'tsho ba mnyam skyel byas/ khong gnyis la bu zhig skyes/ de rjes ga ge mo mo lo 21nas che ge mo dang lus 'brel byung bas snga rjes su phru gu bzhi skyes/ da lta dud tshang der bsdoms mi grangs brgyad yod/ nga tshos ga ge mor khyed gnyis chang sa ga dus brgyab pa yin nam zhes 'dri skabs/ nga tsho chang sa brgyab med ces lan skyon byung / nga tshos khul de'i bgres song zhis la de dang 'brel yod kyi /spyad don bka' 'dri zhus rjes shes rtogs byung bar/ ga ge mo'i pha de'ang

byi phrug yin pa ma zad/ der gcen gcung gzhan gsum yod pa'ang tshang ma pha mi 'dra ba'i byi phrug sha stag yin/ ga ge mo'i pha de bshan pa'i rgyud pa yin pas ga ge mo'ang khul der rigs dman par brtsi yi yod pas/ skyid po la nyis brtsegs med pa'i sdug po la gsum brtsegs kyi dpe ltar ga ge mo lang tshos dar yang mna' mar bsu mkhan med la mag par yong mkhan yang med pas thabs zad ma yi zla bo dang mnyam sdod byas/ khyim tshang gi 'tsho ba da dung mu mthud dbul phongs kyi gnas las mi thar bas/ che ge mos khul der gzhan gyis btsog lta mthong chung byed pa'i rtogs ldan gyi las la 'jug bzhin yod/(dud tshang de'i gnyen gyi 'brel ba'i ri mo rgyab tu shog ngos 67la gsal/)nga tshos rgya ma khul gyi dud tshang yang 162dang / 164 176177bcas dud tshang bzhi'i gnyen gyi 'brel ba dang de tsho'i nang byung ba'i byi phrug gi skor la gzhigs pa byed skabs gnas tshul ya mtshan can de ltar shes rtogs byung ste/ dud tshang ang 177tshang gi ma ga ge mo'i a ma de mi tshe hril por gnyen sgrig byed myong med na'ang snga rjes su phru gu gnyis skye myong yod/ de yang khong dgung lo 25la son skabs grong tsho de rang gi skye pa zhig dang 'brel ba byung nas ga ge mo de skyes pa dang / lo gnyis song ba'i rjes su ga ge mo'i pha des bu mo gzhan zhig mna' mar bsus nas dud tshang ang 164de grub/ ga ge mo'i ma de mna' mar bsu mkhan med la der mag pa'ang len ma thub par dus yun lo bcu gnyis tsam lus/ khong dgung lo 27la son skabs slar yang grong tsho de'i skyes pa gzhan zhig dang tshul min 'brel ba byung bas ga ge sdi/ pha

mi gcig pa'i gcung po zhig byung / 'on kyang bu de'i pha yang khong gi zla bo ngo mar ma gyur/ ga ge mo nar son rjes des kyang ma yi sngar song gi lam la zhugs/ga ge mo lo 2 2skabs la phyi phyogs kyi skye pa zhig dang tshul min 'brel ba byung ba ma zad phru gu bu zhig byung / de rjes lo ngo bcu bzhi'i nang khong dang gnyen sgrig byed mkhan ma byung / ga ge mo lo 27la son skabs khong rang las lo bcu gnyis kyis chung ba'i bu zhig dang gnyen sgrig byas nas gzhis gsar bzung bas da gzod dud tshang 177de grub/ de'i bu mo de ma yi gam du bzhag pas ma tshang ste dud tshang ang 176de grub pa yin/ dud tshang de ni tshe gang gnyen sgrig byed myong med pa'i phru gu gnyis kyi ma rgan de dang / pha med pa'i phru gu gnyis te mi rabs gsum las grub pa'i cha mi tshang ba'i dud tshang zhig yin/ga ge mo'i gcung po'i pha de'ang byi phrug yod pa'i bud med che ge mo dang gnyen sgrig byas nas dud tshang 162de chags/ che ge mo la snga rjes su phru gu gnyis skye myong / rgan 'go de che ge mo lo 22skabs byung ba'i byi phrug zhig yin pa dang /che ge mo mo lo 44la son skabs ga ge mo'i pha dang mnyam 'du byas pa las phru gu gnyis pa de skyes pa'o/ / (dud tshang bzhi po'i gnyen gyi 'brel ba'i ri mo rgyab tu shog ngos 67la gsal/)yang nga tshos gtsang khul rdzong grong tsho'i dud tshang ang 44ste ltag gsar tshang gi gnas tshu lam tsam ngo sprod zhus na/ dud tshang de ni lo gsum gyi sngon du chags pa'i thab gsar gzhis gsar zhig yin pa dang / 'di lo mo lo 45la ma~X pa'i dud tshang de'i ma phan thogs ni dud tshang yang 9pa yi bu mo zhig

yin/ phan thogs kyi ma grong mkhan de ni sngar khul de'i phu grong tsho'i phyug bdag zhig gi bu zhig gis sa khul gzhan gyi bud med zhig la bzos pa'i rtol mo yin pa dang / rtol mo'i pha tshang gi cha rkyen bzang bas de pha tshang du nyar/rtol mo de lo 20la son skabs khul de'i bu zhig dang tshul min 'brel ba byung nas de la yang rtol mo zhig byung ba de ni da gzod kyi phan thogs zhes pa de yin//phan thogs mo lo 2la son skabs de'i ma de rdzong grong tsho'i dud tshang ang 9pa'i ma shi shul du pha'i mna' mar slebs nas phru gu gsum gyi ma yar du gyur/ phan thogs kyang dud tshang ang 9pa der mnyam du khrid yong / dud tshang der phan thogs la pha mi gcig pa'i gcung po gnyis byung / phan thogs mo lo sum cu'i skabs su dud tshang yang 25tshang gi bu zhig gi rtol mo zhig byung ba dang / lo lnga yi rjes su slar yang dud tshang yang 24tshang gi bu zhig dang tshul min 'brel ba byung nas bu mo zhig skyes/ de rjes bu mo de'i pha yis dud tshang 24tshang la phan thogs mna' mar len rgyu'i re ba ston yang dud tshang de'i ma yis mos mthun ma gnang / de nas lo gcig tsam nas bu mo gnyis pa'i pha dang 'dod pa gcig tu sgril nas thab gsar pa zhig bzung bas da lta'i dud tshang 'di chags pa dang der bu zhig skyes/ des na phan thogs rang nyid byi phrug yin pa ma zad/ de'i ma de'ang byi phrug yin pa dang / da dung der snga rjes su byi phrug bu mo gnyis kyang byung yod pas don du khong gi mi rabs gsum gyi skyes khungs ni byi phrug yin la/ma smad mi rabs gnyis kyi dus su dbul po'i gnas las thar thub med/(phan thogs gi gnyen gyi 'brel ba'i 'phel tshul ri mo mjug tu thog ngos 68la ga~X ba

ltar/)rgya bod tshang gi gnyenagyi 'brelaba'i 'phelatshulari mo/〉sgo —1——rjo/ —8 thosgo ( 4 ① go duwa wa — / — /8tho nga59 ngadu 2 ) ྈྈ//8 30 7 10 2 40 36 40phrug rgan gzhon rimabaltar gyi ming gshamagasalaltar/1 spen pa rgyal po/ tshi bstan 'dzin/ 3 rig 'dzin/4 phur bu chog pa/ co mtshams chung / bla ngag dbang /7 lhag pa chung bdag1 bkra shis bu khrid/ 2 rin chen dbang 'dus/ 2 sri thar/4 bde skyid lha mo/60

dud tshang yang 149yoganyen gyi 'brelaba'i 'phelatshul ri mo/ci bye ———sku/ ——— /)chosari zhe (7)4chabemarsha gci ci / ——ridu//༷/)ri ru ri ri/ () kyi () 7— —/)spo yo du dzwa ri/ri ri ()chi sne tsho tsho /ci riril( ri4)tsho ༷ tsho tsho ri ————tsho 1(24 177 172 163dud tshang ang 162dang / 164 176 177bcasakyi gnyen gyi 'brelaba'i 'phelatshulari mo/phan thogasatshang gi gnyen gyi 'brelaba'i 'phelatshulari mo/84 sa /lkunu sa/pa na thogs/nuganyen gyi 'bre/ba'i 'phe/tshulari monang gsalaba'i rtagasakyisamatshon tshul/0bu mo/ ༷tshe las 'das pa'i bu mo/nubu/ 8tshe las 'das pa'i bu/rdeganyen sgrig tshul min 'brel ba/—༷/ phrug /khrag rgyud 'brel ba/

gsum pa/ phyogs lhung lta ba gnyis kyi mtha' dpyod/gcig gleng gzhi/mig snga'i rig gzhung las rigs kyi khrod du bod kyi gnyen srol skor la 'gal zlar gyur pa'i lta ba gnyis chags yod/ 'ga' zhig gis bod kyi spyi tshogs khrod kyi mig gis mthong tshad dang rna bas thos tshad kyi pho mo'i 'brel ba tshang ma bod rigs kyi gnyen srol yin par brjod kyi yod pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis bod du khyo gcig shug gcig gi gnyen srol kho na las gzhan med ces brjod kyi yod/ de lta bu'i kha gtad du langs pa'i lta ba rigs gnyis yod don ci lags zhe na/ rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni gcig mthun gyi rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi mdzub khrid med pas lan pa yin/ gnyen srol ni dmangs srol gyi grub cha gtso bo zhig yin pas der zhib 'jug byed dgos na nges par du dang thog dmangs srol rig pa'i gzhung lugs la brten dgos pa dang / yang sgos gleng gzhi bod kyi gnyen srol yin na bod kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba dngos la zab 'dzul gyis brtag dpyad byed rgyu ni rmang gzhi'i cha rkyen yin/ byas tsang gleng gzhi dngos ma bshad gong du nga tshos dmangs srol gyi khyad chos 'ga' ༷/ la

ngos 'dzin yang dag cig byed dgos nges 'dug spyir mang tshogs kyi khrod du —dar khyab yod la rgyun 'dzin gyi rang bzhin ldan pa dang / mang tshogs kyis khas len brtsi srung byed pa'i bya spyod dang bsam pa'i 'khyer bzo mtha' dag dmangasasrol yin zhing / der lo rgyus kyi rang bzhin dang / sa khul gyi rang bzhin/ rgyun 'dzin gyi rang bzhin/ gzhan 'gyur gyi rang bzhin sogs kyi khyad chos ldan yod/ mi rigs gang 'dra zhig yin rung der rang rang gi khyad chos ldan pa'i dmangs srol du ma yod la de rnams pha tsha bu rgyud kyis rgyun 'dzin byed kyi yod mod/ 'on kyang 6 bla ma re la chos lugs re/ lung pa re la cha lugs re mi zhes pa'i dpe ltar mi rigs gcig rang gi khrod du'ang sa khul so so'i thon skyed dang / 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen/ rang byung khor yug cha rkyen sogs mi 'dra ba'i rkyen gyis dmangs srol sne rigs gcig gi nang du'ang zhib phra'i snang tshul gcig mthun min pa mang po yod/ der brten nga chos do snang byed dgos pa zhig la/ gcig nas mi re gnyis kyi steng du byung ba'i tshul min bya spyod mig gis mthong rgyu yod la rna bas thos rgyu yod pa rnams mi rigs shig gam sa khul zhig gi dmangs srol la sbyar na mi 'thad la/ gnyis nas mi rigs gcig gi khrod du sa khul 'ga' zhig gi mang tshogs kyis khas len brtsi srung byed pa dang sa khul la lar dar med pa'i dmangs srol rnams mi rigs de'i dmangs srol min zhes brjod na'ang mi 'thad/ lta ba sngon ma mi 'thad pa'i rgyu mtshan ni dmangasasrol gyi tha snyad la ngos 'dzin ma thub par dmangs srol dang bya spyod gnyi6sdu gzhi gcig la sbyar nas bshad pas mjug 'bras 'chal gtam las

thon rgyu gzhan ci/ bya spyod la lugs mthun dang tshul min rigs gnyis su dbye rgyu yod pa las lugs mthun gyi bya spyod yin na mang tshogs kyis khas len brtse srung byed la de ni dmangs srol gyi khongs su gtogs pa dang / tshul min gyi bya spyod rnams la dmangs kyi skyon 'dzugs dang 'phya smod byed kyi yod pas de dmangs srol gyi 'gal zlar 'gyur ba red/ lta ba rjes ma mi 'thad pa'i rgyu mtshan ni mi rigs gang 'dra zhig yin rung de'i sa khul so so'i dmangs srol rnamasaspyir che sar 'dra la chung sar khyad par yod pa mang rung / mi rigs shig gnas sdod kyi sa rgya che la kha gram nas gnas pa'i mi rigs dang / mi 'bor mang ba'i mi rigs kyi khrod du sa khul so sor thun mong min pa'i dmangs srol du ma dar nas yod pa spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos kyis ra sprod byung / des na mi rigs shig gnas sdod bya yul las gzhi rgya che tsam gyi sa khul lam mi rigs de'i grangs 'bor gang 'tsham zhig gi mang tshogs khrod du dar khyab yod pa'i dmangs srol yin na mi rigs de'i dmangs srol du ngos 'dzin byas chog pa yin no/ /gzhan yang nga tsho'i gleng gzhi gnyen srol yin na sngon du gnyen ston gyi don snying ngam nus pa la go ba yang dag lon rgyu ni gleng gzhi dngos dang 'brel che/ gnyen sgrig gi bya ba ni mi tshe'i don chen zhig yin pas pho mo gzhon nu gnyis gnyen sgrig byas par bkra shis brten 'brel zhu ched gnyen ston gyi byed sgo spel ba dang / gnyen sgrig dga' ston gyi mdzad sgo spel ba'i dngos yod kyi nus pa ni pho mo gnyen sgrig mkhan gnyis kyi pho mo'i 'brel ba de lugs sdushān

yin pa spyi tshogs la gsal bsgrags byas pa zhig yin la/ de nas bzung pho mo de gnyis khyim thab yin par spyi tshogs kyis khas len byed kyi yod/ khrims srol 'thus tshang min pa'i rgyal khab dang / mi rigs kyi khrod du gnyen ston gyis gnyen sgrig lag khyer gyi nus pa thon gyi yod/ de ltar gleng gzhi dngos dang 'brel yod kyi gzhung lugs zhor du zur bshad zin mtshams gleng gzhi dngos brjod rgyu la/ mi re gnyis steng lhag pa'i tshul min gyi bya spyod bod kyi gnyen srol min pa'i skor dang / phu nus mna' ma gcig spyod byed pa dar khyab che chung dang bzang ngan la ma bltos par bod kyi gnyen srol yin tshul skor/ bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu'i gnyen srol dar gnas thub pa'i rgyu mtshan/ bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu'i gnyen srol skor gyi nor 'khrul gyi lta ba dgag pa bcas dum mtshams bzhi ru dbye ste brjod par bya rgyu yin/gnyis/ tshul min bya spyod gnyen srol du brjod pa'i nor 'khrul gyi lta ba dgag pa/de yang / da phan rgyal khab gzhan dang mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gzhung las rigs khrod dang / rang rigs kyi skye bo mi nyung ba zhig gis kyang lkugs pa'i u tshugs dang 'ol tshod zung du byas te bod kyi gnyen srol nang gdod ma'i khyu ༵༵sa gnyen sgrig gi lhag 'phro pha bus mna' ma thun mong du spyod pa'am ma

dang bu mos mag pa thun mong du spyod pa/ grogs pos (grogs mos )mna' ma (mag pa )thun mong du spyod pa/ 'brel med rgyus med kyi khyo bo gnyis kyis mna' ma thun mong du spyod pa sogs kyi lugs srol yod ces mi shes shes mdog dang mi rig rig mdog gis blun gtam bab col spyi tshogs thog 'ur gyis bsgrags pa ni khyi ngan zhogs rgyug dang / ri bong cal 'drogs kyi brtul zhugs 'dzin pa tsam las dmangs srol rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi thog nas nan tan gyis brtag dpyad dang zhib 'jug byas pa zhig ga nas yin/ gsham du kho bos dmangasasrol rig pa'i gzhung lugs dang don dngos gshib sdur gyis dgag bzhag sun phyung byed rgyu la/khong tshos brjod pa'i pha bus mna' ma mnyam spyod byed pa'i gnyen srol la rnam pa gnyis yod de/ bu'i a ma shi song ba'i rjes bu de la mna' ma blangs rjes a phas bu'i mna' ma dang pho mo'i 'brel ba byas pa dang / rnam pa gzhan zhig ni bu'i a ma shi ba'i rjes bu des ma yar dang pho mo'i 'brel ba byas pa de red/ a phas bu'i mna' ma dang log g.yem byas pa dang / bu yis ma yar dang 'dod log byed pa'i bya ngan spyod ngan gyi rigs bod rigs 'tsho ba'i spyi tshogs na srid pa yin/ 'on kyang de bod kyi gnyen srol yin zhes brjod na/de ni dmangs srol gyi mtshan nyid las yongs su 'gal ba zhig yin/ bye brag dmigs bsal can gyi bya spyod 'ga' re yod nges pa de dag mi rigs gcig gam sa khul gcig gi dmangs srol yin zhes brjod na ni shin tu mi 'thad de/dper na/ 'dod rngam can gyi skye bo 'ga' zhig gis gzhan la gser tāḥl

sogs rin chen yod pa rig nas 'dod pa'i dbang gis gzhan gyi tshe srog 'phrogs te gser dngul rnams rku bcom byed pa'i spyod ngan 'dzam gling sa phyogs gang sa dang mi rigs tshang ma'i khrod du mthong rgyu yod la thos rgyu yod/de rgyu mtshan du byas nas sa khul ga ge mo dang / mi rigs che ge mo'i khrod du mi yis mi gsod pa'i dmangs srol yod ces brjod na mtshan nyid dang 'gal ba de bzhin a pha'i 'dod chags kyis bu yi mna' ma bdag gir spyod pa'i ma rung byustod de bod rigs kyi gnyen srol yin zhes brjod na/ de ni yin min gyi dbye 'byed ma btang bar dgos pa'i dbang du brjod pa zhig yin par snyam/pha bus mna' ma mnyam spyod byas pa de bod rigs kyi gnyen srol min pa lung rigs gnyis kyi sgo nas sgrub thub/ dang po/ mna' ma bsu skabs kyi gnyen ston mdzad sgo de'i thog nas bshad na/ gnyen ston skabs bu yi pha la bu 'di pa'i pha yi go gnas thob thang las/ gnyen sgrig mkhan bza' tsho gsar pa'i go gnas thob thang med pa ma zad/ gnyen ston thog pha de'i bya spyod dmigs bsal che ba med par bu dang mna' ma gtso bor 'dzin pa'i byed sgo zhig yin/de yang / dbus gtsang khul gyi gna' bo'i gnyen ston gyi srol la/ bu zhig la mna' ma bsu skabs thog mar bu dang bu mo'i lo rtags mthun min brtag dgos pa las bu'i pha dang mna' ma'i lo rtags mthun min brtag srol med pa dang gcig gnyen ston skabs bzhugs gral thog gral 'gor bu/ de rjes mna' ma/ de'i 'og bu yi pha ma/ de'i 'og bu mo skyel mi sdod pa sogs rim pa bas/ gral star ru sgrig srol yod pa'i nang / bu yi pha de bu 'di pa'i pha yin

pas bzhugs gral mna' ma'i gsham 'og tu 'khod pa las/ mna' ma'i khyo bo ya gyal gcig yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis bzhugs gral du 'khod pa rtsa ba nas min pa dang gnyis/ bzhugs gral la bshad pa phul mkhan gyis bshad pa phul skabs bu yi pha der bu yi pha yin pa'i bshad pa phul ba dang / sku tshe ring po yong ba'i smon tshig zhu ba las/ khyo bo yin pa dang mna' ma dang gnyen sdeb pa las bu nor longs spyod 'phel ba'i bkra shis bshad pa phul srol med pa dang gsum/ lhag don mna' ma bsu ba'i gnyen ston skabs bag nyal la bu de nyal ba las/ mna' ma de pha bu spyi pa'i yin zhes pha de'ang mna' ma dang mnyam du bag nyal la 'jug srol med pa dang bzhi/ gzhan yang pha bus mna' ma mnyam spyod byas nas sa bon btab pa'i 'bras bu bu phrug smin pa des bu'i pha de la spo bo zhes 'bod pa las a pha zhes 'bod srol med pa dang lnga bcas rgyu mtshan de rnams las pha bus mna' ma mnyam spyod byed pa de bod kyi gnyen srol min pa gsal por shes thub/pha bus mna' ma mnyam spyod byed pa'i rnam pa gzhan zhig la pha yi bza' zlas 'jig rten 'di ru bu zhig bor bzhag nas 'jig rten phyi mar byon pa'i khyim tshang ches nyung shas nang / pha des bza' zla gong ma'i shul 'dzin mna' mgasar du bsus nas khyo shug tu sdeb pa'i skabs bza' zla gong mas bzhag pa'i bu de'ang rim bzhin cher bskyed nas 'jig rten gyi bya bar 'jug mtshams khyim gyi dpal 'byor dang / bde skyid kyi 'tsho bar nyams rgyad dang bar chad mi yong ba'i ched du bu des kyang pha yi mna' ma mnyam spyod lha/ pa

yin/ de ni bod rigs kyi lugs dang mthun pa'i gnyen srol ye nas min par khyim tshang ches nyung shas dang mi re gnyis kyi thabs zad 'u thug gi bya spyod cig yin/ gal srid bu des rang 'dod kyis bu mo gzhan dang gnyen bsdebs nas khyo shug gi 'tsho ba khor skyel byas tshe khyim tshang de'i khang steng gi rlung dar nas sgo yi them pa yan chad kyi nor dngos po yod tshad dum bu gnyis su bgo dgos kyi yod pas 6 grong pa kha gyes na slong mkhan cha gcig ces pa'i gtam dpe ltar dpal 'byor la nyams rgud yong ba dang / lhag par du bu de rang la mna' ma gzhan zhig bsus na gcig tu khyim tshang gcig gi nang pha dang bu/ pha yi bza' zla/ bu la bsus pa'i mna' ma bcas sha rus kyi 'brel ba med pa'i phyogs kha gsum chags kyi yod pa dang / gnyis su pha dang bza' zla rjes mar rjes skyes bu tsha byung ba de tsho la'ang slad mar mna' ma bsu ran mtshams mna' ma de'ang khyim tshang de'i nang gi mi dang sha rus kyi 'brel ba med pa zhig bsu dgos pas de ltar sha nus kyi 'brel ba med pa'i mi mang po thab gcig la 'khor nas zla ba nas zla ba dang lo nas lo bar 'tsho ba mnyam skyel byas tshe khyim gyi bde skyid 'tsho ba la bar chad yong nges yin pa ni sus kyang rtogs nus/ rgyu mtshan de rnams la brten nas khyim tshang nyung shas dang mi re gnyis kyis 6 sdug na ma rung spyod la 'jug mi ces pa ltar thabs med 'u thug kyi bya spyod la 'jug pa de ni lugs 'gal gyi bya spyod yin pa dngos don gyis ra 'phrod la/ yang sgos dmangs srol rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi thog nas bshad na'ang gcig nalha byā de'i pha yis zla bo 'das po'i shul 'dzin khab tu bsus pa'i mna' ma

der ma yar zhes dmigs bsal gyi tha snyad yod pa dang / nam rgyun a ma ma yar zhes kyang 'bod srol yod pa dang / gnyis nas pha bu gnyis kyis thun mong du mna' ma mnyam bsu byas pa de gnyen ston gyi rnam pas spyi tshogs la khyab bsgrags dang gsal brda byas skor rang cag gi 'dren byed rna bas zin myong med la/ dmangs srol rig pa'i gzhung lugs nas bshad na gnyen ston skabs kyi mi so so'i go gnas/ thob thang / de'i thog gi bya spyod rnams kyis mi de pa'i bab thob mtshon gyi yod pa/ gsum nas mna' ma der skyes pa'i bu phrug gis pha bu mna' ma mnyam spyod mkhan gyi bu der a pha'am a khu zhes 'bod srol med par gcen po zhes 'bod kyi yod/ rgyu mtshan de rnams nas pha bus mna' ma mnyam spyod byas pa de lugs mthun yin par spyi tshogs kyi khas len dang gdeng 'jog bzang po thob kyi med pa gsal por mtshon yod na der gnyen srol du brjod pa dmangs srol gyi mtshan nyid las 'gal lo/ma dang bu mos mag pa mnyam spyod byed pa dang pha bus mna' ma mnyam spyod byed pa'i rnam pa gnyis pho mo'i dbye ba tsam las ngo bo'i khyad par med pas ma dang bu mos mag pa mnyam spyod byed pa bod kyi gnyen srol du brjod pa'ang lta ba yang dag cig ga nas yin/ rgyu mtshan ni gong dang 'dra bas 'dir bskyar zlos kyi dgos gal ma mchis/ mdor na pha bus mna' ma mnyam spyod byed pa dang ma dang bu mos mag pa mnyam spyod byed pa'i bya spyod de rigs bod kyi khul du mi re gnyis steng byung myong yod pa bden mod/ 'on kyang de ni khyim tshang re gnyis la god chag byung ba'i steng lhag pa'i gnas tshul sha sta/ byin/

de rnams tshang ma bu'am bu mo'i ma'am pha na ma rgas gong shi song ba'i khyim tshang nang pha la mna' ma gsar pa zhig bsus pa'i rjes bu de na 'tshar yong skabs ma yar dang pho mo'i 'brel ba byung ba'am sngon la bu der mna' ma bsus/ de rjes mna' ma de dang de'i zla bo'i pha yi bar pho mo'i 'brel ba byung ba/ yang na sngon la a mar mag pa bsus/ de rjes bu mo 'tshar longs byung skabs pha yar de dang bu mo de'i bar pho mo'i 'brel ba byung ba'am thog mar bu mor mag pa bsus/ de rjes mag pa de dang de'i zla bo'i ma yi bar pho mo'i 'brel ba byung ba bcas yin/ god chag byung ba'i khyim tshang nang lhag pa'i dmigs bsal gyi gnas tshul te 'tsho gnas dang grong pa kha thor mi 'gro ba'i ched du spyad pa'i thabs dbul ba'i bya thabs rnams gnyen srol du brjod na ga nas 'thad/gal srid de rnams gnyen srol dngos yin na sngon dang rjes kyi dbye ba med par thog ma nas pha bu gnyis la thun mong du mna' ma bsu ba'am ma dang bu mor thun mong du mag pa bsu nges yin/ gong smos kyi gnas tshul rnams las sngon laganyen 'brel byung ba dag lugs mthun yin pa dang rjes su pho mo'i dbar 'brel ba byung ba rnams tshul min gyi bya spyod 'ba' zhig yin pa gsal por mthong thub bo/ /blo mthun 'ga' shas kyis bod kyi gnyen srol la grogs po gnyis kyis mna' ma gcig spyod pa dang sha rus kyi gnyen nye'i 'brel ba med pa'i skyes pa gardiswā kyis mna' ma gcig spyod pa'i lugs yod ces brjod kyi yod pa ma zad/

khong tshos gnyen srol sngon ma der rnam pa gnyis yod de khyo bo las ga'i dbang gis yul phyogs gzhan zhig la song rjes de'i mna' mas skyes pa gzhan zhig dang pho mo'i 'brel bar longs su spyod pa dang gcig skyes pa dbul po zhig la mna' ma yid 'ong mdzes ma zhig yod tshe/ dbul khyim de'i khyim tshang gi 'tsho ba'i ched du mna' ma des rang gi lus phung skyes pa phyug po zhig gam yang na dpon po zhig la longs su spyod du bcug pa dang gnyis zhes brjod la 'ga' res da dung yul ming mi ming sogs kyang gsal por bris yong gi yod/ don du khong tshos brjod pa'i gtam rnams snga phyi 'gal bar 'gro ba'i 'chal gtam 'ba' zhig yin pa khong rang tshos bkod pa'i sgrub byed rnams las zur mthong lebagasal yin pas shig gsod par sta re 'phyar mi dgos pa'i dpe ltar nga tshos rgyu mtshan mang po drangs nas sun 'byin byed dgos don med/ khong tshos brjod pa ltar grogs pos mna' ma mnyam spyod byed pa de bod kyi gnyen srol yin na/ grogs po gnyis ka mna' ma de'i lugs mthun khyo bo yin pas gcig gi mna' ma gzhan zhig gis spyod pa'i gnas tshul yong don ci/ de bas kyang grogs pos mna' ma mnyam spyod byed pa lugs mthun yin na khyo bo las ku'i dbang gis yul phyogs gzhan zhig la song rjes de'i mna' mas lkog tu skyes pa gzhan de dang pho mo'i 'brel ba byed dgos don gang / grogs po mna' ma mnyamaspyod byed pa gnyen srol yin na thab gcig la 'khor nas 'tsho ba skyel mkhan gyi bza' gsum yin la khyim tshang gcig rang yin dgos pas khyo bo'i dbar dbul phyug gi dbye ba dang dbul po'i mna' mas phyug po'am daswā/ po

la gzhang btsongs don ci yin/ don dngos thog khong chos drangs pa'i sgrub byed de rnams nas grogs pos mna' ma gcig spyod byed pa gnyen srol min pa gsal por bshad yod/bod kyi gnyen srol la sha rus kyi gnyen nye'i 'brel ba med la grogs po'ang min pa'i skyes pa kha shas kyis mna' ma mnyam spyod byed kyi yod ces blo mthun nyung shas kyis brjod pa ma zad/ khong tshos yul lung 'di na khyim tshang 'di 'dra zhig yod ces khungs su drangs pa'i khul byed kyi yod/ kho pa tshos khungs su drangs pa'i dpe rnams tshang ma lugs min gyi bya spyod kun gyis 'phya smon byed pa'i yul kho nar zad/ dper na/ khong chos khungs drangs pa la yul ga ge mo na bud med che ge mo zer ba gcig yod pa des rang gi khyo bo khyim du ma bsdad pa'i skabs/ khyo bo gzhan la phung lus kyi bsu ba zhus/ de las sne len gyi gla cha len gyi yod ces pa dang / yang na yul ga ge mo na bud med che ge mo zer ba zhig yod pa des rang gi khyo bo khyim du bsdad med pa'i skabs lkog tu khyo bo gzhan dang lus 'brel byed kyi yod ces brjod kyi yod/ de ni kho pa tshos brtsam pa'i rtsom yig de khyad mtshar po/ ya ma gzugs 'dra byung na bod kyi spyi tshogs dngos la shes rtogs med pa'i skye bo 'gas yid ches byed pa dang dga' po byed kyi yod pas/ de'i ched du min pa yin par bkod nas don dngos la sgro 'dogs byas pa zhig rang yin/ de 'dra ba'i tshul min gyi bya spyod pho mo gnyis las grub pa'i mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs nang yod bzhin pas bod rigs kyi dzhai /gas khrod du'ang yod nges yin/ 'on kyang de dag mi rigs gcig gam

sa khul gcig gi dmangs tshogs kyis khas len brtsi srung byed pa'i dmangs srol gyi grub cha gnyen srol yin zhes brjod na ga nas 'thad/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang gong smos pha bus mna' ma mnyam spyod byed pa dang / grogs pos mna' ma mnyam spyod byed pa bod kyi gnyen srol min pa'i sgrub byed bstan pa rnams dang 'dra bas 'dir bskyar zlos kyi dgos pa ma mchis/ lta ba 'dir gzhigs nas nan bshad gcig byed rgyu la/ lugs min gyi bya spyod de rigs la 'jug mkhan rnams la la 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen zhan pas rang nyid kyi lus phung la brten nas 'tsho ba'i kha gsab len thabs byed kyi yod pa dang / la la rgyu mtshan sna tshogs kyis rkyen pas lugs mthun khyo bo'i lkog tu khyo yan dang lus 'brel byed mkhan sha stag yin/ skye bo kun gyis mkhyen gsal ltar rgyal khab bam mi rigs gang 'dra zhig yin rung / de yi spyi tshogs nang mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba la dbul phyugagi dbye ba gnam sa chod pa lta bu yod pa dang / dbul po la la ni rang rang gi lag tu yod pa'i rgyu dngos kyis 'tsho ba skyel thabs med par ngo tsha spangs te khrom gzhung dang za khang sogs la slong mor 'gro yi yod pa dang /'ga' shas kyis rang gi yon tan glu gar gtam brjod sogs la brten nas 'tsho ba skyel ba dang / yang 'ga' shas thabs med 'u thug nas khrel med kyi ma byin len gyi bya bar 'jug gi yod/ yang bud med 'ga' shas ni rang gi lus kyi mdzes chos sogs la bstun te gzhan la smad btsongs te 'tsho ba skyel gyi yod pa sogs thabs dbul ba'i bya thabs rnam pa sna tshogs spyad de 'tsho ba skyel thabs byed pa sa phyogs gang sar mngon rgyu yod pa ni smos ci dgos/ 7stag

par du rang re'i da lta'i spyi tshogs kyi ngos nas bshad na'ang / tang dang rgyal khab kyis gzhang tshong dang 'chal rgyug gtan 'gog byed rgyu'i bka' 'bebs dang gsal bsgrags yang yang gnang gi yod pa de nas rang rgyal gyi sa khul khag tu tshul min gyi spyod pa dang khrims 'gal gyi bya spyod de rigs dar nas yod pa mtshon mi thub bam/ gzhan yang sa khul gang sar rgyu yod dbang yod kyi skyes pa dang spyod ngan langs shor gyi bud med mang pos gsang ba'i thog nas zur bza' dang khyo yan 'tshol gyi yod pa rnams rang gi lugs mthun gyi bza' zla las logs su btsal ba kho na yin/ de lta bu'i skyug bro ba'i spyod ngan de dag spyi tshogs kyi sde tshan chung shos khyim rgyud grub par byed pa'i rmang gzhi dang /gnyen nye 'phel rgyas yong ba'i sngon 'gro gnyen sgrig yin zhes brjod na mi dang dud 'gro'i dbar gyi khyad par chen po zhig med pa chags nges red la don rdog 'khrig spyod dang gnyen srol dbar gyi dbye ba gsal po phye ma thub pas lan no/rgyal phyi rgyal nang gi mi rigs tshang ma'i khrod du gna' nas da bar bud med kyis gzhang tshong ba dang / skyes pas 'chal po rgyug pa/ log g.yem la 'jug pa sogs tshul min gyi pho mo'i 'brel ba sna tshogs mig gis mthong yul dang rna bas thos yul du gyur thub pa ji bzhin bod kyi spyi tshogs thog tu tshul min spyod ngan de rigs byung yod pa los bden/ 'on kyang / bsgrub bya'i gzhi de bod kyi gnyen sgrig gam gnyen srol la bzhag sgrub byed du gsang thabs kyis lugs mthun khyo bo'i lkog tu log g.yem byas pa dang / rgyu nor gyi che/ ṭī gzhang btsongs pa/ khrel med kyis 'chal po rgyug pa sogs lugs min

gyi bya spyod bkod pa de rigs ra mgo lug bsgar min na gang yin/ go go ba'i rna rtsa dang / rig rig gi mig rtsa'i bcud du smin tshad dmangs srol du bzhag song tshe 'jig rten 'di na lugs dang lugs min gyi dbye ba ma mchis par bya ba las tshad dang / bsam pa'i khyer bzo mtha' dag kun gyis khas len brtsi srung byed pa'i dmangs srol yin par nges la/ bya spyod mtha' dag bya rung dang ma rung gi dbye 'byed med par bzang ngan gang yang spel du rung ba yin/ bya spyod ma rung ba ngan pa spel na yang de ni kun gyis khas len brtsi srung byed pa'i dmangs srol yin pas gdeng 'jog bzang po thob dgos/ de ltar 'dren byed rna bas mthong thos byung tshad dmangs srol du bzhag na/ lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i nang tshags par zhig gi thog tu rgyal khab gcig gi glang rdzi bas ba mo gcig dang gnyen bsdeb bya rgyu'i 6 chang sa'i lag khyer /blangs yod ces 'khod pa de las/ rgyal khab de'am mi rigs de'i lugs srol la skye bo dang ba glang gnyen sgrig byed pa'i srol yod ces brjod kyang mi 'grig pa gang yang min 'dug 'on kyang dmangs srol gyi khongs su mig gis mthong tshad dang / rna bas thos tshad/ lag tu lon tshad tshang ma mi gtogs par/ nges par du spyi tshogs dang mi dmangs kyi dbus su dar khyab yod pa zhig dgos la mi dmangs kyis khas len brtsi srung byed pa zhig dgos pa ni smra shes go nus pa'i mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig yin na rtogs sla/ der brten gong du brjod pa'i skye bo ches nyung shas kyi lus la lhag pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i spyod tshul bod mi yongs kyis skyon 'dzugs dang 'phya smod byed yul du gyur ba'i tshul min7 shā pho

mo'i lus 'brel bya spyod de rigs bod rigs mi dmangs kyis khas len brtsi srung byed pa'i dmangs srol yin zhes brjod pa dang / de rnams bod rigs khrod kyi gdod ma'i khyu tshogs gnyen sgrig gi lhag 'phro yin zhes brjod pa rnams bzhad gad kho na'i rgyu las phan 'bras kyi dri ma spu tsam yang ma mchis pa'i khyi ngan gzhogs rgyug gi bab col 'ba' zhig yin par snyam mo/gsum/ phu nus mna' ma mnyam spyod byed pa bodakyi gnyen srol yin tshul bstan pa/spyir bod mi rigs kyi gnyen sgrig lam srol gyi grub cha gtso bo de khyo gcig shug gcig gi lam srol 'di nyid yin mod kyang / 'grim 'grul stabs bde med la dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen zhan pa'i yul lung 'gar da lta'i bar du'ang pha mgacig las skyes pa'i phu nur mna' ma gcig mnyam bsu byed pa'am bu mo spun la mag pa gcig mnyam du len pa'i lugs srol yod pa nyan byed rna ba'i yul du mngon sum 'char rgyu mchis na'ang / rang rigs blo mthun nyung shas kyis mi rigs kyi la rgya 'chor dogs nas gnyen srol de nyid bod kyi spyi tshogs su med zer ba'am phu nus mna' ma gcig spyod byed mkhan re gnyis mthong rgyu yod pa gnyen srol du grub thabs med ces u tshugs mthar skyel byed kyi yod pa de swā /cig nas tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rtsa don dang 'gal la gnyis nas bod

mi rigs rang nyid la phan yon spu tsam med pa'i brjod tshul zhig yin/ rang mi rigs la skyug bro ba'i ngos de yod bzhin du g.yo 'gebs byas pa'am gzhan mi rigs la skyug bro ba'i cha de med bzhin du g.yo bzo byas pa tshang ma tshan rig zhib 'jug pa'i spangs bya yin/ nga tshos bltas na snga nas da bar yod bzhin pa'i gnad don 'ga' zhig byung med par smras nas rang ngos kyi ngo tsha 'grib par byed pa des mi rigs kyi la rgya srung skyob bya khul byas kyang des la rgya srung skyob bya rgyu lta ci/ de las ldog ste mi rigs la gnod 'tshe che ba dang / mi rigs kyi la rgya shor ba'i nyen kha yod par snyam/bod mi rigs kyi lo rgyus chu rgyun ring po'i nang spun mched 'gas mna' ma'am mag pa thun mong du len pa'i lo rgyus dngos byung yod pa ma zad/ deng dus gtsang khul dang / stod khul/ khams khul du dar khyab cung che ba'i gnyen srol gyi ya rgyal zhig yin/ thog mar nga tshos bu spun mna' ma mnyam du bsu ba de bod kyi lugs srol yin min la dbye zhib lam tsam bya rgyu yin/ bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa de gtsang khul dang / nag chu/ stod/ lho kha/khams/ kun tse sogs su dar khyab che chung la ma ltos par dar nas yod la/de'i nang nas gtsang khul dang / khams khul du de bas dar khyab che ba yod/rtsom pa pos 19〈〈lo'i zla ba brgyad par gzhis rtse sa gnas pa snam rdzong bkra shar shang gi grong tsho dang por brtag dpyad cig byas pa yin/ grong tsho de'i nang bsdom bza' tsho 29yod pa dang / de'i nang khyo gcig shug gcig yin pa bza' tsho 14yod pa/ bu spun gnyis mna' ma mnyam bsu byas pa ba~X tsho

11yod pa/ bu spun gsum mna' ma gcig mnyam bsu byas pa bza' tsho 10yod pa/ bu spun bzhi mna' ma mnyam bsu byas pa bza' tsho 2yod pa/bu mo spun gnyis mag pa mnyam bsu byas pa bza' tsho 1bcas yod pa'i nang khyo gcig shug gcig gi bza' tshos 25 'phrolas zin med/ yang dper na blo mthun lu'u khrang ling gis chab mdo sa khul du brtag dpyad byas par gzhigs na go 'jo rdzong sa ngan chus kyi grong tsho drug gi nang 1999lo'i zla ba bzhi par pho gcig mo mang gi bza' tsho yin pa dud tshang 204yod pa des dud tshang spyi'i 12 66zin gyi yod pa dang / go 'jo rdzo) gi sa ngan chus khongs phud pa'i skya 'bel/ lha rgyal/ 'bo lo/ lha tho/ a dbang / rtse pa bcas shang drug la brtag dpyad byas pa'i gnas tshul ni mo gcig pho mang gi bza' tsho yin pa'i dud tshang 2201yod pa des dud tshang spyi'i 67 26zin gyi yod/ smar khams rdzong khongs su 1996lor brtag dpyad byed skabs rdzong yongs su khyo gcig shug mang gi dud tshang 472dang / khyo mang shug gcig gi dud tshang 4597yod pa des dud tshang spyi'i 46 616zin yod/ brag g.yab rdzong khongs kyi 'brog khul du khyo mang shug gcig gi dud tshang 607nas 707g.yas g.yon zin pa dang / mdzo sgang rdzong khongs stobs 'bangs shang jo rong grong tsho'i nang khyo mang shug gcig gi dud tshang 906zin pa dang / khyo gcig shug gcig gi dud tshang gis 57las zin med/ yang dper na/ rtsom pa pos 1997lor lha sa grong khyer snye mo rdzong la spyi tshogs brtag dpyad la 'gro ma~X lhun khang shang tang tsu'u yi hru'u ci dkar ma lags kyis ngo sprod gnang

bar shang de khul du them grangs 210yod pa'i nang bza' gsum pa'i them grangs 21yod gsungs/ bza' gsum pa'i dud tshang gis 76zin yod/snye mo dar grong shang bzang ri grong tsho'i dbu 'dzin bsod nams grags pa lags kyis ngo sprod gnang bar grong tsho der them grangs 111yod pa'i nang bza' gsum gyi dud tshang 45yod gsungs/ bza' gsum dud tshang gis them grangs spyi'i 40 546zin gyi yod/ 〈nag chu'i 'brog pa 〉zhes pa'i spyi tshogs brtag dpyad snyan zhu yi nang gsal bar nag chu sa khul du 6 bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed mkhan mang che ba bu spun gnyis chung ma gcig bsu/da dung bu spun gnyis yan gyis chung ma mnyam bsu byed pa'ang yod/ dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur ma btang gong nag chu rdzong a mdo smad ma'i rgyal mtshan nor bu la bu spun drug yod pa dang / khong rang yang bzhi pa de yin/ khong dang gcung po tshe ring grags pa mna' ma gcig mnyam bsu byas yod/ yang mal bde ru pa'i bsod nams grags par bu spun lnga yod pa'i nang chung ba grwa pa byas pa phud de byings bu spun bzhi mna' ma mnyam bsu byas yod/’ 1997lo'i zla ba bdun par kho bos pa snam rdzong khongs kyi bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa'i gnas tshul la rtog zhib rags tsam byas pa yin/ rdzong yongs su bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed mkhan khyab che ba dang / 'brog khul lam sa ma 'khrog khul du bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed mkhan gyi brgya cha mtho ba yod/ lhag don du mag shang gi mi lung rang byung grong tsho lta bu'i bza' tsho tshang ma bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed mkhan yin pa'ang ma~X rgyu

yod/ rang byung grong tsho der bza' tsho khag bdun yod pa tshang ma bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byas pa sha stag yin la mna' ma gcig la khyo bo mang shos la bu spun drug tsam byas pa'ang yod/ yang rdzong de'i rdzong shang rim pa gnyis kyi las byed khrod du nyung mthar las byed mi grangs brgyad tsam zhing khul du yod pa'i rang gi phu bo'am nu bo dang mnyam du bza' gsum gyi 'tsho ba skyel gyi yod la de rnams nas 507ni chus rim pa'i 'go khrid las byed yin pa dang da dung gcig ni gung khran tang yon yang yin/ de ltar don dngos 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi bza' gsum gi gnas tshul re zhig zhu mtshams bzhag ste rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi thog nas dbye zhib lam tsam bya rgyu la/dus phyis kyi zhib 'jug pa nyung shas kyis bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa'i gnyen srol ngo sprod byed skabs bod spyi tshogs kyi don dngos dang mi mthun pa'i tshod dpag gi gtam gleng mang po zhig byas yod/ 〈bod ljongs zhib 'jug〉rgya yig dus deb nang rtsom pa po zhig gis 6 bu spun rnams kyis rgan 'go'i chung ma mnyam du spyod/ thun mong du 'tsho ba mnyam skyel byed/'on kyang ming thog tu chung ma de rgan 'gor bdag pa yin/ khong gnyis ni spyi tshogs spyis khas len pa'i khyo shug gi 'brel ba yin mi zhes bris yod pa dang /dus deb de ga'i nang rtsom pa po gzhan zhig gis 6 bu spun mna' ma mnyam spyod kyi khyim tshang rnams rmang che ba sngon la rgan 'go'i mtshan thog nas chung ma bsu/khyim tshang gi gnyen sgrig 'tsho ba btsugs/ de rjes bu spun rnams rim bzhin gnyeci/ sgrig 'tsho ba'i nang 'dzul/ mna' ma mnyam spyod kyi don dngos

chags mi zhes bkod yod/ rtsom pa po de gnyis kyis bod kyi spyi tshogs dngos dang lhag par du bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed khul gyi zhing 'brog sa khul gyi mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos la rtog zhib byas med pa gsal por mthong thub/don dngos thog gong du drangs pa'i skad cha dum mtshams gnyis po 'dis bu spun mna' ma mnyam spyod byed pa de lugs mthun gyi gnyen srol min par bshad yod/ 6 ming thog tu chung ma de rgan 'gor bdag pa yin/ khong gnyis ni spyi tshogs spyis khas len pa'i khyo shug gi 'brel ba yin mizhes brjod pa las spyi tshogs kyis rgan 'go dang chung ma'i khyo shug gi 'brel ba khas len pa las nu bo rnams dang chung ma'i khyo shug gi 'brel ba khas len byed kyi med pa mtshon yod/yang 4 sngon la rgan 'go'i mtshan thog nas chung ma bsu/ khyim tshang gi gnyen sgrig 'tsho ba btsugs mipa de ha lam lugs mthun gyi gnyen sgrig yin pa dang /66de rjes bu spun rnams rim bzhin gnyen sgrig 'tsho ba'i nang 'dzul/ mna' ma mnyam spyod kyi don dngos chags 9pa rnams don dngos kyi bya spyod yin pa tsam las lugs dang 'gal la byi byas pa kho nar grub/ don dngos thog bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa'i sa khul du mna' ma bu rgan 'go'i mtshan thog nas bsus pa min la/ ming thog gam don dngos gang thad nas mna' ma bu rgan 'gor bdag pa zhig min par nu bo rnams dang mna' ma'i bar gyi 'brel ba de lugs mthun gyi gnyen sgrig yin par spyi tshogs kyis khas len byed kyi yod/dang po/ bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed khul gyi mi sger gyi lta sdusam

spyi tshogs kyi spyi gtam gang gi thad nas bltas kyang gnyen srol de rigs ni lugs dang mthun pa dang mi'i gshis rgyud dang mthun pa'i bya spyod la brtsi yi yod la/ spyi tshogs kyis khas len pa tsam ma zad/ de da dung ya rabs spyod bzang zhig tu brtsi yi yod/ dper na/ tsa bu spun gnyis stag mo kha 'phrod yin/bu kha thor khyi shig sbar gang yin ’ 0zhes dang 66bu spun gnyis lcags mkhar sgo med yin/ bu spun gnyis chung ma gcig 'du yin mi②zhes gsungs pa rnams las ra sprod thub nges yin/gnyis pa/ bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed mkhan gyis thog mar mna' ma 'tshol skabs mna' ma'i lo de phu nu tshang ma'i na tshod dang bstun gang thub byed srol yod pa'ang mna' ma de bu spun thun mong gi yin pas de'i lo bu rgan 'go las chung ba btsal te nu bo rnams la blta rtog byed kyi yod/ bod kyi srol rgyun lta ba'i nang khyo shug gnyis las chung ma de khyo bo las lo rgan pa byung na cung dman par brtsi ba dang / chung ma khyo bo las lo gcig gis rgan pa yod na 6 gcig snon zhes mi shis pa'i don la brtsi srol yod pa de dang bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa'i gnyen srol 'brel ba med ces brjod mi thub la/ spyi lo 1990lor rgyal yongs su mi 'bor zhib bsher thengs bzhi pa byed skabs bod kyi bod rigs khyo shug gi lo'i dbye ba ni khyo bo chung ma las rgan pa mang dusbyi stsi ṇḍaṃ kṣiṃ sgyu/zhi /sgyu stsor ni / ṭī /sna 〉〉snya (12/4la gsal/

ba'i sdom tshig thon yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo gcig ni bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa'i gnyen srol de yin zhes brjod mi phod pa gang yang med/gsum pa/ bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed mkhan gyi phu nu tshang ma dmigs bsal gyi gnas tshul yod pa phud gnyen sgrig gi mdzad sgo'i nang zhugs kyi yod pa dang / tshang ma'i thob thang dang nus pa 'dra mnyam yin/gnyen ston skabs kyi zhugs gral gyi bshad pa'i nang dang khyo bo'i bshad pa'i nang phu nu tshang ma'i bstod pa tshud yod/ (mjug gi gnyen bshad le tshan nang gsal )'on kyang gnyen ston skabs kyi zhugs gral thog gi bsdad sa dang bag nyal gyi dus tshod bcas la rgan gzhon gyi rim pa dbye srol yod/bzhi pa/ bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed mkhan gyi bu tshang mar thun mong gi chung mar byung ba'i bu phrug rnams la do dam slob gso byed dbang yod la gso skyong byed rgyu'i 'os 'gan yang yod pa dang / phu nu tshang mas rang nyid bu phrug rnams kyi khrus nas mi dag pa'i pha yin par brtsis te brtse dung zab mo bcangs kyi yod pa red/lnga pa/ bu phrug rnams 'tshar longs byung skabs kyang rang nyid yang snying pha khu rnams las su zhig gi sha dus yin pa mi shes kyang bu phrug tshang mas pha a khu a ma mnyam bsu byed mkhan rnams tshang ma rang gi pha ngo mar brtsis la 'bod phyogs mi 'dra tsam las dbyer med kyis brtsi bkur dang gus zhabs zhu yi yod/gong gsal rgyu mtshan de rnams nas bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa de khams dang / gtsang / byang thang sogs sa khul mang po zhig gi gnyenā /la

gyi grub cha zhig tu grub pa dang / bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa'i lugs srol de dar yul gzhi rgya che tsam yod la mi 'bor gyis mi 'bor spyi'i brgya cha mi nyung tsam zin gyi yod pas de ni bod kyi gnyen srol gyi grub cha zhig tu grub pa yin/ blo mthun re zung gis bod rigs gnas sdod bya yul gyi sa khul 'ga' shas su bu spun mna' ma mnyam spyod byed pa'i gnyen srol dar med pa rgyu mtshan dukhyas nas de nyid bod kyi gnyen srol min zhes brjod kyi yod/ de ltar na bod pa yongs kyis khas len pa dang brtsi srung zhu ba'i dmangs srol gang dang ci yod/ byang gi 'brog pa rnams kyis lta 'dod zhing nyan spro ba'i rig rtsed byed sgo mang po lha sa bas cha med rgyus med chags kyi yod pa dang / lha sa ba'i dus ston sogs byed sgo'i 'gro lugs byang pa'i blo yul las 'das pa mang po yod/lha sa bas lo gsar skabs sgrig chas nang bcos ma'i lug mgo sgrig gi yod pa dang / gtsang dang nag chu sogs sa khul mang por lo gsar tshes gcig nyin lug mgo za ba'i goms gshis yod/ des na lha sa bas lo gsar la lug mgo za ba de bod kyi lugs srol min zhes brjod na mi 'thad la/ gtsang pa dang byang pas lo gsar la lug mgo sgrig pa de bod kyi lugs srol min zhes brjod na'ang mi 'thad/ sngon thon gyi lugs srol bzang po zhig yin kyang rung rjes lus kyi lugs srol ngan pa zhig yin kyang rung de bod rigs gnas sdod byed pa'i sa khul 'gar khyab rgya che tsam yod pa dang / bod rigs khrod du mi mang tsam gyis khas len brtsi srung byed kyi yod na de ni bod kyi yul srol goms gshe8sdu su mi rtsi thabs med yin/ lhag par du dmangs srol ngan pa dag yod

bzhin du med par brjod kyang de med pa chags kyi med na nga tshos de gnas pa'i rgyu mtshan dang dor ba'i thabs 'tshol rgyu ni don dam yin/bzhi/ phu nu'i mna' ma mnyam bsu'i gnyen srol dar gnas thub pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan pa/nga tshos bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa'i lugs srol de dar ba'i rgyu rkyen la dbye zhib byed skabs gnyen srol de dar khul bod kyi sa khul de dag la bud med nyung drags pa min la gdod ma'i khyu tshogs gnyen sgrig lam srol gyi lhag 'phro'ang min par de ni khyim tshang gi ngal nus gcig sdud yong ched dang rgyu nor kha thor mi 'gro ba'i khyim tshang gi khe phan kho na'i ched du chags pa'i lam srol zhig yin pa dang / khe phan gyi dmigs yul de gnyis kyi shugs rkyen 'og grub pa'i srol rgyun khyim tshang gi 'du shes des gnyen srol 'di dar khyab rtsa brtan yong rgyur shugs rkyen chen po thebs yod/dang po/ rang mkho rang sgrub byed pa'i rang byung dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen 'ogakhyim tshang tshang mas ri klung gnyis kur 'thab dgos kyi yod pa dang lhag par du 'brog khul dang sa ma 'brog khul du khyim tshang nang thon skyed ngal nus kyi grangs 'bor gyi dgos mkho che ba ni khyim tshang gcig rang gi nang du g.yag rdzi/ 'bri rdzi/ lug dzi/ ra rdzi/ so nam mkhan bcas las rigs re la las mi re rtag rgyun dgos pa ma zad/ zhing 'brog dbar la skyel 'dren byed sdu/na

dgos pa dang / bzhin dus su bzhon ma dang 'debs dus su 'debs rogs dgos pa/ lhagayar zhing 'brog las brel ba che skabs ngal nus kyi dgos pa de bas che ba yod pa ni dper na dpyid dus skyes bsu'i skabs su lug khyu kho nar cha bzhag nas bshad na tsho khag bzhi ru dbye nas 'tsho dzi byed dgos kyi yod/ nam rgyun lug khyu de ma khyu dang la ga tsho gnyis su dbye nas 'tsho ba dang /dpyid ka ma khyu de'ang ma mo dang shar po shar ma tsho gnyis su dbye/ skyes bsu byed bzhin pa'i skabs ma mo'i khyu de skyes ma dang sbrum ma zhes khyu tsho gnyis su dbye nas 'tsho dgos kyi yod/ de ni lo ngo stong phrag mang po'i 'brog las thon skyed kyi nyams myong yin la/ bod kyi rang byung khor yug dang / rtswa ra'i thon khungs/ phyugs rigs kyi 'tsho ba'i goms gshis dang mthun pa'i thon skyed bya lugs shig red/ de ltar phyugs rigs khyu tsho re'i rjes su mi re bdag pa dang /da dung nang las byed mkhan dang phyi 'gro byed mkhan yang dgos kyi yod na khyim tshang gcig rang gi nang du ngal nus kyi dgos mkho ji 'dra'i che ba min 'dug gam/ bod kyi bshad rgyun du 6 brgyad pa kha chag gnag la gtong / gnag rdzi mi yong na rgyug pas brdung mi zhes brjod pa ltar byis pa lo bdun las slebs med kyang khyim tshang nang gi ngal nus gcig chags yod pa gzhan gyi rna yul du thos skabs ha lam yid mi ches pa'i rgyu ru 'gro nges red/ 'on kyang de lta bu'i don dngos bod kyi 'brog khul dang sa ma 'brog khul du rig byed mig gis dngos su mthong rgyu yod la de ni khyim tshang nang gi ngal nus kyi dgos mkho che bsasdu na song / de lta bu'i khyim tshang nang ngal nus kyi dgos mkho che ba'i sa

khul du khyo gcig shug gcig dud tshang gi zhan cha ni sne mang la nam dus rang bzhin che ba'i thon skyed rnams dus thog tu sgrub dka' bas thon skyed la 'thus shor 'gro la rtag tu mi cha mang ba'i dud tshang la rten rgyu kho na las med/1999lo'i lo stod du pa snam rdzong khongs bkra shar shang gi grong tsho dang po'i nang bsdom them grangs 42yod pa dang / de'i nang khyo gcig shug gcig gi dud tshang 16yod pa dang / bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed mkhan dud tshang 24yod/ khyo gcig shug gcig gi dud tshang 16de'i nang 'bri g.yag dang ra lug tshang ma yod pa'i dud tshang 6las med pa dang / phyugs rigs la dud tshang de rang gis bdag po cha tshang rgyag thub mkhan dud tshang bzhi las med/dud tshang 12kyi phyug rigs rnams bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed mkhan gyi dud tshang la bcol pa sha stag yin/ der brten ngal nus dbul ba'i dud tshang rnams spyi'i cha nas 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen zhan pa dang / dud tshang mang po zhig dbul po'i gnas su lus nas yod/ spyi lo 19〈〈lor rtsom pa pos pa snam rdzong bkra shar shang khongs kyi grong tsho gnyis la spyi tshogs brtag dpyad byed skabs khul de'i them grangs 120yod pa'i nang nas dbul po'i dud tshang 12dang phyug po'i dud tshang 12kyi nang mi'i grub tshul la zhib bsdur byas pa yin/ 91
sne

(gong gi dbul po'i dud tshang bcu gnyis nang da dung bza' zla med par gyur ba dang / kha gyes pa/ mi rkyang / byi phrug yod pa bcas dbul po'i dud tshang dgu tshud med/)gong du re'u mig ka nang gsal ba ltar phyug po'i dud tshang bcu gnyis nang bza' tsho bsdoms 19yod pa dang / bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byas pa bza' tsho 16yod/ dud tshang de rnams kyi nang khyo gcig shug gcig gi bza' tsho khe gtsang byas pa gcig kyang med la dud tshang rer cha snyoms mi grangs 12min gyi yod/ de las ldog ste re'u mig kha la gsal ba ltar dbul po'i dud tshang bcu gnyis kyi nang bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byas pa gcig kyang med la dud tshang rer cha snyoms mi grangs bdun las med pa red/ don de rnams kyi thog nas bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa de khyim tshang gi ngal nusagacig sdud yong ba'i ched du yin pa dang des khyim tshang gi dpal 'byor 'tsho ba'i dar gud la shugs rkyen chen po thebs kyi yod pa mtshon yod/ de ni bgres song 'gas dran gso gnang ba'i gsham gyi dud tshang gnyis kyi lo rgyus nas de bas ra 'phrod thub nges yin/kho bo'i deb chung 'di'i nang 'khod pa'i khyim tshang ang 4ste pha shar tshang gi gnas tshul la dbye zhib byed skabs bgres song spen dgos lags kyi spo bo'i dus su bu gnyis mna' ma gcig mnyam bsu byas pas khyim tshang gi 'tsho ba ma~X de dus kyi grong tsho'i nang rab gras su gtogs kyi yod par grags/ 'on

kyang khong tshor bu dngos grub gcig rang las ma skyes pa der mna' ma grong tsho gzhan gyi dud tshang phyug gras shig gi bu mo bu khrid bsus/ dus de tsa na dngos grub kyi pha gnyis kyang na rgas/ bu gnyis 'khrungs pa nar ma son pas ri zhing gnyis ka la dngos grub khong rang gis 'thab dgos pas zhing 'brog gnyis ku'i thon skyed la 'thud shor phyin/ khyim tshang gi 'tsho ba yang rim bzhin nyams gud byung / de'i skabs dngos grub khong rang yang tshe yis ma brtan par a ma a khu rgan rgon gnyis dang / bza' zla/ bu gnyis bcas 'jig rten 'dir bzhag nas lnga ba'i lam du phebs/ pha shar tshang de yang nyams thag dbul zhing phongs pa'i gnas su gyar/ skabs de dus spen dgos dang mig tshe gnyis kyi ma bu khrid ni khyim tshang chen po'i sras mo yin pas dud tshang de'i nang dka' sdug gis ma bzod par ma tshang la log phyin/ de rjes spen dgos dang mig tshe gnyis rim bzhin 'tshar longs byung zhing spen dgos bod lo bcu bdun dang mig tshe bod lo bco lnga'i skabs rdzong khongs gzhan zhig gi grong ming du ber phyug 'bod pa'i khyim tshang che gras shig yod par sras mo gsum yod pa las rgan 'go de mna' mar slong / ber phyug gi pha des ma gzhi pha shar tshang da lta dbul po'i gnas su gyar yang gos chen rgas kyang ri mo'i gzhung yod zhes brjod nas rang gi bu mo rgan pa mna' mar byin/ de rjes pha shar tshang gi 'tsho ba rim bzhin yar ngo'i zla ltar yar rgyas byung ste lo bcu'i nang khyim tshang phyug gras su tshud pa dang / bu phug bdun byung ba las dus rabs gong ma'i lo rabs bdun cu'i smad du bu gnyis la mna' ma mnyam bsu byas pas grong tsho de'i nang kāsnal

'byor phyug shos kyi dud tshang gsum nang tshud yod/ 'on kyang bgres song spen dgos lags kyi bu'i mna' ma der bu mo bzhi dang bu gcig rang las ma skyes pa dang / bu de'i ming la tshe ring don grub ces btags/ bu tshe ring don grub pho lo 20la slebs skabs (2000lo )grong tsho gzhan zhig nas de las lo gcig gis chung ba'i bu mo zhig mna' mar blangs/ bgres song khong gi tsha bo dang de'i mna' mar dus yun lo gnyis tsam ring phru gu ma skyes/ pha shar tshang gi rgan dar gzhon gsum tshang mas skom pa chu 'dod ltar re 'gug byas pa'i bu chung 'ig 2002lo'i re gza' phur bu zhig la skyes pas de'i ming du phur bu don grub ces btags/ de rjes bgres song spen dgos lags kyi tsha bo'i mna' mar da bar yang tsha phur bu don grub gcig rang las ma skyes pas/khong dang nang mi tshang ma sems khral chen po byed kyi yod la/ khul de'i lha pa rtsis pa'i gam du mo lung thugs brtag zhu ba dang / lha sa dang gzhis rtse khul du sman khang nang brtag dpyad byas 'bras su tsha bo'i mna' mar phru gu gnyis pa skye ba'i nas pa med pa shes rjes bgres song khong de bas thugs khral chen po gnang bzhin yod/ 2006lo'i lo mjug tu nga tshos khul der spyi tshogs brtag zhib byed skabs pha shar tshang la mi grangs 11yod pa la sa zhing mu'u 6dang / 'bri g.yag bsdoms 51 ra lug 280 rta drel 2 ba mdzo 4bcas yod/zhing 'brog gi las sne mang la las yul kha thor yin pas nam rgyun nang mi rnams las bgos byed skabs dka' ngal che ba dang / thon skyed la'ang shugs rkyenā ༵na pa phog bzhin yod pas bgres song spen dgos lags kyis phyug po'i

lam du 'gro bar mi chas bslus song zhes nga tshor yang skor skyar skor gyis gsungs byung la/ da dung khong gis tsha bo'i mna' mar yang tsha gcig rang las ma skyes tshe/ mna' ma de'i gcen mo zhig yod pa tsha bo'i chung mar len rgyu'i dgongs 'char bu dang tsha bo la yang yang bton gyi yod ces gsungs byung /yang khyim tshang ang 14tshang gi gnas tshul la gzhigs pa byed skabs dud tshang de'i pha ga ge mo'i spo bo'i dus la bu gsum mna' ma mnyam du yin pa dang / de'i dus dud tshang de grong tsho'i nang 'tsho ba rab gras su tshud kyi yod/ga ge mo'i pa'i dus su bu spun gnyis mna' ma mnyam bsu byas yod/ de dus dud tshang de grong tsho'i nang 'tsho ba 'bring rab tsam yin/ ga ge mo bu spun gsum la spyi lo 1976lor mna' ma zhig mnyam bsu byas kyang dus yun lo gcig lhag tsam nas ga ge mo dang mna' ma gnyis ma tshang de las kha gyes/1978lo la ga ge mo'i gcung po gnyis la slar yang mna' ma mnyam bsu byas/de yang dus yun lo gcig tsam nas bu 'bring ba dang mna' ma gnyis ma tshang nas kha nus/ 1982lo la bu chung ba de ma tshang nas bral te ga ge mo dang 'dod pa sgril/ ga ge mo'i dud tshang slar yang bza' gsum chags/1992lo la ga ge mo'i spun mched chung shos bu mo de go ma 'grim par yul gzhan gyi skyes pa zhig dang rang mos dga' 'du byas pas skyes pa de kho mo'i tshang la mag par slebs/ de yang lo gcig lhag tsam nas bza' tsho gnyis ma tshang dang kha gyes/ mthar ma tshang der ma gcig rkyang du lus pa dang dus yun lo bcu drug gi nang 'tsho ba'i chu tshad 'bring rab kyi dud tshang gcig sta/ bu

bzhi ru kha gyes/ (las byed byas pa dang bu mo mna' mar ster ba ma brtsis )da yod kyi dud tshang bzhi po der blta skabs/ ma tshang dang / bu 'bring ba'i tshang / bu mo chung bdag gi tshang bcas ches dbul po'i dud tshang chags yod la phyi ma gnyis srid gzhung gyi rgyab skyor 'og yul gzhan gyi dbul skyor gsar spel sa khul btsugs yod sar gnas spo byas pa dang / sngon ma de la ngal rtsol gyi nus shugs med pas pha yul du srid gzhung gi skyob gso dang bu phrug dang grong pa khyim mtshes rnams kyi rogs ram la brten nas ya nga ba'i 'tsho ba skyal nas bsdad yod/ dud tshang yang 14tshang ni ga ge mo dang bu rgan pa phyi 'gro yong babs gsog par 'gro ba dang / nu bo des phru gu byings khrid nas phyugs 'tsho ba/ khong gnyis kyi bza' zlas nang las byed pa bcas byas nas khyim tshang nang phyar ba gru 'degs byas stabs 'tsho ba'i chu tshad grong tsho'i nang rab gral nang slebs kyi yod/ ga ge mo dang bu 'bring ba gnyis dang po ma tshang dang kha gyes pa'i rgyu mtshan ni khong gnyis ka gung khran tang yon yin pas bza' gsum byed mi chog ces phyi mi dang gnyen nye rnams la lab kyi yod/ 'on kyang dgod bro ba zhig la thog ma khong tshor mna' ma mnyam bsu byed skabs gnyis ka gung khran tang mi yin pa dang / lhag par du ga ge mo ma tshang dang kha gyes skabs rgyu mtshan tang mi bza' gsum byas mi chog pas yin pa dang / dus yun lo drug phyin pa'i rjes gung khran tang yon bza' gsum byas mi chog pa'i gtan 'bebs la 'gyur ba med la ga ge mo rang nyid gung khran tang nang nas phyir 'themiswā ma byas bzhin du slar yang bza' gsum chags yod pa red/ don du

78lo la bza' gsum nas kha gyes don dang 〈2lo la slar bza' gsum byed pa'i gtso bo'i rgyu mtshan ni 1981lo la khul der sa zhing spyod dbang them dud la sprad de rang bdag gnyer skyong byed rgyu yun ring 'gyur ba mi gtong ba dang /phyugs zog them dud la sprad de sger bdag sger gso dang rang bdag gnyer skyong byed rgyu yun ring 'gyur ba mi gtong ba'i thon skyed 'gan 'khri'i lam lugs lag bstar byas pas yin no/ /sa ma 'brog khul du gnas pa'i khyim tshang gnyis kyi mi rabs gsum gyi gnyen sgrig byed tshul dang khyim tshang gi 'tsho ba'i gnas bab rags bsdus mtshams sbyor dbye zhib byas pa de'i thad nas gsal bshad byung ba ni dus rabs gcig lhag tsam gyi ring dud tshang de gnyis kyi nang su zhig bza' gsum pa'i gnyen sgrig la 'jug na khyim tshang gi 'tsho ba'i chu tshad yar rgyas 'gro ba dang / khyo gcig shug gcig gi gnyen sgrig la 'jug na dbul zhing phongs pa'i gnas su gyar gyi yod pa gsal por mtshon yod/ mdor na 'brog khul lam sa ma 'brog khul du bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa'i lugs srol dar khyab che ba dang / thon skyed 'gan 'khri'i lam lugs lag bstar byas rjes sa khul 'ga' shas su bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed mkhan tshabs cher phyin yod pa rnams tshang ma khyim tshang nang gi ngal nus kha thor la mi 'gro ba'i slad du yin no/ /gnyis pa/ bu spun mna' ma mnyam spyod byed pa de mi rabs brgyud nas byung ba'i khyim tshang gi rgyu nor kha thor du mi 'gro ba'i ched du'ang yin/ /shā kyi

khyim tshang gi rgyu nor shul 'dzin byed lugs dang bgo bsha' rgyag tshul ni spyir shul 'dzin byed stangs la bu su zhig ma tshang du bsdad na der khyim tshang gi rgyu nor shul 'dzin byed pa'i dbang cha yod/ gal srid bu spun gnyis sam gsum yod pa rnams mag par ma phyin par thab gsar btsugs nas gzhis gsar 'dzin pa yin tshe rgyu nor rnams bu spun la cha snyoms bgo ba'i srol yod/ der khrims kyi khungs lung 'ded sa med kyang spyi tshogs kyi goms gshis shig yin/bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa'i sa khul de dag gi spyi tshogs dngos la blta skabs gal srid bu gnyis sam gsum yod pa'i dud tshang nang bu re res rang 'dod ltar gtan grogs re btsal te 'tsho ba khor skyel byas tshe khyim tshang de nyams rgud 'gro rgyu yin pa'i ra 'phrod gsal po yong gi yod/ dper na gong du gsal ba'i dud tshang ang 14tshang gi gnas tshul ltar 'tsho ba'i chu tshad grong tsho'i nang 'bring rab tu slebs pa'i dud tshang zhig dum bu bzhi la rgyar ba'i rjes srid gzhung gi dbul skyor bya yul gyi dbul phongs dud tshang gsum chags yod/de las 6 grong pa kha gyes na slong mkhan cha gcig 9zer ba'i sngar rgyun gtam dper g.yo bzo dang sgro 'dogs spu tsam med pa shes thub la/ don 'di'i thad phyogs bsdoms rang bzhin ldan pa'i gtam zhig kyang yin pa shes thub/ blo mthun 'ga' shas kyis thog mar gdod ma'i khyo gcig shug gcig gi lam lugs la gtor bshig gtong mkhan de ha lam dpal 'byor kun slong gi btsan 'dzul la brtsi dgos kyi yod ’ ces gsungs yod pa de bod kyi bu spun man1༷ hum mnyam bsu bya yul gyi gnas tshul la sbyar na'ang mi 'thad pa gang yang

med/ de ni gong du bkod pa'i 'og rim gyi dbul po'i dud tshang bcu gnyis dang phyug po'i dud tshang bcu gnyis kyi gnyen sgrig bya tshul las mngon thub la mtho rim sku drag khyim rgyud kyi lo rgyus las kyang mngon thub kyi yod/ 6 bod ljongs kyi sku drag gis mi rabs brgyud nas byung ba'i rgyu dngos kha thor du mi 'gro ba dang khyim rgyud kyi da yod go gnas sra brtan du gtong ched khyim rgyud de yongs mnyam 'brel mnyam sdod bya rgyu nan bshad byed pa dang / de ni sku drag khyim tshang tshang mas dar spel shugs chen byed pa'i khyim tshang gi dpe dbyibs shig red/ khyim tshang gi rgyu nor kha thor du song ba las khyim rgyud de'i spyi tshogs kyi go gnas la shugs rkyen thebs pas mi tshad/ de bas kyang khyim rgyud de yi chags 'jig la thad kur shugs rkyen thebs srid cing / khyim rgyud mnyam 'brel mnyam sdod byed pa des tag tag gnad don rigs 'di gnyis thag gcod byas pa red/ 'on kyang gcen gcung gnyis la chung ma so sor yod pa shin tu nyung /mi dude ltar na bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa'i gnyen srol dar ba'i gong gsal rgyu rkyen khag gnyis las/ gzhi rim khrod du bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni khyim tshang gi ngal nus kha thor mi 'gro ba'i ched du yin la rgyu nor kha thor mi 'gro ba'i dmigs yul yang yod pa dang / mtho rim sku drag gi khrod du bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa de mi rabs brgyud du krung go'i bod kyi shesarig 〉188lo'i bod yig dusadeb bzhi par gsal/ 101

nas byung ba'i rgyu dngos rnams kha thor mi 'gro ba'i ched du yin pa gsal por rtogs thub bo// bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed khul du bu spun kha thor mi 'gro ba'i ched du rtag tu pha mas rjes skyes rnams la slob gso dang khrid ston byed kyi yod pa ma zad bya thabs kyang sna tshogs spyad kyi yod pa red/ dper na snye mo rdzong gzhu phu shang khongs su dngul bzo ba'i dud tshang zhig yod par bu rgan gzhon gnyis yod pa las gcig la dngul bzo'i leb rdung lag rtsal kho na las ma bslabs pa dang / gcig la tshags rgyag pa'i lag shes las bslabs med/ de'i rgyu mtshan 'dri skabs pha des bu gnyis kha ma bral ba'i ched du spyad pa'i thabs shes shig red zer/gsum pa/ bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa'i gnyen srol de gnas thub pa'i rgyu mtshan khyim tshang gi ngal nus dang rgyu nor kha thor mi 'gro ba'i ched du yin pa ma zad/ da dung srol rgyun gyi khyim rgyud kyi 'du shes des gnyen srol 'di nyid dar gnas thub rgyur shugs rkyen chen po thebs yod/ 'on kyang srol rgyun gyi 'du shes de yang gong gsal rgyu mtshan de gnyis kyi rmang gzhi'i thog chags gnas thub pa ma zad nas pa'ang thon gyi yod/ bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa'i gnyen srol dar khul du bu spun gnyis sam gsum las med pa kha thor du song tshe 6 bkra shis ma song mizhes ma shis pa'i don la brtsi la/ nam rgyun du khyim tshang kha gyes pa dang / bu spun so sor phyin pa/ mi shi skyon chag byung na tsa bkra ma shes song mi zhes brjod srol yod/ de las ldog ste bu spun ga tshad kyis mang1 72 yod pa mna' ma gcig la 'khor ba dang 'cham mthun mnyam gnas

byung tshe de ni ya rab bzang po'i spyod bzang du brtsi la ‘ bu spun gnyis stag mo kha 'phrod yin/ bu kha thor khyi shig sbar gang yin mi zhes bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byas nas 'khon med gnas thub pa na kun gyi smon yul du brtsi yi yod/lhag par du bud med gcig gis bu spun rnams la phyogs zhen med pa rang gi mtha' 'khor du 'cham gnas thub na bud med der spyi tshogs kyi bsngags brjod thob pa ma zad/ de khul gyi bud med rnams kyi dmigs dper gyur gyi yod/ gal srid bud med gcig bu spun la mna' mar mnyam bsu byas rjes des bu spun tshang mar bstun mkhas ma thub par bu spun kha gyes tshe der spyi tshogs dang lhag don du dud tshang de'i gon rabs rnams kyis kha brdung drag po gtong nges red/ de ni pha ma'i bka' bkod la ma nyan pa dang / pha mar bsnyen bkur med pa'i spyod tshul du brtsi yi yod/ de yang dper na/ pa snam rdzong bkra shar shang gi rdo zur tshang la bu spun gnyis yod par pha mas bu rgan pa'i 'dod blo ltar kho pa'i dga' rogs de mna' mar mnyam bsu byas pa red/'on kyang bu chung ba de mna' ma dang mnyam du bsdad 'dod med par grong tsho de'i bud med gzhan zhig dang dga' 'du byas/ don de pha yis shes skabs phas bu la bka' bkyon btang ba ma zad nyes brdung yang thengs 'ga' shas phog yod pa red/ shang de'i dud tshang gzhan zhig la bu bzhi yod pa la bu gsum pa phud de byings gsum la sa skya rdzong khongs nas mna' ma gcig mnyam bsu byas/ 1987lo la bu gnyis pa de grong tsho de rang gi bu mo gzhan zhig gi rjes su shor/ bu'i pha mas mna' ma la bu gnyis pa blo bkug ma thub sdu/ kha

btang bas mna' mas bu'i ma la yin lugs min lugs gsal bshad byas/bu'i ma yis bsam shes gnang rgyu lta ci khong khro langs nas mna' ma thengs gcig gtor yang myong / 1998lor yang bu bzhi pa de'ang grong tsho de'i bud med gzhan zhig dang dga' rogs sgrig der pha mas bka' bkyon gnang bsakho pa khong khro langs thog phyi byol zla ba gnyis tsam byas/ de'i skabs bu rnams kyi a khu tshe las 'das pas kho bo yang rang gi khyim la slar yang 'khor nas da bar grong tsho'i nang bsdad yod/ de dang de lta bu'i gnas tshul bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed khul gyi dmangs khrod du yongs khyab che tsam yod/khyim tshang gi dpal 'byor dang ngal nus kha thor mi 'gro ba'i ched du chags dar byung ba'i srol rgyun khyim tshang gi 'du shes des bu spun mna' ma mnyam bas byed pa'i gnyen srol 'di nyid dar gnas thub rgyur shugs rkyen chen po thebs yod/lnga/ phu nu'i mna' ma mnyam bsu'i gnyen srol skor gyi nor 'khrul gyi lta ba gnyis dgag pa/gnyen sgrig ni mi chos kun spyod kyi khongs gtogs yin te steng gi bkod pa'i khyab khongs nang gtogs pa zhig yin pas de ni dpal 'byor rmang gzhi'i rdog chags gnas thub pa dang / dar 'phel 'gro ba zhig yin/ der brten godi nā nga tshos bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa'i gnyen srol chags dar

thub pa'i rgyu rkyen rnams dbye zhib byas zin pas de gdod ma'i khyu tshogs gnyen sgrig gi lhag 'phro yin min la dpyad pa byed pa'i dgos gal che ba mi 'dug kyang da lam gnyen srol 'di nyid gdod ma'i khyu tshogs gnyen sgrig gi lhag 'phro yin zhes rig gzhung las rigs khrod du rgya bsgrags bod bsgrags su gyur yod pas der dbye zhib lam tsam byed pa'i dgos pa phra mo mthong / khyu tshogs gnyen sgrig zer ba de smyo gdod ma'i spyi tshogs kyi thog ma'i dus kyi gnyen sgrig gi rnam pa zhig yin/ de ni skyes pa khyu gcig dang bud med khyu gcig phan tshun khyo shug sgrig pa zhig yin la phrag dog med pa'i zang zing 'khrig spyod 'brel ba'i gnyen sgrig gi rnam pa zhig kyang yin/mi du'o na bod kyi bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa 'di nyid de lta bu'i gdod ma'i khyu tshogs gnyen sgrig gi lhag 'phro yin nam zer na/ de ni min/ gal srid de ltar ngos 'dzin byas na khyo gcig shug gcig gi gnyen sgrig rnam pa tshud pa'i da bar nga chos shes rtogs thub pa'i gnyen sgrig rnam pa rigs mtha' dag gdod ma'i gnyen sgrig gi lhag 'phro yin/gdod ma'i spyi tshogs kyi nang khyo gcig shug gcig gi gnyen sgrig rnam pa'ang med pa min/ dbyin ji'i bsam blo mkhas can lo'o so'o yis 〈gnyen sgrig gi gsar brje 〉zhes pa'i nang gnyen sgrig ni 66khrims srol tshud pa'i spyod tshul yin/gdod ma'i mi'i nang yod pa ma zad/ spra rigs dang de bzhin srog chags rigs sna tshogs kyi khrod du'ang gnas yod/ srog chags la'ang gnyen sgrig du spyi tshogs rig pa'i stabs bde'i tshig mdzod〉(rgya yig )thos ngos 461nang gsal/ 105

dang 'dra ba'i spyod pa yod/ de ni phru gu gso ba'i skabs su pho rigs kyi mnyam las dgos nges yin pas yin/ spyir btang thog srog chags kyi gnyen sgrig ni khyo gcig shug gcig gi gnyen sgrig yin/ grags can mi sna 'ga' shas kyi gsungs rgyun ltar na spra mi'i khrod du gnas tshul de rigs de bas de ltar yin/ 0de ltar na bu spun gyi mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa de gdod ma'i khyu tshogs gnyen sgrig gi lhag 'phro yin zhes brjod pa'i dgos pa med la de bas rgyu mtshan khungs thub cig ston rgyu med/ po'o an nan gyis ma'o ar kun gyi gnyen sgrig dang khyim tshang gi 'phel rim skor gyi chod gtam la gdeng 'jog 'di 'dra zhig gnang myong yod 6 ma'o ar kun gyis 'phel 'gyur gyi go rim 'ga' zhig legs sgrub yong ched du khyo gcig shug gcig gnyen sgrig gi rmang gzhi byas pa'i khyim tshang dang da phan shes rtogs byung ba'i khyim tshang gi rnam pa tshang ma'i dbar dbye 'byed byas rjes kun spyod kyi thon snga phyi la gzhigs te snga dus kyi rim pa 'ga' tshod dpag byas/ de rnams kyi (rim pa )bkod sgrig kyang mi byed thabs med byung / de lta bu'i rim pa smra ba des khungs btsan min pa'i rtog bzo byas yod/ khyim tshang gi sgrig 'dzugs 'ga' zhig gi rnam pa ni gzhan 'ga' zhig las rnyog 'dzing che ba yod/ da lta blta dus khyo gcig shug gcig khyim tshang gi rnam pa dag ha lam khyo mang shug mang gi rnam pa'i phyogs su 'gyur 'gro ba yod la khyo mang shug mang gi lam lugs nas khyo gcig shug gcig /bye6(gnyen sgrig gi gsar brje 〉(rgya yig )shog ngos88lagasal/

gi lam lugs la 'gyur ba'ang yod/mi dung chos pha bu dbar gyi 'bod phyogs kyi thad nas dbye zhib zhig byas na yi lo khud kyi sa khul du mi gcig gis rang gi lus skyes pha la pa pha zhes 'bod pa ma zad/ pha'i nye rgyang med pa'i bu spun rnams la'ang tshang mar pa pha zhes 'bod kyi yod la/ pha rnams kyis rang gi phru gu ngo ma dang rang gi nye rgyang med pa'i bu spun gyi phru gu tshang mar rang gi bu dang bu mo zhes 'bod kyi yod/ 'on kyang ye lo khud kyi sa khul du khyo gcig shug gcig gi gnyen sgrig lag bstar byed kyi yod pas mi so so'i skyes pa'i pha ngo ma su yin min rtsa ba'i cha nas ngo shes thub nges red/ gnad don 'di'i thad ma'o ar kun gyis 'bod tshul 'di rigs ni 'das pa'i dus kyi gnyen tshan 'brel ba'i 'khrul ba med pa'i zin bkod yin/ de yang pha rgyud dam ma rgyud kyi nye rgyang med pa'i bu spun tsho pa gcig dang de dang khrag rgyud kyi 'brel ba med pa'i pha rgyud dam ma rgyud kyi nye rgyang med pa'i bu mo spun tsho pa gcig gnyen sdeb byas pa las byung ba'i gnyen 'brel gyi zin bkod yin zhes dgongs kyi yod/'bod tshul gzhan zhig la bod kyi spyi tshogs khrod kyi bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa'i sa khul de rnams tshang ma'i nang mna' ma la skyes pa'i bu phrug rnams kyis skyes pa'i pha ngo ma su yin rung pha rnams las rgan 'go la pa pha'am a pa zhes 'bod pa dang / gzhan pa rnams la a khu zhes 'bod par ma zad yul 'ga' shas su pha'i nye rgyang med pa'i pha rgyud dam ma rgyud kyi pha'i bu spun rnams du me gling sa cha de ga'i khang pa dang khyim tshang gi 'tsho ga〉zhesapa'i (gling gzhi 〉nang gsal/ 107

tshang mar a khu zhes 'bod kyi yod/ gal srid gzhan gyis bshad pa ltar bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byas pa de gdod ma'i khyu tshogs gnyen sgrig gi lhag 'phro yin na mna' ma mnyam bsu byed mkhan gyi bu spun rnams tshang mar a pa'am pa pha zhes 'bod mi dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/ 'bod tshul de rnams kyi 'byung khungs gang yin zhes na de ni stes dbang gis stabs 'khel byung ba'i bod kyi gnyen 'brel 'bod tshul min la bod mi dmangs kyi 'phrul snang gi thon rdzas kyang min par de ni 66'das pa'i dus kyi gnyen tshan 'brel ba'i 'khrul ba med pa'i zin bkod yin/ de cung gsal bar bshad na bod kyi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i lo rgyus kyi dus rim gang 'tsham zhig nang da lta'i bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa'i gnyen srol dar khul tshud bod yongs kyi gnyen sgrig rnam pa'i nang bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa'i snang tshul thon med pa'am bod kyi gnyen srol gi rnam pa ni khyo gcig shug gcig gi gnyen sgrig rnam pa gcig rkyang yin pa mtshon gyi yod/ bod kyi spyi tshogs lam lugs la 'gyur ba 'gro ba dang spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed 'brel ba la rgyun chad med pa'i 'gyur ba byung ba/ khor yug cha rkyen nyin re bzhin 'gyur ba 'gro ba bcas dang bstun nas khyim rgyud kyi khe phan kho na'i skul slong 'og bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa'i gnyen srol 'di nyid dar ba yin/ don 'dir lo shas sngon la 'gan gtsang lam lugs lag bstar byas rjes bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa'i gnad don yul 'ga' shas su tshabs che ru phyin pa des kyang ra 'phrod gang 'ardoshā /ba nges yin/ bod kyi gnyen sgrig lam srol gyi 'phel rim des po'o

an nan gyi gsungs pa'i smyo khyo gcig shug gcig khyim tshang gi rnam pa dag ha lam khyo mang shug mang gi rnam pa'i phyogs su 'gyur 'gro ba yod pa'i chod gtam la don dngos kyi rgyab snon byung ba gsal po mthong ngo /bod kyi yul du dar ba'i bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa'i gnyen srol gyi rnam pa'i mngon tshul la blta skabs spyir pha ma gcig las skyes pa'i bu spun la mna' ma mnyam du bsu mkhan sha stag yin pa las pha rgyud kyi bu spun nam ma rgyud kyi bu spun la mna' ma mnyam bsu byed mkhan med/ 'on kyang yul 'ga' shas su pha ma gcig las skyes pa'i bu spun phrug gi bu spun la mna' ma mnyam bsu byed mkhan re gnyis rig rgyu yod pa rnams kyi bu'i ma rnams khag khag so so yin/ gsham du nga tshos dud tshang gnyis kyi gnas tshul zur tsam bkod rgyu la/pa snam rdzong mag shang stag sgo tshang gi gnas tshul bkod rgyu la mig dmar gyi pha ma gnyis la bsdoms bu phrug bcu bzhi skyes/ de'i nang nas bcu gnyis gson thub pa byung la bu phyed bu mo phyed yin pa dang / bu drug las gnyis pa dpal ldan chos grags grwa pa byas/ bzhi pa spen rnam bud med gzhan zhig dang rang mos dga' 'du byas nas thab gsar btsugs/ de min bu spun bzhi la mna' ma tshe sgrol mnyam bsu byas/ 'on kyang khong tshor bu dngos grub dang bu mo gsum las ma byung la mig dmar gyi gcen po rgan pa gsum dang zla bo tshe sgrol rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs dka' sdug 'og dar ma'i skabs snga rjes su tshe las 'das/ mig dmar gyi gcen po spen rnam la bu bzhi da ༵ mo

gsum byung la bu gsum pa bu chog ni mig dmar gyi bu dngos grub dang lo khyad chung ba zhig byung / de nas bu chog lo bcu'i skabs mig dmar gyi bu tshab la slong / dngos grub kyi rogs pa yin zer/ dngos grub dang bu chog gnyis nar son skabs khong gnyis la mna' ma mnyam bsu byas yod la da lta khong tshor bu gnyis dang bu mo gcig skyes yod/(khyim tshang gi gnyen gyi 'brel ba'i ri mo rgyab tu shog ngos 119la gsal/)pa snam rdzong mag shang rta ra tshang gi sri tshe'i pha la nu bo gcig rang las byung med la khong phu nu gnyis gtan grogs so sor btsal nas 'tsho ba skyel/'on kyang phu bo la bu sri tshe gcig rang las ma skyes pa dang nu bo la bu gsum byung / phu bos nu bo'i bu rgan pa chos mkhas sri tshe'i rogs par slong pa dang /khong gnyis la mnyam du mna' ma bsus par bu phug drug byung ba dang bu drug po der mna' ma gcig rang mnyam bsu byas nas da lta phru gu gsum tsam byung yod/ nu bor da dung bu bar pa dang chung ba gnyis yod pas khong gnyis la mna' ma mnyam bsu byas nas da lta bu phrug bzhi tsam yod pa las bu gsum dang bu mo gcig yin/ 'on kyang da lta bu rnams la mna' ma bsu rgyu yin/(khyim tshang gi gnyen gyi 'brel ba'i ri mo rgyab tu shog ngos 119la gsal/)gong gsal dud tshang de gnyis kyi gnas tshul mdor bshad nas nga tshos shes thub par bu spun chung ma so sor btsal rjes phu bo'am nu bo gcig la bu gcig las ma byung ba dang gzhan der bu gsum bzhi byung tshe nyung bas mang bar bu /shāg bu tshab lta bur slong nas rang gi bu dang mnyam du mna' ma bsu yi

yod/ 'on kyang gsal bshad byed rgyur pha ma gcig las skyes pa'i bu spun phrug gi bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed mkhan yod pa las pha ma gcig las skyes pa'i bu dang bu mo'i bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed mkhan med la bu spun phrug gi bu'i bu mna' ma mnyam bsu byed mkhan yang med pa dang bu mo spun phrugagi bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed pa sogs da lam brtag dpyad byed khul gyi sa khul du rig rgyu med do/ /gzhan yang blo mthun 'ga' shas kyis bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu'i gnyen srol 'di dang 'brel yod kyi gnad don gcig la yang mi dag pa'i brjod tshul 'dug pa dper na/ phyi rgyal 'ga' shas dang rgya rigs blo mthun 'ga' shas kyis bod kyi lugs srol la bu spun mna' ma thun mong du len skabs bu mo de khyim tshang che ba'am 6 rigs rgyud mtho ba mi las slong thabs byed kyi yod ces brjod la/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni bu mo'i gnas babs mtho bas bu spun tshang mar mtho gnon byed ched du yin zer ba dang / yang 'ga' shas kyis bu mo'i khyim gyi rgyu dngos la rngams nas slong ba red ces ha cang stabs bde pos tshig thag bcad yod/ don de mi rigs gzhan gyi skye bo'i lta tshul ltar na ha lam 'dra chags po 'dra yod nges kyang / nga tshos dmangs srol 'di nyid dar khyab yod pa'i yul lung 'di'i mi dmangs kyi lta tshul dngos dang de dang 'brel yod kyi lugs srol rnams la dpyad pa zhig byed dus gong gsal brjod tshul de dag tsa rang myong mi jus 'ding ba mi'am zhwa dpe lham 'gebs byas pa tsam las/gnas tshul dngos ma rtogs shing bod kyi bu spun la mna' ma mnyam bstu spyad

pa'i yul gyi spyi tshogs la yang dag pa'i blta zhib byas nas byung ba'i 'bras bu zhig ye nas min/ bod rigs kyi rgyun srol lta tshul la khyim tshang che ba'am 6 rigs rgyud mtho ba'i ’ skye bo tshang ma bya ba gang thad spyod lugs bzang bar dgongs kyi yod/ dper na 6 skyes sas yar 'then/ spyod pas mar 'then mi zhes pa'i gtam dpe las kyang 6 skyes sa mtho ba yin pa na spyod pa'ang bzang po yod dgos pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pa mngon yod/ der brten bu spun mang por mna' ma thun mong du bsu skabs 6 skyes sa mtho ba mi yi bu mo de rigs 'tshol thabs byed kyi yod pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / mna' ma thun mong du blangs pa des bu spun tshang mar bstun mkhas kyis khyo bo tshang mar yo 'khyog dbyer ba med pa'i 6 brtse dung bzung ste khyim du thab gcig la 'khor nas 'tsho ba mnyam skyel yong ba'i re ba byed kyi yod pa mtshon pa tsam las/ mna' mas bu spun tshang mar mtho gnon byed ched du ga la yin/ mi dmangs kyi lta tshul 'dir rgyu mtshan med pa ma yin te/ gnyen sgrig lugs srol 'di nyid dar ba'i yul lung tshang mar khyim tshang che ba'am phyug pa'i bu spun rnams la mna' ma mnyam bsu byed mkhan ca/nga zhing / bu spun mna' ma mnyam bsu byed mkhan gyi dud tshang mang che ba rgyu nor cung phyug pa'i khyim tshang sha stag yin pa gong smos ltar yin/ des na khyim tshang de rigs kyi bu mo tshos kyang so so'i pha ma spun mched kyi gnyen sgrig bya lugs dang / zla bo skyong lugs/ khyim gzhis 'dzin tshul rnams dngos su mthong thos byung yod pas/ de dag las kyang myong tshor bsdidī ༵ gting zab po lon nges yin pa ni kun gyis mkhyen gsal lags/

der brten bod mi mang po'i lta tshul la khyim tshang che ba'i bu mo de bu spun gyi thun mong gi mna' mar byung na khyo bo tshang mar bstun mkhas pas de rigs la brtson len dang re ba byed pa'i bya spyod de byung ba lags so/ /spyir bod kyi lugs la 6 a ma'i nu rin pang gdan/ gangs can dmangs kyi lugs srol ’ zhes pa ltar bu'i khyim nas bu mo'i yab yum la nu rin phran tsam dang / bu mo'i yum chen la pang gdan gcig sprod srol yod pa ma gtogs/ mi rigs gzhan ltar gnyen rten 'di dang 'di dgos pa yod ces ha lam sha rus las chas pa'i bu mo des rin chen rgyu nor nyo ba'i ngang tshul de bod rigs kyi lugs la med pa dang / bu mo mna' mar ster skabs bu mo'i skal rdzong rnams bu mo'i pha mas gang gnang ba de las bu'i khyim gyis ster go 'di dang de dgos zhes re ba ston srol med pa de nas kyang khyim tshang che ba'i bu mo bu spun gyi mna' mar btsal ba de rgyu dngos kho nar rngams pa min pa shes thub kyi yod/ de yang 6 phyug po ser sna che zhes pa'i ngag rgyun ltar rgyu phyug pa'i khyim tshang gi bu mo'i skal rdzong che ba'i nges pa med pa ni don dngos mang dag cig gis ra 'phrod thub nges yin/ bod mi rigs kyi khrod du mna' ma'am dga' rogs btsal skabs bu mo'i ngang rgyud ring min dang / las 'jon thang che min la blta ba las bu mo'i phyi rnam pa dang / rgyu phyug min la gtsor 'dzin byed kyi med/ lhag par du bu spun la mna' ma mnyam bsu byed skabs de bas bu mo'i nang gi bsam pa bzang min gtso don du bzung gi yod pa ni gnyen srol 'di nyid dar khyab yod pa'i spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i thog nas mngos1 sdub

bo/ /nga tshos shes rtogs dgos par/ mi rigs gang 'dra zhig yin rung der rang rang gi 'jig rten lta tshul dang / phugs bsam/ kun spyod kyi dpe tshad 'dzin sa bcas yod nges yin/ 'on kyang rang mi rigs kyi dpe tshad de khyer nas gzhan mi rigs kyi rig gnas la tshod 'jal byed pa de/ kun gyi dor byar 'os pa'i rig pa'i dpyad thabs shig yin/ nga tshos nges par du blo rtsar bzung dgos pa ni mi rigs gang gi rig gnas ga ge mo brjod par 'dod tshe/nges par mi rigs de ga'i spyi tshogs kyi rig gnas gzhan la shes rtogs dgos pa ma zad/ de'i rmang gzhi'i steng blo drang zol med kyi bsam pa khyer te rig pas dpyad pa byas na don dngos dang mthun pa'i drang bden gyi sdom tshig cig thob thub/ de las ldog ste spyi tshogs dngos kyi zur cha tsam la'ang rang nyid ngo mas nyams zhib med par go thos kho na'i rjes su 'brangs te rang mi rigs kyi lugs su yod pa'i gnad don dag khyer te bya dngos kyi gnas babs la bsam gzhigs ma byas par ra mgo lug bsgar gyis gzhan gyi kun spyod la tshod 'jal byas na/ des rgyu mtshan dngos de bshad mi thub bo/ /114

stag sgo tshang gi gnyen gyi 'brelaba'i 'phelatshulari mo/dhe ji / thong — —— 2 —rjo1 4042 40tho/ lku/1mig dmar/ 〉spen rnam/ 1dngos grub/ 2bu chogarta ra tshang gi gnyen gyi 'brelaba'i 'phelatshulari mo/ — — 1 tho 12 ———gotho nga ྈ ྈྈ1sri tshe/ 2chos mkhas/5

bzhi pa/ srol rgyun gnyen ston dang gnyen bshad rig rtsed skor/gcig srol rgyun gnyen ston gyi don snying brjod pa/de yang gnyen sgrig mdzad sgo ni yul goms gshis lugs rig pa'i thog nas dbye na/ 'di ni spyi tshogs yul srol gyi nang gses tshe gang hril po'i 'jig rten 'gro lugs kyi mdzad sgo'i khungs su gtogs pa zhig yin/ tshe gang hril po'i 'jig rten 'gro lugs kyi mdzad sgo ni chung byis pa skyes pa nas na rgas tshe las 'das pa'i bar gyi mi'i gnas skabs so sor dus rim gang du son na/ de la spyi tshogs kyis khas len pa dang / gdeng 'jog bzang po zhig yong ched du spel ba'i mdzad sgo zhig yin/ de'i brgyud rim ni mi'i lo'i 'phel rim nas mngon thub kyi yod/ ma gzhi tshe gang hril po'i nang mdzad sgo 'di 'dra ha cang mang po yod kyang / lhag par gal che ba'i mdzad sgo ni mi'i lo grangs gnad che ba'i dus rim la slebs pa de nas byung / der brten mi'i rigs kyi 'tsho ba'i nang spyir khas len brtsi srung byed pa'i mdzad sgo'i srol rgyun bzhi yod/de do~X btsas ston dang / na dar ba'i ston mo/ gnyen sgrig dga' ston/

'das mchod kyi byed sgo bcas lags so/ de dang phyogs mtshungs par/gangs ri'i ra bas bskor ba'i sman ljongs 'dir yang / yongs grags su brtsi srung byed pa'i byed sgo gsum yod/ de rnams ni bang sel dang / gnyen sgrig dga' ston/ 'das mchod bcas lags shing(a mdo sa khul du bud med gzhon nu ma lo bcu bdun la son skabs/ skra ston zhes pa'i ston mo zhig spel srol 'dug pa de'i ngo bo la gzhigs na na dar ba'i ston mo yin/) 'tsho ba'i brgyud rim nang gi gnyen sgrig mdzad sgo de dang / skyes 'chi'i byed sgo bang sel dang 'das mchod gnyis bar khyad par chen po yod/ gnyen sgrig mdzad sgo ni gnyen du sgrig pa po pho mo zung mdzad sgo'i nang go gnas thob thang che ba dang / bag ma dang khyo bo gnyis gtso bor 'dzin pa'i mdzad sgo zhig yin/bang sel dang / 'das mchod gnyis ni lhums kyi rgya las grol ma thag pa'i zho 'thung byis pa dang / tshe las 'das pa'i gshin po des don dngos byed sgo'i nang spyi tshogs kyi bya ba gang yang byas med par spun mched dkar nye gtso bor byed pa'i byed sgo zhig red/ der brten gnyen sgrig mdzad sgo ni tshe gang hril po'i ha cang gal che ba'i mdzad sgo zhig yin/ rang re'i sngon byon dang yang mesarnams kyis de la mi rabs gcig gi gtan 'dun zhes tshe gang hril po'i don chen gcig tu brtsi ba ni rgyu mtshan med pa zhig min/ gnyen sgrig mdzad sgo spel bar brten spyi tshogs kyis pho mo gnyen sgrig mkhan gnyis kyis dro skyid ldan pa'i khyim gsar pa zhig bzung ba khas len yong gi yod la de lugs mthun yin pa'i gdeng 'jog bzang po zhig yong gi yod/ des na gnyen sgrig1 /chod
