sgo ni gsar du khyim 'dzugs byas pa'i mtshon rtags shig yin pas der rten 'brel byed pa'i mdzad sgo ni tshe gang hril po'i mdzad sgo'i nang 6 dus skabs phye ba'i mdzad sgo zhig yin/ gnyen sgrig dang khyim 'dzugs byed pa ni mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs dang 'tsho ba'i rtsa ba'i rnam pa zhig yin zhing / 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi rigs rus 'chol bar mi spyod pa'i byed thabs shig yin/ de spyi tshogs kun gyis khas len yong ched pha ma nye du tshang 'dzoms sar chang sa'i rten 'brel gyi byed sgo de legs par spel ba red/ de ni gzhon nu pho mo gnyis gzhon so dkar dus nas rgan skra dkar gyi bar phan tshun gcig phan gcig grogs dang / mdza' mthun dar gyi mdud pa nam yang mi lhod pa'i 'dun pa mtshon pa zhig red/ dper na/ 〈gtam padma'i tshal gyi zlos gar snyanang 66sngar gtam dar gyi mdud pa de/ da dung ma grol dam lags sam/ zhe 'dod rdo yi ri mo de/ da dung ma zum bkra lags sam/ dam bca' snying gi phur pa de/ da dung ma bud brtan lags sam/ mizhes pa lta bu'o/ gzhan yang gnyen ston mdzad sgo spel bas lugs dang lugs min gyi dbye ba phye ste gnyen sgrig gi bya ba de bzhin gyi gtsang ba padma'i sbubs dang 'dra ba zhig mtshon byar gyur pa la phan pa shin tu che/ pho mo gnyen sgrig byas nas khyim 'dzugs byas pa ni mi'i rigs kyispya tshogs rgyun chad med pa mu mthud 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i srog rtsa yin na gnyen ston ni spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas 'gro bar dgos nges kyi mdzad sgo zhig kyang yin pas mi rigs tshang mas mdzad sgo 'di la dmigs bsam gyi mthong chen po byed1 snyi 8yod/ rang yul sman ljongs 'dir yang yul lung kun dang 'dra bar

mdzad sgo 'di la dmigs bsal brtse mthong byed pa ma zad/ tshang mas rgyas gtong byed kyi yod/ gal srid gnyen sgrig skabs rten 'brel ma byas tshe 6 khyi rul sgo mtshang mi zhes 'phya smod byed kyi yod/ mdor na gnyen ston ni pho mo gnyen du sgrig pa po gnyis kyis gsar du khyim 'dzugs byas pa'am/ de gnyis lugs mthun gyi khyo shug chags par bkra shes rten 'brel byas pa zhig yin la/gnyen ston mdzad sgo spel ba'i dngos yod kyi nus pa ni pho mo gnyen sgrig mkhan gnyis kyi pho mo'i 'brel ba de lugs mthun yin pa spyi tshogs la gsal bsgrags byas pa zhig yin la de nas bzung pho mo de gnyis khyim thab yin par spyi tshogs kyis khas len byed kyi yod/ khrims srol 'thus tshang min pa'i rgyal khab dang /mi rigs kyi khrod du gnyen ston mdzad sgos gnyen sgrig lag khyer gyi nus pa thon gyi yod/mi rgyud sa bon btab pa'i gnyen sgrig 'di/ /spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i srog rtsa lags/ /de'i tshe kun la gnyen sgrig gsal brda'i phyir/ /spel ba'i mdzad sgo rlabs chen snying pos brgyan/ /gnyis/ srolargyun gnyen ston gyi rgyud rim dang po gnyen slong ba'i byed sgo/gangs can bod la gna' snga mo nas bu la mna' ma len pa dardo /19 bu

mor mag pa bsu ba'i lugs srol zung du mchis gshes khyim so so'i gnas tshul dang bstun nas mna' mag gtong len byed pa spyi lugs su yod kyang / spyir bu mo mna' mar gtong mkhan shas che ba dang / rang dbang gnyen sgrig dang btsan dbang gnyen sgrig zung du ldan rung pha mas ster slong byed pa'i bka' bkod gnyen srol shas che ba/ sa khul so so'i goms srol mi 'dra ba dang /khyim dud so so'i 'byor pa che chung mi 'dra ba'i rkyen gyis gnyen ston mdzad sgo rgyas bsdus 'bring gsum dang byed stangs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod kyang / bkra shis pa'i don chen zhes rang nas gang yod ci thub kyis rgyas gtong byed mkhan shas che ba yod/ der brten 'dir yul lung tshang ma'i gnyen ston gyi rgyud rim re re bzhin bkod pa'i dgos pa ma mchis pas pha mas bka' bkod byas pa'i bu mo bag mar gtong ba'i gtsang khul gyi gnyen ston rgyud rim mdor bsdus pos bkod rgyu yin/dud tshang zhig gi bu zhig lang tsho dar la babs nas 'jig rten gnyen sgrig gi byed sgo ran pa'i skabs su bu'i khyim gyi dkar nye do chod pa gcig gis bu'i pha ma'i bka' mngags bzhin rigs rus go gnas dang / rgyu nor dbul phyug sog gang cir bu'i phyogs dang do mnyam pa'i bu mo 'ga'i pha ma'i drung nas bu mo'i lo rtags ji yin shes thabs byed pa dang dus mtshungs bu mo dang 'dris che ba'i grong pa khyim mtshes dang / dkar nye grogs gsum gyi sa nas bu mo de'i nam rgyun gyi gshes rgyud bzang min 'dri rtsad gcod pa dang / bgres song rnam1sdu spya drung nas sha rus kyi 'brel ba yod med bka' 'dri zhus rjes blo mos

su song ba'i bu mo de'i lo rtags de khyer nas bla ma dang chos skyong la 'phrod lam yod med mo lung thugs dam zhu ba dang / rtsis pa'i mdun du bag rtsis kyi 'bras bu gtan phab byas/ de rjes gong du brtag zhib byas pas bzung babs su byung ba'i bu mo de'i pha ma'i drung du rtsad gcod byed mi des phyin nas dkar gtsang bkra shis pa'i rdzas kha btags phul ba dang sbrags khyed tsho'i bu mo bzhin bzang ma che ge mo 'di nged tsho gnas khang ga ge mo'i bu che ge mo'i mdun thabs su mo lung rtsis gsum gcig mthun bzang phebs byung ba ma zad/ sngar nas re 'dun zhus yod pas da cha de rang la gtan 'khel go ster yong ba zhu zhes thog ma'i gleng slong byed/ mos mthun tshe bu mo slong mkhan dang / bu mo'i pha ma gnyis gros bsdur gleng mol gyis slong chang (lab chang )nam 'dren gza' skar tshes grangs bzang ba zhig la dus bkag bzo srol yod/ dus bkag de 'char ba'i nyin mor/ bu'i khyim tshang gi ngo tshab pa de rogs zla re gnyis dang bcas gzab mchor gyis brgyan nas bu mo'i khyim du yong / bu mo'i pha ma spun mched sogs nang mi tshang ma bzhugs gral la 'khod thog mdun lcog gi steng du rten 'brel gyi gro ma 'bras sil lam phye mar bsgrigs/ bu mo'i nang mi tshang mar mjal dar dang / 'ga' res gyon chas sne re phul/ lhag par du bu mo'i a mar mjal dar phul ba tsam ma zad/ nu rin zhes bu'i khyim gyi 'byor par gzhigs pa'i dngul phran bu dang bang gdan 'ja' ris ltar bkra ba gcig nges par dmigs bkar gyis 'bul dgos/ de nas bu phyogs kyi ngo tshab de dang bu mo'i pha ma dang bu mo'i phyogs kyi ngo tshab bcas lhan 'dzoms nas1 /spyan

yig 'bri ba dang der ming rtags bkod rjes bu mo ster bsu'i dus tshod bkag nas slong chang gtong mkhan log 'gro ba'i srol yod/gtsang gi yul 'ga' shas su bu mo'i lo rtags brtsis zhib byed skabs dang / go ster zhu ba'i thog ma'i gleng slong byed skabs kyang bu'i ngo tshab nas chang 'khyer srol yod pas 'ga' res slong chang thengs ma gsum gtong ba'i srol yod ces brjod srol yod/ bu mo mna' mar slong ba'i byed sgo 'dir slong chang ngam lab chang zer dgos don gang lags zhe na/ bu mo mna' mar slong bar 'gro skabs chang ston bsgrigs kyi yod pas ming 'di dar ba yin la/ bod kyi dmangs khrod byed sgo mang po'i tha snyad chang dang 'brel nas yod pa ni skyel chang / mgron chang / phebs chang / bsu chang / thog chang / thab chang /sdug chang / rogs chang zhes pa lta bu'o/ yul 'ga' shas su slong chang rten 'brel byed srol yod pa dang / yul 'ga' shas su slong chang 'dren pa tsam las dmigs su rten 'brel gyi mdzad sgo spel srol med la/ bu'i phyogs nas bu mo'i a mar nu rin dang pang gdan kha btags dang bcas pa phul ba las nang mi gzhan rnams la kha btags dang gos sne sprod srol med/ nu rin ni bu mo de chung dus a ma'i 'o mas gsos pas 'o ma'i rin yin tshul dang / pang gdan ni bu mo de chung dus a ma'i pang du nyar bas pang gdan mang po zad yod pas de'i dod yin tshul yin/ don du de dag tshang ma gsos rin yin khul yin/gnyen yig ni gnyen sgrig gi gan rgya yin pas dud tshang che gras rnams kyis ma gardo/sdu phal pa'i dud tshang rnams kyis gnyen yig 'jog srol med/ gnyen

yig gi nang gtso bo bgres song rnams kyis gzhon skyes la bka' bslab byams skyong dang / gzhon skyes nas yab yum la bkur sti/ khyo shug phan tshun gus brtse byed lugs bcas kyi bslab bya bstan yod/ de lta bu'i gnyen yig la 66phal che ba gnyen yig tu kha g.yar ba tsam las don la 'khor ba rmi lam gyi spun zlar yid brtan med stabs gal te kha bral du gyur na/ phan tshun rtsod pa'i lab 'ju shor dogs ma rung khog zhugs kyi gan rgya rwa co 'dra ba 'dra gnyis 'jog srol dar ba mi 0yin zhes pa'i gdeng 'jog gnang mkhan yod rung / gnyen yig 'jog pa'i srol 'dir yang 'di rang gi dge mtshan ldan yod/ gsham du nga tshos gnyen yig gi gtso bo'i nang don dum bu gcig dper grangs pa na/6 yul chen po thams cad kyi bzang po'i srol du dar ba bzhin 'dir yang phan tshun mtho ba'i rigs su mnyam pa sger dkar sa yi thig le7 pa'i sras ༅kyi thugs mdun mchis 'brang du sger pa'i sras mo lugs bzhin khab tu bzhes par gal che pa la nan tan gyi dpe bzhin thog mar gnyis ku'i thugs mos gtso bor gyur pas bslu med bla lhar mo lung rtsis gsum gyis gtan 'bebs dang bcas slong sbyin mdzad sgo'i rim pa srol mthun sngon du grub pa'i zhung sa dngos gzhi kun 'dzin ces pas byi hor zla tshes gza' skar 'byung 'phrod dge ba'i nyin ji ltar mi'am ci'i dbang phyug gi sras mo yid 'phrog ma sa skyong nor bu bzang la bzhin du ster cha skyes tho zur gsal dang du yig bskur rnam gzhag 〉shog ngosaphril gsal/ 123

bcas bsu bzhes mdzad rgyur/ bkra shis dga' ston gyi sgo 'phar dngos dbye ba 'di nas bzung sku ngo bgres pa rnams nas sras steng zhal la byams brtse'i spyan ras sras phyogs su ma lhung pas tshul spyod la ngang gi 'jug cing tshul min las shugs kyis ldog pa'i gcun khyab mdzad 'os sha tshar gtam snyan med zer ba ltar 'jam rtsub skabs gang ran mdzes mtshon med pa'i dbu 'don bka' bslab stsal rgyu/ sras mo kyang yab yum la thugs mthun bkur sti zol med kyi sgo nas mdor na bka' ci gnang dang du len rgyu ma zad mchis 'brang la thugs brtse gcig gtod min pa'i grogs zur bsten dang myos byed rtsed 'jor bag med sogs skyid sdug gi blo rtse gang la gtad pa'i thugs mthun sun 'byin yid gcod du 'gro ba'i smad 'os ma rabs kyi spyod ngan rigs nam kun tu mi mdzad/lcam nas kyang yab yum thun mong du spyi khur thog bdag po rigs sras la sku skyed rgyas man gyi brtsi mkhas dang 'brel gus brtse lhod med las/ gtso bor tshugs ma thub dang nga rtags su bkod pa'i spyod rengs sogs thugs zhe dkrugs pa'i rigs dang / zhabs 'don thams cad nye ring byams 'tshos 'dor ba'i gleng tsam med par tshul ldan bsngags 'os kyi spyod pa lhur bzhes mdzad rgyu bcas mdor na tshang mas 'jig rten ya rabs kyi lugs bzang dam gtsang bgres slob gzhon gsan mthun po mched bzhi'i ngang tshul la gzhol ba ma gtogs/ 'dod khyer tha dad sogs rang drin rang la chung du 'jug pa'i tshul min rigs yi ge'i lam las bsgrags min la mi ltos par zhar (gzhar)yang1 ༵༵da rgyu med cing phyogs phyogs nas gzur gnas kyi yang rtser son pas

bdag skyid la gzhan smon pa'i yul gcig par gyur pa bkra shes lugs legs 'ba' zhig gis sku tshe hril mthar 'khyol nges mdzad rgyur legs pa'i phyogs la dgongs dbyangs ma bgros gcig tu mthun pa'i ched rgya btsan pos bsdoms pa 'di las mi 'da'/mi duzhes pa lta bu'o/ gong du drangs pa'i gnyen yig gi nang don dum bu 'dis gnyen du sgrig pa po khyo shug gnyis dang / de 'brel rgan rabs rnams kyi slad phyin gyi bya lugs byed stangs kyi bslab bya gang mang bkod yod pa rnams kyis mdza' mthun mthun pa spun bzhi ltar rang skyid gzhan smon pa'i sgo nas mi tshe mtha' 'khyol yong rgyur sman pa che la/ tshul min spyod ngan dang ma shes pa'i bya ba rigs tha dag la chu ma shor gong la rags kyi dpe ltar sngon 'gog gi nus pa ldan yod/ mdor na gnyen yig gis gnyen sgrig mkhan dang de 'brel mi sna mi tshe hril po thab gcig la 'khor nas 'tsho sdod byed ring tshang ma'i bya spyod la 'ching shugs chen po ldan yod/ gnyen yig gi dge mtshan 'di la bltas na dus phyis kyi khra chil sba chil gyi spyi tshogs 'di'i nangakhyo shug bar gyi 'brel ba de tshod 'dzin rang bzhin ldan pa'i gnyen yig ltar gyi rgya btsan po zhig gis gcun thabs byed rgyu byung na lugs min khrims 'gal gyi bya spyod mang po thon pa dang / bza' tshang ya bral du 'gro ba'i spyi tshogs kyi gnad don chen po 'dir sngon 'gog gi nus pa thon nges red/ de bzhinaganyen yig 'bri ba'i srol yod pa 'di nas bod pa rnams kyis mi tshe'i du yig bskur rnam gzhag 〉shog ngos84nang gsal/ 125

don chen thabs shes zung 'brel gyi bya ba dag la yun ring tan tig gi rnam 'gyur 'dzin gyi yod pa mtshon yod/gsum/ srol rgyun gnyen ston gyi rgyud rim gnyis pa gnyen lam gyi byed sgo/sngar nas dus bkag zin pa'i bag bsu dngos gzhi'i nyi ma ma tshes gong gi nyin gcig gam gnyis thog bu'i phyogs kyi bsu mi sku tshab rnams bu mo'i khyim du slebs nas 'ga' res sgo dang / them skas/ ka ba bcas la bshad pa phul ba dang mchod chang mchod bzhin thugs spro'i dbyings su tshud la bu mo'i rogs mo dang grong pa khyim mtshes/ dkar nye spun mched rnams kyis dkar gtsang kha btags dang lag sne phran bu khyer nas bu mor phebs skyel lam zhal gyes zhu bar yong la yul 'ga' shas su der 6 ltogs zan skur 〉zer srol yang yod/ bu mo gnas la ma thon gong du bu mo'i skra 'khru ba'i srol yod la/ yul 'ga' shas su nyin der (yul 'ga' shas su mna' ma slong ba'i skabs bu mo'i pha mas bu mo blos 'khrol byung rjes )bu'i phyogs nas khyer yong ba'i gtsug g.yu de bu mo'i spyi gtsug gi rgyan du sgron srol yod la bshad pa'ang smyo yi sā sti/ bde legs su gyur cig rigs stobs dpal 'byor mnga' thang lang tsho tshogs/ g.yang gi rtsi zhag kun chags bro dkar g.yu/ de ring mdzes ma'i gtsug tu phul ba 'dis/bkra1 spras dge mtshan gong nas gong du 'phel shog ces gtong srol yod pa'am

yang na 66yi su sti/ bde legs su gyur cig bkra shis mi 'gyur bkra shis shogadakon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog lha dang bla ma'i bkra shis shog yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi bkra shis shog ma mi 'gyur tsan dan gyi sdong po la/dman mi 'gyur tsan dan gyi 'bras bu 'khrungs/ tsan dan 'bras bu longs su spyod dbang de/ pha bzang bu la ma gtogs yod le min/ nga'i lag tu bzung ba'i g.yu chung 'di/ rin chen po sprad nas nyos pa yin/ rin chen pos nyos pa'i g.yu chung 'di/ don chen po bsgrub pa'i rten 'brel du/ khyed bu mo'i dbu la sgron zer na/ nor bdag por thob pa'i rten 'brel dang / gnyen bu rgyud skyong ba'i rten 'brel sogs/ nged bsam don bsgrub pa'i rten 'brel yod/mi ces gtong srol yod/ bu mo'i spyi gtsug tu gtsug g.yu sgron pa de ni nyin de nas bzung bu mo de bu'i khyim la bdag pa'i mtshon tshul yin/ nam rgyun yul 'ga' shas su bu mo zhig chang sa brgyab yod min gyi rtags mtshan gcig ni bu mo de gtsug g.yu btags yod med nas mngon gyi yod pa'ang lha sa lta bur pang gdan brgyab yod med kyis gnyen sgrig byas yod med mtshon pa lta bu yin/sho bshad kyi nang du'ang pa ra dang sho mig bzhi dmigs skabs 66sems pa shor gyi 'dug na/ mgo la g.yu chung brgyab shog lag pa'i tshigs khebs 'phrog pa/nor 'dod langs pa yin 'gro mizhes sho bshad gtong srol yod pa las kyang mngon thub kyi yod/ bu mo ma thon gong la khyim du nang mi spun mched dang dkar nye grogs rnams 'dzoms thog bsu mi dang lhan du mchod chang mchod bzhin gzhas zhabs bro la rol ba dang / de rjes sngon rtsis la babs pas 2sta mo

gnas la thon pa'i dus la slebs skabs bsu mi des mda' dar gyi bshad pa gtong bzhin bu'i khyim nas khyer yong ba'i mda' dar bu mo'i gong bar btsugs pa dang / kha btags kyi bshad pa gtong bzhin kha btags sgron srol yod/ mda' dar gyi bshad pa ni 66'o legs so/ pho la dgos pa mda' la tshang nas yod/ mda' mo'i 'khrungs sa lho rong gting du 'khrungs/ gcod mkhan lha bu bu spun gsum gyis bcad/ gcod yas rgya zor ngar mas byas/'gel ba gsi ling drel 'ur bkal/ la lung lam 'phrang rim brgyud nas/'dren pa gangs can bod du drangs/ mda' bzo mkhas pa'i phyag tu grim/ de nas tshang pa'i lnga ldan tshang / mda' 'di la tshang pa lnga ldan zer/ mi nga la 'dzoms pa lnga 'dzoms zer/ g.yas pha ma 'dzoms pas 'dzoms pa gcigagayon bu phrug 'dzoms pas 'dzoms pa gnyis/ rgyab gnyen tshan 'dzoms pas 'dzoms pa gsum/ mdun gtan grogs 'dzoms pas 'dzoms pa bzhi/dbus rgyu nor 'dzoms pas 'dzoms pa de dang lnga/ mda' mo'i tshang pa lnga ldan ni/ lho rong gting nas thon pa'i smyug gsar de dang gcig bya rgyal rgod po'i rtse sgro de dang gnyis/ g.yang dkar lug gi rgyus skud de dang gsum/ stong kha mtshal gyi kha sgron de dang bzhi/ gnam lcags ngar ma'i mde'u de dang lnga /mda' mo'i tshang pa lnga ldan de ltar lags/ mda' mo 'di la sgro gcig bskyon tsa na/ rab byung btsun pas rtsed zhwa bzhes pa 'dra/ mda' mo 'di la sgro gnyis bskyon tsa na/ thang dkar rgod pos gshog rkyong byas pa 'dra/ mda' mo 'di1 18 sgro gsum bskyon tsa na/ nus ldan sngags 'chang phur pa thogs pa 'dra/

mda' mo 'di la skud gcig dkris tsa na/ stag shar gzhon pa ska rags bcings pa 'dra/ mda' mo 'di la mtshal gcig byug tsa na/ gnam lcags logs su me lce 'bar ba 'dra/ mda' mo 'di la stong kha gtod tsa na/ pho brang dmar po'i rgyal sgo phye ba 'dra/ mda' mo 'di la mde'u sgron tsa na/ dman chung bu mo khyim bzo zin pa 'dra/ mda' snag tshigs gsum byas pa 'di/rigs gsum mgon po'i mtshan rtags yin/ stong kha mar yis gsos pa 'di/pho lha dbu 'phangs mtho ba'i rten 'brel yin/ mde'u lcags la byas pa 'di/phyogs bzhi'i dgra bo 'dul ba'i rten 'brel yin/ dar mtshon sman cos brgyan pa 'di/ sman gyi rtse gcig 'byor ba'i rten 'brel yin/ sgron bu bu chen btags pa 'di/ bu nor longs spyod 'dzoms pa'i rten 'brel yin/dngul dkar me long btags pa 'di/ gling bzhi'i mun pa sel ba'i rten 'brel yin/ mda' la rtse lnga yod pa 'di/ mnga' thang dgung la reg pa'i rten 'brel yin/ mda' dar g.yas su btsugs pa 'di/ g.yas pho rgyud rgod pa'i rten 'brel yin/ mda' dar g.yon du btsugs pa 'di/ g.yon mo rgyud mdzangs pa'i rten 'brel yin/ mda' dar rgyab tu gtsugs pa 'di/ rgyab gnyen tshan 'dzoms pa'i rten 'brel yin/ mda' dar mdun du btsugs pa 'di/ mdun rgyu nor 'dzoms pa'i rten 'brel yin/ phywa kha ba bzhin du thul lu lu/ g.yang rgya mtsho bzhin du mer re re/ da phywa g.yang ma 'khyil li li/ ki ki swo swo lha rgyal lo/mi zhes pa'am yang na mda' dar gyi bshad pa sdud pa gtong srol yang yod/ kha btags kyi bshad pa ni ra lag na 'dzin pa'i dar 1)par

'di/ steng lha mo gsum gyis bkal le yin/ bar gnyan mo gsum gyis bsgrims le yin/ 'og klu mo gsum gyis btags le yin/ dar 'gor bkra shis rtags brgyad yod/ dar dkyil rgyal srid sna bdun yod/ dar 'dabs mu tig 'dzar lo yod/ byung ba nag po rgya nas byung / dar ba 'jig rten khams la dar/ zhes pa lta bu gtong ngo / de nas bu mo gdan nas 'dren khar mna' ma la bu'i khyim nas khyer yong ba'i gser gdub bam mdzub dkris der kha btags a she gcig gi rtse gcig bsgar/ kha btags de'i dar sne gzhan de nas bsu mis bzung ste bu mo la yar langs dgos pa'i bshad pa smyo pha bzang gi bu mo yar bzhengs shig ma bzang gi bu mo yar bzhengs shig lha yul skyid pa'i zhing stod bde khang du/ pha yab chen gangs dkar ti se 'dra/ de la dgongs te bu mo yar bzhengs shig yum chen a ma ma pham g.yu mtsho 'dra/de la dgongs te bu mo yar bzhings shig tshe gang gtan grogs gangs la nyi shar 'dra/ de la dgongs te bu mo yar bzhengs shig phu na g.yag lug rta gsum bsam mi khyab/ de la dgongs te bu mo yar bzhengs shig mda' na sa khang 'bru yi bang mdzod yod/ de la dgongs te bu mo yar bzhengs shig ces pa'i bshad pa phul nas bu mo gdan drangs kyi yod/ de nas mna' ma de pha tshang gi sgo nas don skabs grong pa khyim mtshes kyi gzhon pa 'ga' 'dzoms nas sgo bkag gtong srol yod/ sgo bkag mkhan rnams kyis bu mo la mdzangs ma'i yon tan ldan lugs kyi bsngags brjod kyis bsu mi la bston 'dzugs byed kyi yod1/30de dus bsu mi nas sgo bkag mkhan rnams la kha btags dang chang rin

spra da rjes bu mo gtong ba dang / bu mo rta la bzhon khar bsu mis bag rta la bshad pa tsa rta 'di rta ngo ma shes na/ gyi ling gnam rta dkar po yin/ a lce rgya bza'i chebs chen yin/ steng lha nas gnang ba'i lha rta ngang pa yin/ la la 'gro ba'i la rta 'di la zhu/ 'og klu nas gnang ba'i klu rta sngo mo yin/ chu la 'gro ba'i chu rta 'di la zhu/ bar btsan nas gnang ba'i btsan rta rkyang po yin/thang la 'gro ba'i thang rta 'di la zhu/ sngon dus lha gcig kong jo chibs/ kha dro g.yang chags kyi rta zhig yin/ da lta rigs bzang gi bu mo chibs/ kha dro g.yang chags kyi bag rta 'di la zhu/’ zhes bshad pa phul rjes bu mo rta la bskyon pa'i srol yod/ bu mo'i bzhon rta'i spu mdog gang byed rtsis la gang babs la blta ba dang spyir bag rta de rgod ma mngal ldan ma byed mkhan shas che ba'ang bu mo de mna' mar bsus rjes bu nor 'phel ba'i rten 'brel mtshon pa zhig yin/mna' ma pha khyim nas kha bral te lam bar bskyod ring lam bar gro so phye mar bkyag mkhan byung ba'am yang na 'bras dkar gyi bshad pa phul mkhan byung tshe skyel mkhan gyis kha btags sgron pa dang / chang rin sprod pa'i srol yod pa ma zad/ da dung lam bar chu len mkhan dang / me shing khyer nas yong mkhan 'phrad tshe de ni rtags rten 'brel bzang por brtsis nas bsu skyel mkhan rnams rta las babs te lci ba dang chu khyer mkhan la kha btags g.yog pa dang da dung 6 grogs kyi dang po lci ba yin/ rdza stod 'brong gi lci ba yod/ g.yag po stong gi spang lci yod/ 'bri mo brgya yi lhas lci yod/ grogs kyi dang po 'dzoms pa la/ grogs kyi lha rnams mgul dar bzhed/mi ces dang 6 grogs kyi ga~X pa

chu mo yin/ gong ma nam mkha' yangs pa la/ lha yi yul na chu phud yod/ rin chen spungs 'dra'i chu phud yod/ bar phyogs btsan gyi chu rgyu yod/ gangs chen bzhi yi chu sna yod/ 'og phyogs klu yi bdud rtsi yod/ klu rgyal de bzhin mgul dar bzhed/’ ces mna' ma skyel mkhan gyi lci ba dang chu'i bshad pa gtong ba'i srol yod/ de min lam bar du mna' ma bsu skyel byed mkhan gzhan 'phrad tshe lam kha de rang du mchod chang 'dren res dang bkra shis bde legs zhu bar mtshon pa'i kha btags g.yog res bya srol yod/ yul 'ga' shas kyi bshad rgyun la mna' ma skyel bsu byed mkhan gnyis 'phrad tshe sngon ma phan tshun gyi ster skal rnams brje po rgyag pa'i srol yod par grags kyang de lta bu'i don dngos de dang 'di byung myong zhes mdzub mo btsugs rgyu mi 'dug yang mna' ma skyel bsu byed pa'i lam bar bag brdung gtong ba'i srol yod/ bag brdung gtong skabs sa rdo sogs gzhus mi chog par rta sbangs/ khyi brun/ lci ba/ lham rnying gog po la sogs 'phang dgos kyi yod/ de'i dgos don ni mna' mar bag 'dre yod pa 'dul ba'i ched du yin zer skad kyang re gnyis 'phang rjes chang rin dngul sprad de 'phang du mi 'jug mna' ma skyel mkhan la las bag brdung gtong mkhan 'phrad skabs chang rin la 'dzem nas bros thabs byed pa'am yang na bag brdung gtong mkhan 'dod pa che ba 'ga' shas la chang rin gya nom pa ma byung ba'i skabs sa rdo 'phen pa sogs rten 'brel nyes pa'i don dngos kyang thon gyi yod/ gong rnams las ldog ste lam bar du nad pa dang /gad1 ṭīkas g.yug mkhan/ sle po stong pa khyer ba bcas dang 'phrad tshe de ni

bkra mi shis par brtsi ba'i srol yang yod/de nas bag ma bsu skyel byed mkhan rnams bu'i khyim gyi sgo 'gram du 'byor skabs khyim gyi sgo 'gram du bu'i nang nas bag ma rta las 'bebs pa'i 'bab stegs la 'bru do po/ 'bras gro'i do po/ tshwa do po/ mar ltang sogs brtsigs pa'i steng phying pa dkar po g.yog de'i steng du thig le brgya ldan gyi gzig lpags kyi kha gdan dang / de'i steng du stag lpags kyi kha gdan/ de'i steng du mi 'gyur ba mtshon byed kyi gro'i g.yung drung zhig bris pa gra sgrig byas yod pa der mna' ma skyel mis 2bu mo'i 'bebs gdan la gro nas sran gsum/dar gos chen/ gzig lpags/ stag lpags bcas e yod lags 7zhes brjod pa'i lan du bsu mi'am yang na bu'i khyim gyi nang mi zhig gis 2 lags yod mi ces brjod 'phral skyel mis ra de ltar 'grig lags zer na bu mo 'bebs par zhu/mi zhes smras rjes bsu mis bu mo rta thog nas phab ste bu'i nang du khrid 'gro ba dang sgo nang du bu'i a mas mna' ma'i lag tu 'o zom dang rgyab tu lci ba se kha ma sgye chung gang bskur nas shar rer mdzod nang skyel bar khrid srol yod/de'i skabs mna' ma skyel mi ni bu'i phyogs kyi grong sde'i mi rnams kyis sgo'i g.yas g.yon gnyis su btsugs pa'i tho po dkar nag gnyis yod pa dkar po lha yi tho po/ bkra shis pa'i mtshon rtags/ nag po bdud kyi tho po/ ltas ngan pa'i mtshon rtags yin pas de gnyis la bshad pa gtong bzhin gsol gtor byed srol yod/ dkar tho la 6 g.yas phyogs dkar ba'i lha tho dkar po 'di/yul sde dkar ba'i dkar rdo yin/ khyim mtshes dkar ba'i dkar ༵ byin/

nang mi dkar ba'i dkar rdo yin/ bza' tshang dkar ba'i dkar rdo yin/dus de ring rten 'brel dge 'dzom nyin/ bkra shis kyi mgul dar 'di la 'bul/’ zhes pa'am yang na ‘ tho po dkar po steng phyogs lha yi tho/ lha tshangs pa dkar po'i tho rten yin/ pho lha dang mo lha dgra lha yi/ bde skyid kyi rtsa ba 'dzugs pa'i tho/ dus de ring phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin/ bkra shis kyi dar dkar 'di la 'bul/mi zhes pa'am yang na 66rma su sti/ legs su gyur cigaphun tshogs du ba ljang chung gnas lnga'i khrod/ legs tshogs 'dus pa'i tho dkar 'khrungs nas byung / bkra shis bde legs dga' ston nyin mo 'dir/bkra shis tho dkar gsol ba'i skal ba de/ zhang chen nga la steng ma lha nas gnang / lha tho dkar po'i dbus su sku zhig yod/ sku de ni gangs dkar ti se yin/ gangs dkar ti se lha yi mchod rten 'dir/ nag nog ngan pa'i dri ma mthong rgyu med/ 'di yi g.yas su lha zhig bzhugs/ lha de ni tshangs pa dkar po yin/ lha tshangs pa'i dbu 'phang dgung las mtho/ dgung nyi zla gnyis dang dbyer med yin/ 'di yi g.yon du lha zhig bzhugs/ lha de ni sgrol ma dkar mo yin/ nor 'phrin las myur ba'i srung ma yin/ nga'i nor bu srung ba'i srung ma yin/ tho dkar 'di la dkar po rnam gsum 'dzoms/ de 'dzoms gsum 'dzoms pa'i rten 'brel dang / gegs bar chad srung ba'i rten 'brel yod/rten 'brel gyi rtsa ba bkra shis yin/ bkra shis kyi rtsa ba dar dkar yin/ dar dkar dkar gtsang bde legs 'di/ ngas gus pa'i ngang nas khyed la phul/ zhedi bye/ bshad pa phul rjes rdo dkar po gsum mam lnga'am bdun brtsegs

pa'i dkar tho la kha btags bskon/ de mur g.yon phyogs su yod pa'i nag rdo kha shas brtsegs pa'i tho po nag po la 6 g.yon phyogs nag pa'i 'dre tho nag po 'di/ yul sde dkrug pa'i dkrug rdo yin/ khyim mtshes dkrug pa'i dkrug rdo yin/ nang mi dkrug pa'i dkrug rdo yin/ bza' tsho dkrug pa'i dkrug rdo yin/dkrug rdo 'di ru ma sdod byang snye ma mi skye sar rgyugs ang /’ zhes pa'am yang na 6 tho 'di nag po bdud kyi tho/ mi kun la gnod byed dgra bo'i tho/ dus de ring rten 'brel dge 'dzoms nyin/ ngan khyod ni 'jog pa'i thabs med pas/mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol du song zhig ces pa'am yang na 66g.yon nag nag nag pa'i 'dre tho 'di/ 'dre yan lag brgyad ldan gyi 'dre tho yin/ khyod 'dre tho ma chags 'dre tho chags/ 'dre tho nag po bya rog gzugs shig chags/ khyod tho po'i mgo la bltas pa na/ bdud lha sbyin nag po'i mgo bo 'dra/ bdud nag po'i mgo bo ma bcad na/ bod bstan pa dar bar gnod le yin/ khyod tho po'i sked par bltas tsa na/ bdud the'u rang nag po'i sked pa 'dra/ khyod sked pa nga yis ma bcad na/ mtho ge sar dmag la bar chad yong / khyod tho po'i rtsa bar bltas tsa na/ bdud klu bdud nag po'i rtsa ba 'dra/ khyod rtsa ba nga yis ma bkog na/ nor longs spyod 'phel bar gnod le yin/ gnas 'di na 'byor ba'i zhang chen nga / yul gang du slebs kyang nag phyogs kun/ ngas mi 'joms zhes pa grags le min/ dus de ring khyed kyang skad cig tsam/ gnas 'di ru sdod pa'i dus med do/ zhes pa'i bshad pa btang mtshams rkang rdog dang rta lcag gzhus nas gtor gyi yod/ de nas bu'i phyogs kyi grong ༵༵ mi

'ga' shas kyis sgo bkag nas mna' ma skyel mi de bu'i khyim la ma btang bar sgo bshad brgyab shog ces brjod skabs mna' ma skyel mi des mi de rnams la kha btags dang / chang rin/ sha zan sogs phul ba dang / sgo la 6 sgo mo phyi sgo gcig dang nang sgo gcig bar sgo tsan dan smug po'i sgo yas them ser po gser la byas/ mas them sngo mo g.yu la byas/ sgo 'bor dngul dkar me long yin/ dbye shing dung dkar g.yas 'khyil 'byed mi phebs yod pas/ bkra shis pa'i mjal dar 'di 'bul lo/’ zhes pa'am yang sgo'i bshad pa cung rgyas pa zhig la/ tsa yi su sti/ bde legs su gyur cig smra ba ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbyangs/ dbyangs can lha mo'i gtsug lag bde zhing 'phel/dpan ldan tshangs pa sde bzhis bang mdzod 'dzin/ 'dzin ma'i mnga' bdag rnams kyis shis par stsol/ shes par stsol te tshig gi lam yangs pa/ gnam sngon po g.yu gcal bkram pa'i 'og bar g.yang chags bkra shes rtags brgyad dbus/ sa g.yang chags pad ma 'dab brgyad steng / bkra shis pa rnam gsum 'dzoms nas yod/ dgung sngon por bkra shis nyi zla 'dzoms/ bar yangs por gza' skar 'phrod sbyor 'dzoms/ gnas 'di ru dga' nye blo dkar 'dzoms/ 'di 'dzoms gsum 'dzoms pa'i rten 'brel la/ nga zhang chen mi slebs ci la srid/ nga zhang chen zhal nas gsung gcig grags/ gsung snyan po tshangs pa'i rgyud mangs 'dra/ gsung snyan po'i tshig de go bar gyis/ ma khar mi 'gyur rnam rgyal khang bzang la/ sgo mi 'gyur phun tshogs gzhung sgo yod1/36sgo 'di la bshad pa rgyobs zer na/ bkra shis pa'i sgo mo shar la gtad/

shar rdo rje sems pa'i byon lam yin/ sgo'i phyi nas bltas na lha khang 'dra/sgo'i nang nas bltas na klu khang 'dra/ sgo'i steng de tshangs pa'i pho brang 'dra/chos dam chos gsung dus bzhugs sa yin/ sgo'i thod de dpag bsam shing las grub/ yid bsam pa'i longs spyod 'dzoms pa'i rtags/ sgo'i smad de tsan dan shing las grub/ khyim brgyud pa tsan dan sdong po la/ shing sbyor ba'i 'dres lhad med pa'i rtags/ sdems gnyis po lha shing shug par bcol/ lha dkar phyogs dgyes pa'i rten 'brel yod/ a shing de byang chub ljon shing la bcol/ yi dam gyi lha tshogs mnyes pa'i rtags/ a thag de stong skud gsum sgril la/ dar tshon sna lnga yi mdud pa yod/ dkre lcags de dkar po dung la bcol/ dung la rus pa'i 'dres lhad med/ sgo lcags de sngon mo'i g.yu la bcol/ g.yu la do lo'i 'dres lhad med/ lde mig de ser po gser la bcol/gser la rag gi 'dres lhad med/ gzeb sgro de zangs lcags bar mas bsgrubs/ zha nye dang gsha' dkar gyi 'dres lhad med/ sgo mo'i me long tsan dan dkar dmar la/ bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad 'khrungs nas yod/ sgo 'di la rin chen kun 'dzoms pas/ grogs dga' nye kun la bsu ba dang /sdang dgra bo thams cad thar sa med/ sgo 'di la them sgo rnam gsum yod/ sgo stong dang sgo bar sgo 'og gsum/ bkra shes pa'i them sgo gsum las grub/ sgo steng sgo lha dang bla ma'i sgo/ lha dang bla ma'i sgo de chos kyis phye/ chos bstan pa dar ba'i rten 'brel yod/ sgo bar sgo 'go 'dren dpon po'i sgo/ gong dpon po'i sgo de khrims kyis phye/ yul khrims kyis skyong ba'i rten 'brel yo/3/ba sgo

'og sgo zhang chen nga yi sgo/ zhang chen gyi sgo de dar gyis phye/ dar 'dzoms pa tshon sna lnga yis phye/ dar 'dzoms pa tshon sna lnga ldan 'dir/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sku mdog tshang nas yod/ 'byung ba lnga yi khyad chos tshang nas yod/ dar 'di yi sne la dar dkar yod/ dar dkar po nyi ma bde legs yod/ dar dkar po nyi ma bde legs 'di/ lug g.yang dkar brgya yi mkhal bal yin/lug g.yang dkar ma mo'i khyu tshogs kyis/ dus bzhi yi rtsi bcud rab ngoms pas/ bal bzang po bregs pa'i dus la babs/ bal bregs dus lha chen brgya yis bregs/ bal 'khel dus lha mo brgya yis 'khel/ bal thags dus klu mo brgya yis btags/ gnyan lha klu 'dzoms pa'i dar dkar yin/ dar 'di la lha dgu 'khrungs nas yod/ sku dang po thub pa sangs rgyas 'khrungs/ sku gnyis pa snying rje'i lha mchog 'khrungs/ sku gsum pa tshangs pa dkar po 'khrungs/ sku bzhi pa ngag gi dbang phyug 'khrungs/ sku lnga pa sgrol ma dkar mo 'khrungs/ sku drug pa rig pa'i lha mo 'khrungs/ sku bdun pa phyag na rdo rje 'khrungs/ sku brgyad pa rta mgrin dmar po 'khrungs/ sku dgu pa gling rje ge sar 'khrungs/'di lha dgu 'dzoms pa'i lha dar yin/ nga'i lha dar nyi ma bde legs 'di/bod gangs can ljongs su 'khyer zer na/ lha bla ma mjal ba'i mjal dar yin/smad rgya nag yul du 'khyer zer na/ gong dpon po mjal ba'i mjal dar yin/dus de ring bkra shis dga' ston la/ dar 'di ko yar la 'phyar zer na/ sgo 'di la mi phye rang dbang med/ ki ki swo swo lha rgyal lo/’ zhes bshad pa phul nas kha do/sdus sgo la bskon mtshams sgo bkag mkhan rnams kyis mna' ma skyel

mkhan bu'i nang la gtong gi yod/ de nas sgo rgyab tu yod pa'i 'dogs khyi la bu mo skyel mis lha sgo srung dom po snying dkar khyod/ sdang dgra bo'i thog la bi sgra sgrogs/ gnyen nye ba'i phyogs la nyal nas sdod/ bkra shis pa'i mjal dar 'di 'bul lo/’ zhes pa'am yang na 6 legs byas dgra la bar ba'i skad sgra sgrogs/ zhe sdang che cher mjug ma gnam la gzengs/ sder mo sa gzhir btsugs pas khams gsum zil gyis gnon/ nor srung dgra 'dul gnyen skyong la bkra shis pa'i mjal dar 'di 'bul lo/mi zhes pa'i bshad pa btang rjes kha btags g.yogs srol yod/ de nas lam bar gyi byed sgo cha tshang mjug sgril ba ste mna' ma skyel mkhan rnams bu'i sgo'i nang du 'dzul ba dang / khang pa'i sgo nang du 'ga' shas kyis phye mar dang / 'o phud/ lci phud/ chu phud bcas sgrig nas 'jog srol yod pa dang / mna' ma skyel mkhan gyis de rnams las phud gtor byed pa dang de rnams la kha btags g.yog pa ridang sbrags bshad pa mdor bsdus re bshad srol yod/ yang 'ga' shas kyis lci ba'i bshad pa dang chu'i bshad pa ni lam bar lci ba khyer ba'am chu len mkhan dang 'phrad pa'am chu sne dang 'phrad skabs gtong srol yang yod/ dper na/ phye mar gyi bshad pa la 6 bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs/ e ma bag dro sku khams bzang / tshe ring lo brgya thub pa dang / dga' spro'i dpal la rol bar shog ces pa dang / 'o phud kyi bshad par 6 nor bu ri yi rtse mo nas/ 'bri bzhin ma brgya yi 'o phud blangs/ dkar 'o ma'i phud gtor dgung la mchod/lha dkar phyogs dgyes pa'i rten 'brel dang / phyugs sgo zog 'phel bstu spyan

'brel yod/ mices pa/ yang chang phud mchod skabs 4 mchod dang po steng phyogs lha la mchod/ lha'i longs spyod 'dzoms pa'i zhal bzhes yod/ mchod gnyis pa bar phyogs btsan la mchod/ nad mu ge med pa'i zhal bzhes yod/ mchod gsum pa 'og phyogs klu la mchod/ stobs mnga' thang dar ba'i zhal bzhes yod/mi ces pa/ yang lci ba'i bshad pa la 6 lci phud 'di la bstod pa phul zer na/mtho gangs can byang thang yangs po la/ rtswa rtsi thog ro bcud phun sum tshogs/de longs su spyod pa'i 'bri g.yag nor/ nor stong tsho gcig gi lci phud de/dus de ring 'di ru bsnams nas 'dug bar sa gzhi phun tshogs dbus gtsang yul/ rigs rgyud bzang ba'i mdzo mo mang / bar mdzo mo stong gi lci phud de/ dus de ring 'di ru bsnams nas 'dug smad mdo khams yul de rgya che bas/ ba be'u'i phyugs rgyud lhag par bzang / ba stong tsho gcig gi lci phud de/ dus de ring 'di ru bsnams nas 'dug lce phud dang po lci ba'i phung po 'dir/ bkra shis pa'i mjal dar sgron rgyu yin/mi zhes dang / yang chu phud kyi bshad par 4 yo su sti/ bde legs su gyur cig gangs rin chen ti se'i 'dabs rol nas/ chu rin chen yan lag brgyad ldan byung / chu mngar ba ka ra bu ram dang / chu bsil ba char rjes rlung bu 'dra/ chu 'jam pa g.yang mo'i bal la 'gran/ chu yang pa bya yi sgro 'dra ba/ chu dwangs pa ston gyi nam mkha' bzhin/ chu gtsang ba tshangs pa'i gter chu la/ chu mgrin par ma gnod lto ba bde/ chu 'di la chu dar 'di sgron pas/ lha mchog gsum mnyes pa'i rten 'asdidī sbyad/’ ces pa'i bshad pa phul rjes khyim tshang gi skas ka 'dzigs nas

steng khang du rten 'brel dngos gzhi byed sar 'byor ro/ /bzhi/ gnyen ston dngos gzhi'i mdzad sgo/gnyen lam gyi skyel bsu'i mdzad sgo rnams mjug sgril rjes bu dang mna' ma/ bu'i yab yum spun mched/ skyel bsur phebs mkhan gyi bu dang bu'i ngo tshab/ bag g.yog ma/ dkar rtsis pa dang lha bsang gtong mkhan sngags pa bcas pa rten 'brel byed yul gyi khang pa'i nang 'dzoms shing bu dang bu mo gnyis bag rtsis nang gsal gyi kha phyogs su kha bltas nas gro yi g.yung drung bris pa'i gdan steng du sdod pa dang / mna' ma'i 'khris su bag g.yog ma sdod kyi yod/ bzhugs gral g.yas g.yon gnyis su mna' ma skyel mkhan dang bu'i yab yum bcas pa lhing 'jags su bzhugs thog khrung 'dren ma zhig gis gro so phye mar 'bul ba dang mchod chang 'dren srol yod/ de rjes bu mo'i ngo tshab pas bu'i khyim gyi nang rten dang / rten 'brel sgrig chas/ bzhugs gral la 'khod pa'i skyes pho mo rgan gzhon bcas la gang la gang 'tsham gyi bshad pa phul bzhin rten dar sgron srol yod/ de mur bu mo'i khyim tshang gi ngo tshab pas bzhugs gral yongs la gnyen yig dang skal rdzong gi zin tho sgrogs sbyang byas mtshams gral sgo nas kha shags 'bod skul gyi gtam gleng ba dang /bzhugs gral g.yas gral dang g.yon gral gnyis phan tshun shags gtam gleng /de nas ja chang bza' btung longs su spyod bzhin la las rkang bro glu 11dis/

la las sgra snyan pi wang sogs rol mo'i bye brag sna tshogs la rol nas rten 'brel gyi nyin dang po de 'das pa dang / nyin gnyis pa nas dkar nye grogs gsum dang / grong pa khyim mtshes rnams rten 'brel la yong srol yod/ rten 'brel la phebs mkhan rnams kyis rang gi 'byor pa dang bstun pa dang snga lan yod med la gzhigs nas rten 'brel gyi gro dang / mchod chang / kha btags/lag rtags zhal zas dang zhal lag gi rdzas cha rnams khyer nas 'ga' res nyi ring dang 'ga' res nyi thung gi rten 'brel byed srol yod/ nyi ring nyi thung gang byed gtso bo snga lan yod med la blta ba dang / de gnyis kyi khyad par yang lag sne che chung dang / mchod chang mang nyung / zhal zas zhal lag gi rgyas bsdus nas mtshon gyi yod/ gal srid nyi ring gi tshad bzhin rten 'brel byas na nyin de'i bu'i khyim tshang gi nang mi tshang ma dang / sku mgron yongs kyi zhal lagamachod chang tshang ma'i 'gro song rten 'brel la phebs mkhan gyis gtong dgos pa ma zad/ tha na mna' ma skyel bsu byed pa'i rta drel gyi zan rtswa rnams kyang gtong dgos yod pa'i bshad srol yang yod/ rten 'brel la phebs mkhan rnams kyis thog mar rang gis khyer yong ba'i mchod chang nas khrung rdza/ khrung spur/ khrung ban rnams chang gis bkang / zhal lag gi rdzas cha rnams bzhugs gralayongs la ston rjes lag tu gro sbar gang khyer nas thog mar bzhugs gral yongs la bzhugs gral gyi bshad pa phul bzhin phud gtor byed/ de rjes rten gtso'am nang rten dang gro so phye mar/ 'dzugs sha zhes pa'i sha gog mgo sbyar/khrung1 /2/ khrung sbur/ khrung ban/ khrung skya sogs khrung chas sna tshogs dang

bcas rten 'brel sgrig chas rnams dang / khang pa'i ka ba bcas la bshad pa phul bzhin rten dar sgron pa dang / de nas mur bu dang mna' ma/ bu'i yab yum/ mna' ma skyel mkhan gyi bu mo'i sku tshab/ bag g.yog ma/ gnye bo (bar mi )bu'i nang mi tshang ma bcas la rten dar dang lag rtags 'bul ba dang chabs cig gang la gang 'tsham gyi gnyen bshad rgyas bsdus sna tshogs gtong bzhin mchod chang 'dren srol yod/ de nas nyin der nyi thung gi rten 'brel byed mkhan 'ga' shas zhor la rten 'brel kha btags dang lag rtags 'bul ba dang mchod chang 'dren pa las nyin gcig la nyi ring gi rten 'brel byed mkhan mang po med/ nyin gnyis pa der bu'i ngo tshab rten 'brel mdzad sgo'i ring mdzad sgo'i bkod 'dom byed mkhan gyi gnyer pa zhig yod pa des rten 'brel byed mkhan gyi bang rim bkod sgrig byed kyi yod/ gnyer pa de nges par du nam rgyun du 'jig rten skyid sdug gi 'gro lugs rnams la mkhas shing 'jug pa dang / khul der grags dang mthong che ba/ bu'i tshang gi spun mched min na dkar nye grogs po gcig 'tshal gyi yod/ gnyer pa des gnyen ston mdzad sgo'i ring gi byed sgo khag dang / zhal lag bcas pa'i bkod sgrig tshang ma byed dgos pa ma zad/ da dung bzhugs gral gyi khrims srung mkhan yang byed kyi yod/ de yang bzhugs gral gyi sgrig chas nang khrung skya smyug ma tshigs gsum ldan zhig yod pa de gcig nas khrung snod nang gi chang dkrug byed du spyod pa dang / de min bzhugs gral nang ra bzi skyur 'gong bshad mkhan byung na skyur 'gong byed mkhan gcun byed du spyod kyi yod/ nam rgyun mi 'gadi /sa

6bzhugs gral mang po sgrim myong yang / mgo la sbu skya ze ma myong /’ zhes brjod srol yod pa'i nang don ni bzhugs gral thog ra bzi skyur 'gong bshad ma myong zhes pa'i don yin/ gzhan yang 6 khrung bkag nang du'ang tsa ra bzi skyur 'gong bshad na/ khrung skya smyug ma tshigs gsum dbu la zhu/mi zhes 'khod yod pa ltar khrung skya de chang khrims srung mkhan yin pa dang / gnyen ston skabs de bed spyod pa'i dbang cha yod mkhan ni gnyer pa yin/ khrung ston phud pa'i bzhugs gral thog khrung skya bed spyod dbang yod pa ni khrung 'dren ma yin/ de yang 6 khrung skya smyug ma tshigs gsum de/ khrung 'dren sman chung bu mo'i phyag mtshan yin/’ zer ba ltar ro/gsham du gnyen bshad kyi dpe mtshon re re bzhin bkod na/zhugasaswāsprol gyicabashad la/oṃ bde legs su gyur cigabakra shes bde legs phun sum tshogs/a ma bag dro sku khams bzang /gtan du bde ba thob par shogagayu chung gru dkar bstan pa dar/'o lags so zhes zhus pas g.yas stag gral la 'khod pa'i dpa' bo'i zhugs gral dang / g.yon gzig gral la 'khod pa'i dpa' mo'i zhugs gral/zursha kāsum bre mo gug tu bzhugs pa dang / ka gdong seng ge'i gral du

bzhugs pa/ sgo rgyab a long gug tu bzhugs pa rnams snyan gyi dbang po gsan par zhu/sa yul skyid pa'i bkra shis dge 'khor 'di/chos grwa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i shar/gdan sa mtho ba bkra shes lhun po'i lho/'bru sna 'dzoms pa shel dkar rgyal rtse'i nub/zas sna 'dzoms pa tshong 'dus pha ri'i byang /phu ru spang chags 'brog sde brgya phrag gnas/g.yag ra lug gsum gzhan la smon dgos med/rkang bzhis kun khyab longs spyod mar la bcol/sha mar longs spyod 'dzoms pa'i ngang la bzhugs/bar du rten chags ka bzhi gdung brgyad gnas/gser g.yu mu tig nor bu'i bang mdzod yod/gon dar gzhon gsum bkra shis bde legs yod/mda' ru rten chags sa zhing brgya phrag gnas/'bru sna 'dzoms shing longs spyod chang la bcol/a rag bdud rtsi 'di 'dra'i ngang la btang /nas sran gro sogs gang dga' gang 'dod yod/ 'o lags so zhes zhus pas/chos sku'i ston pa kun tu bzang po mchod/ 145

longs sku'i ston pa spyan ras gzigs dbang mchod/sprul sku'i ston pa padma 'byung gnas mchod/sku gsum bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/'dzam gling lte ba rgya gar rdo rje gdan/bod kyi lte ba dbus kyi po ta la/lha sa bod kyi yar ba yin/yar bas dka' spyad ma bzhes na/ bod kyi bstan pa gang du dar/bla ma'i bka' skyongs dam chos kun tu khyab/dpon po'i bka' skyongs khams gsum dbang du 'dus/smra ba ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbyangs/dbyangs can lha mo gtsug lag 'dod 'jo'i dpal/dpal ldan tshangs pa de bzhin legs par 'dzin/'dzin pa'i man ngag mi rnams kyis shes par mdzod/drin can pha mas dka' bas yar bzhengs pa'i/bkra shis g.yang du 'khyil ba'i pho brang nang /gnas khang bzang po'i bu rgyud khyad 'phags gsum/rgan pa gser gyi nyi ma'i zhogs ya la/bar pa dung gi zla ba 'dra zhig yod/146 gzhon pa dngul gyi skar chen 'dra zhigayod/

pho de gsum bsod nams che ba dang /sngon las smon lam gzhan las cher mchog pas/drin can bu la brtse ba'i yab yum gyi/sha khrag lus las grub pa'i sras su 'khrungs/rgan 'og gzhon tshul gzhan la smon dgos med/pha mas bur byams bu yis pha mar bkur/gnas khang longs spyod yar ngo'i zla bar 'gran/khyed bzang khyed yag gus pa'i bsngags brjod mang /nga dga' nga skyid bkra shis gtam bzang mang /da yang 'jig rten kun gyi 'gro lugs ltar/ngo mtshar sras kyi 'jig rten mdun thabs su/don grub yar 'phel bkra shis (grong ming )gi/sras mo rgan pa (mna' ma'i ming )gdan drangs pa'i skabs 'dir/gnam mi 'gyur 'khor chen brgyad kyi 'ogs mi 'gyur pad ma 'dab brgyad steng /bar mi 'gyur pho brang 'di yi nang /phu nas 'brog pa'i mar thud char ltar babs/mda' ru 'bru sna btab tshad dus su smin/char chu bzang po lo phyugs rtag tu legs/tshe ring nad med lus ngag yid gsum bde/ 147

rdzogs ldan dga' ston slobs par byin gyis rlobs/nā mo ki ki swo swo lha rgyal lo/zhabaradaragadulaba'ibashad pa/steng dga' ldan lha yi pho brang dang /sgo kun nas mtshungs pa'i khang bzang 'dir/rgyu tsan dan sprul snying las grub pa'i/ka rabs bshad pa 'tshol ba la/phyi gru bzhi lha yi gzhal yas khang /nang srung skyobs pho lha'i rten mkhar yin/thog mi 'gyur ka stegs nor bu'i rdo/rgyu sra bar rang grub sgor mo yod/bre phreng dang nor bus rgyan pa gsum/gzhu ring dang gzhu thung gzhu khebs mdzes/gdung dang gdung gdan gdung khebs bkra/pad ma chos brtsegs nyi zla bcas/ ka rabs bcu gsum tshang ba 'di/gzhi mi 'gyur brtan pa'i ka ba yin/sngon srid pa chags pa'i dus skabs nas/148 dus da lta bar du'ang gnas khang 'dir/

dpal phun sum tshogs pa'i rtsa ba byas/gzhi lhun grub 'dod rgu g.yang du 'khyil/dus de ring phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin/dar dkar 'di ka ba'i rgyan du 'bul/tshe dang longs spyod gong 'phel shogayang na/ 'o lags so zhes zhus pas/ shar skyed tshal klu gting nas gdan drangs pa'i shol dkar gyi ka ba 'di la bstod pa 'bul ba la/ka rabs kyi bcu gsum tshang a yod/(gzhan gyis lags yod do/)ka rabs bcu gsum gyi bstod pa la/ka stegs dang po rin chen sa la bcol/ka stegs gnyis pa nor bu'i rdo la bcol/ka ba bre dang phreng ba gsum/gzhu ring gzhu thung gzhu khebs gsum/gdung dang gdung gdan gdung khebs gsum/pad ma chos brtsegs nyi zla'i rgyan/lcam shing dgra ma bu nor 'dzoms/gtan yun ring 'dzoms pa'i ngang la bzhugs/pho rab gser gyi ka ba 'dra/ka ba ma 'gyur ngang du bzhugs/ 149

mo rab g.yu yi gdung ma 'dra/gad chag med pa'i ngang la bzhugs/'o lags so/ rgya zhing chen bco brgyad nas gdan drangs pa'i/dar dkar po'i dri med rnam dag 'di/mtho ba nam mkha' yar la 'phyar zer na/gangs stod kyi gdangs kyang gcog pa yod/dma' ba gtsang gzhung mar la snar zer na/gtsang chab sngon mo'i chu sna las kyang ring /ri mo yag pa la byas na bkra shis rtags brgyad tshang /lha tshangs pa mjal ba'i mjal dar yin/dma' gong ma mjal ba'i mjal dar yin/de ring gnas khang gi ka ba'i rgyan du sgron/g.yas nas btags pas g.yon la 'khyil le bzhugs/g.yon nas btags pas g.yas su 'khyel le bzhugs/ka ba'i rtse nas btang pas ka gsham ma ru nyi le bzhugs/ka gsham ma ru lug po skya chen gyi bal spungs pa ltar skya phung nge spung yod/khrung zhu sman chung bu mo tshos zhabs 'khon gyi dogs gnang ā/ hwa hwa/ 150

bye mar 'a'o dang rten khri'ibashadari/oṃ su /ste/la stod phyogs nas gnan drangs pa'i rgya lcog gru bzhi 'di/phyi la zur bzhi yod pa 'di/phyi dgra bo'i phyogs la zur ba yin/nang la gug bzhi yod pa 'di/nang phywa g.yang 'gug pa'i gug bzhi yin/de'i steng du yod pa'i phye mar gyi gangs ri 'od 'phro 'di/zhal tshogs gangs las dkar ba'i rten 'brel yin/de'i stong du yod sa'i 'bri mar ser po'i dkar rgyan 'di/gnas khang 'di mar dkrog las sgril ba'i rten 'brel yin/de'i g.yon du yod pa'i rgya gro dkar mo 'di/zhal dro ba'i gro gcig yin/de'i steng du yod pa'i byang tshwa dkar po 'di/bya ba tshabs su 'gro ba'i tshwa gcig zer/o rgyan bho so dkar po las grub pa'i/gzugs bkod legs pa'i rten 'brel mchod shong 'di/bltas pa tsam gyis 'gro rnams dbang du 'dus/sdig pa tsam gyis sde brgyad bran du bkol/bsam pa tsam gyis dgos 'dod char ltar 'bebs/ 151

o rgyan rin po che la mgul dar legs pa gcig 'bul lo/ yang na/ 6 rma su sti/ bde legs su gyur ciganor bu dga' 'khyil 'khrungs pa'i rgya lcog stong /'bo la bzang po gser gyi kha rgyan bzhugs/'bo 'di bskrun pa'i bskrun rabs brjod dgos na/bzo bo mkhas pa bi shwa kurmas bskrun/'bo 'di la phyi nang zur gug bzhi/phyi zur bzhis rgyan pa'i dgos pa ni/phyi'i 'byung bzhi dbang du bsdus pa'i rtags/nang gug bzhis rgyan pa'i dgos pa ni/nor longs spyod g.yang du 'gug pa'i rtags/de'i nang du yod pa'i gro bzang 'di/lha dzam lha'i mdzod las drangs pa yin/de'i steng du bzhag pa'i byang tshwa 'di/las bya ba tshags su tshud pa'i rtags/de'i steng du btsugs pa'i mda' dar 'di/lho rong sprug ma'i mda' dang gcigarin chen lcags kyi mde'u dang gnyis/thang dkar rgod po'i sgro dang gsum/152 gsal byed dngul dkar me long dang /

sked 'ching dar mtshon sna lngas brgyan/mda' 'di la tshang pa'i lnga ldan zer/ki ki swo swo lha rgyal lo/ / ’khrungaldan gyibashadari/ oṃ su sti/ rgyu rin chen sna lnga las grub pa'i/'khyil bzhugs rin chen bum bzang 'di/nang lha yi bdud rtsis yongs bkang nas/mar dkar ser gyi yal ga rgyan gyis mdzes/lho rma bya'i yul gyi sprug ma yis/g.yas skor dang g.yon skor lan gsum brgyab/bdud rtsi lha yi rgya mtsho 'khyil ba 'dra/'dir bzhugs kyi zhugs gral sgor mo rnams/a la la bdud rtsi yis tshim par mdzod/shing byang chub ljon shing rtsa ba nas/yal 'dab sogs me tog ge sar 'khrungs/dar tshon sna lnga'i cod pan sgron/rlung mda' sogs dar zhing rgyas pa'i dar gcig 'bul/153

khrung sbyar byibashad pa/oṃ su sti/ bde legs su 'phel gyur cigarta nag gting nas gdan drangs pa'i/'khyil zhugs o rgyan padma la/yā rtse tshang pa'i lnga ldan sgron/phyi na rta rnga tsam zhig gad pa med/nang ni sgong khog tsam zhig zhom pa med/na ning bcos pa'i lo chang kham pa yod/da lo btsos pa'i 'bras chang bsil ma yod/'khyil zhugs o rgyan pad ma 'di/phyi nas bltas na ri bo 'dra/nang nas bltas na rgya mtsho 'dra/rgya mtsho'i nang na shing zhig 'dugagatsug na rin chen klu yi sras/bar snang khams na dar cig 'dugatshangs pa rgyal chen lha yi sras/lha sras dang klu sras 'debs 'dug pa'i/'khyil zhugs o rgyan bum mtsho la/154 bkra shis kyi mgul dar gcig 'bul/

khyung rgya'i shad pa/oṃ swa ste/ bde legs su 'phel gyur cigalho rong gting nas gdan drangs pa'i/khrung rgya smyug ma tshigs gsum 'di/rtsa ba stag shar gzhon pa'i zhal gling nyan pa yod/sked pa a ma chang ma'i khrung rgya nyan pa yod/rtse mo sku rlung dar ba'i dar lcog nyan pa yod/rtsa ba tshig gi dang po ni/'og klu 'khor dbang du 'dus pa'i rten 'brel yin/sked pa tshig gi gnyis pa ni/bar btsan 'khor dbang du 'dus pa'i rten 'brel yin/rtse mo tshig gi gsum pa ni/steng lha 'khor dbang du 'dus pa'i rten 'brel yin/gi ki swo swo lha rgyal lo/khrung sna'ibashadab/oṃ su sti/ bde legs su 'phel gyur cigal stod bkra shis skyed tshal nas gdan drangs pa'i/ 155

khrung rdza ma pham g.yu mtsho 'di/phyi ni rin chen gser dang zangs la shams/nang ni dbang 'dus g.yu mtsho 'khyil/g.yas su a long btags pa 'di/stag gral non pa'i a long yin/g.yon du a long btags pa 'di/gzig gral non pa'i a long yin/zhal mchu dbyings la bstan pa 'di/zhugs gral yongs la bstan pa yin/khrung rdza ma pham g.yu mtsho la/bkra shes kyi mgul dar legs pa gcig 'bul lo/yang na/ oṃ su sti/ bde legs su 'phel gyur cigastod shel dkar yul nas gdan drangs pa'i/khrung rdza ma pham g.yu mtsho 'di/phyi gser bya lta bu'i gdangs gshog ldan/nang dngul dkar lta bu'i 'od mdangs che/g.yas su a long btags pa 'di/stag gral g.yas su 'khyil ba yin/g.yon du a long btags pa 'di/156 gzig gral g.yon du 'khyil ba yin/

zhal mchu dbyings la bstan pa 'di/zhugs gral yongs la bstan pa yin/khrung rdza ma pham g.yu mtsho la/bkra shis pa'i mgul dar legs pa gcig 'bul lo/chang gibashad la/lo la btsos pa'i lo chang yod/lo chang lo yag kham pa yod/zla la btsos pa'i zla chang yod/zla chang zil mngar ldan pa yod/zhag la btsos pa'i zhag chang yod/zhag chang zhag po me 'bar yod/nyin la btsos pa'i nyin chang yod/nyin chang bdud rtsi lo yag yod/chang thengs gsum bzhes dang dbu 'phang mtho/rtags dang rten 'brel 'grig le yod/ja'abashadari/dngul rkyan nang la ja 'dren yod/ja 'di yi 'byung khungs bshad pas na/ 157

shar rgya nag bkra shis ri bo nas/tshong dpon nor bu bzang po gcigalag do kurma bkra shis gnyis/rgya drel mi nyag tshal mo gsum/rgya nag po'i ja g.yang 'bebs pa'i dus/nyi ri'i gseb kyi shog dkar ja/srib ri'i gseb kyi shog nag ja/nyi srib bar gyi shog dmar ja/ja rab ja yi bla med de/rgya lcang me tog g.yang 'dzin gcigatil 'bru ja yi dpon po gnyis/can shel ja yi dpa' bo gsum/'bru thang ja yi ma chen bzhi/lha ja ja yi g.yog mo lnga / ko tshe ja yi g.yog po drug/rdza chu bsil ma de dang bdun/'bri mar ser po de dang brgyad/byang tshwa dkar mo de dang dgu/dgu ser ja yi dgu dkrugs brgyab/158

lugadzinapharadzugasaXdzag giphabashad pa/dbyar rtswa sna gang 'dzoms su zhugs pa'i g.yang dkar lugaston chu sna gang 'dzoms su zhugs pa'i g.yang dkar lugadagun zhugs yul gang dro ru zhugs pa'i g.yang dkar lugalug khyed dang skal bzang zla ba 'dra/khram khyod dang rma bo smin drug 'dra/lug gcig ma yin lug pa zer/phyi bal lug pa'i lug pa zer/nang sha tshil lug pa'i lug pa zer/nam rgyun lud shing lug pa'i lug pa zer/gzugs mi zer nor rtsa 'dzugs pa'i 'dzugs/de ring zhugs gral sgor mo'i rgyan du 'dzugs pa'i 'dzugs/rkang pa mi zer bkang ba zer/bang mdzod nor gyis bkang pa'i bkang ba zer/tshang ra mi zer tshang ba zer/bu nor longs spyod tshang ba'i tshang ba zer/rtsib ma mi zer brtsigs pa zer/rtsi bcud brgya zas brtsigs pa'i brtsigs pa zer/stod po mi zer mthon po zer/dbu 'phang dgung las mtho ba'i mthon po zer/ 159

brang khog mi zer grangs med zer/'khor 'bangs grangs med yong ba'i grangs med zer/lag pa mi zer legs pa zer/bya ba ci byas legs pa'i legs pa zer/mjing pa mi zer 'gying pa zer/snang dgra bo'i phyogs la 'gying pa zer/sha bal tshil gyis rgyan pa'i g.yang dkar khyod/de ring zhugs gral sgor mo'i rgyan du byon par bkra shes kyi mgul dar gcig 'bul lo/yang na/ oṃ su sti/ bde legs su 'phel gyur cigabyang thang lhas ra gru bzhi nas gdan drangs pa'i/lug pho bal sha gnyis ldan 'di/nam rgyun lung pa bzang po'i rtswa chu gang bzang la zhugs kyang /de ring zhugs gral sgor mo'i 'dzugs la gdan drangs pa yin/lug mi zer lug pa zer/phyi bal lug pa'i lug pa zer/nang sha tshil lug pa'i lug pa zer/nam rgyun lud shing lug pa'i lug pa zer/rnga ma mi zer mnga' thang zer/bu nor mnga' thang rgyas pa zer/160

rkang pa mi zer khengs pa zer/bang mdzod nor gyis khengs pa zer/long mi zer longs spyod zer/gnas khang longs spyod che ba zer/rtseb ma mi zer brtsigs pa zer/dkar mo 'bru yis brtsigs pa zer/lag pa mi zer legs pa zer/bya ba kun la legs pa zer/sog pa mi zer gsog pa zer/nor gsog pa'i gsog pa zer/brang mi zer pho brang zer/sems nyid brang ba'i pho brang zer/mjing pa mi zer 'gying pa zer/phyi dgra bo'i phyogs la 'gying pa zer/ltag pa mi zer bstan pa zer/sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba zer/lha lug dung dkar la bkra shes kyi mgul dar gcig 'bul lo/darasu rgabashadari/dar shing smyug bzang ldem ldem 'di/ 161

yul ljongs lho rong gting nas gdan drangs pa'i/rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo lnga/rtsa ba a ma chang ma'i khrung rgyan nyan pa yod/rtse mo sku rlung dar ba'i dar shing nyan pa yod/gangs la nyi shar dar mtshon sna lnga'i mkhar/rgyal dar dkar po lha ras 'bug 'di sgron/mkhar chen 'di yi pho lha'i dbus su btsugs/btsugs dang ma btsugs dgra lha'i dbu 'phang mtho ba la gzigs rsha rsha /swo swo lha rgyal lo/khyo'ajihostond ba/'dzam gling sa gzhi kun la dbang bsgyur ba/sngon bsags bsod nams stobs las legs bskrun pa'i/gzugs sku nyi ma lta bu'i gzi brjid can/lha sras gzhon nu'i mdzes sdug dpal gyis ni/gangs ri'i mdangs 'phrog rab dkar seng ge 'dra/seng ge gangs ri 'grims ltar brtan par shogakhri brtan mi 'gyur 'dzam gling gser las grub/g.yas g.yon seng ge stag pa'i khri yi steng /162

za 'og rgyan bzhi dmar ser sngo ljang dkar/bzhugs 'bol lnga tshan rim par brtsegs pa'i steng /'dzam gling bod yul khri skor bcu gsum gyi/'bru mchog 'dod rgu longs spyod 'khyil ba'i dbus/ja chang dpal yon 'dzoms pa'i bde skyid kyis/rtag tu rtse dgar rol baglo nyams ldan ni/steng phyogs lha yi yul na'ang med do zhes/'dir tshogs gral zhugs rnams kyis yang yang gleng /de ring phun sum tshogs pa'i dus kyi char/mi nor zas gos thams cad dbang du 'dus/rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun dpal gyis rgyan/bkra shis rtags brgyad kyis mtshon dar dkar 'di/lha sras dbang 'dus khyed kyi rgyan du 'bul/yang na / oṃ su sti/ bde legs su gyur cigapha la bu skyes ge sar dpa' bo'i rgyud/dgra mgo 'dul bzhin dpa' bo'i rgyud/gnyen mgo skyong bzhin dpa' bo'i rgyud/a ma'i dgra 'dul gnyen skyong la mgul dar gcig 'bul/pho rab la bltas na 'go khrid yod/ri bo 'dra ma'i tshugs gcig yod/ 163

rgya mtsho 'dra ma'i klad gcig yod/gtsang chab 'dra ma'i gzhung gcig yod/nyi zla 'dra ma'i bkrags gcig yod/bu ge sar rgyal po dang dbyer med la mgul dar 'bul/spyang grung 'dzoms la khra yi bu/chung la mtshar pa padma'i me tog 'dra/bu chung lha'u dar po dang dbyer med la mgur dar 'di 'bul lo/mna' ma'i shad pa/oṃ swa sti/ bde legs su gyur cigade ring gza' skar mchog tu dga' ba'i nyin/phun sum tshogs pa'i lha rdzas za 'og 'bol/bkra shis g.yung drung 'khyil ba'i gdan steng na/mthong na mi mthun med pa'i lang tsho ni/stong phyogs lha mo'i gzugs su shar ba ltar/gzugs mdzes lta na sdug cing tshul bzang ma/legs pa'i mdog dang 'jam pa'i dri mchog ldan/yid 'ong 'dod rgu reg bya sogs tshang ba'i/btsun mo rin chen lta bu gang nyid la/14 sngon du bkra shes gro so phye mar 'bul/

bde legs rtags mtshan g.yang ṭa'i zhal dkar nang /'dzam gling rtsi tog snying po bdud rtsi'i bcud/rgya gar bal bod bza' cha'i btung ba sogs/phun sum tshogs pa byur bur bkang ste 'bul/bkra shes rtags brgyad ri mos brgyan pa yi/rgyal dar dkar mo nang mdzod dri med 'di/mgul du 'bul bas dge legs gong 'phel shogayang na/ oṃ su sti/ bde legs su 'phel gyur cigayar bltas lha yi sras mo 'dra/mar bltas klu yi sras mo 'dra/bzhengs zer na thang zhang bkram pa 'dra/bzhugs zer na gur khang phug pa 'dra/rgyab gang bltas skra lo'i bsil ljang ma/mdun gang bltas so dkar 'dzum legs ma/phar 'gro khra chung mig gis skyel shes ma/tshur yong so dkar 'dzum gyis bsu shes ma/a lce lha gcig rgya bza' dang dbyer med la/bkra shis kyi mgul dar gcig 'bul lo/165

ba'idzib kyibashad la/gtsang g.yas ru phun sum tshogs pa'i sar/dpal rtsal drug 'dzoms shing ngang rgyud ring /mi gzhan gyis mthong ba'i mod nyid la/pho skyes pa kun gyi dgra lha 'dra/dman bu mo sems yid 'phrog pa yi/yab rgyal po 'di ni ngo mtshar che/brtan mi 'gyur gser khri chen po'i steng /rgyan gos bkra shis 'bol gdan btings/g.yang chags pa gro yi g.yung drung 'khyil/yab rgyal po mi 'gyur brtan par bzhugs/yab rgyal po sku gzugs gangs ri 'dra/gangs ri la nyi zer phog pa bzhin/dkar dmar gyi mdangs ldan zla ba 'dra/zhwa lham sogs na bzas brgyan tsa na/bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad bum pa la/dar tshon sna lnga yis brgyan pa 'dra/snyan rgyan dang mgul rgyan rin chen sogs/166 seng ge la sogs g.yu ral rgyas pa 'dra/

ci yab rgyal po'i dbu zhwa 'bog ser 'di/shar gser ri'i rtse la nyi shar 'dra/bkra shis 'dod rgu 'dzoms pa'i dus de ring /bkra shis rtags brgyad kyis mtshon pa'i lha dar 'di/bkra shis yab rgyal mgul du phul ba yin/bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs par shogayang na/ oṃ su sti/ bde legs su 'phel gyur cigayab chen khyed dang ri rgyal lhun po 'dra/da las dga' na dga' dus med/gangs dkar mtho la nyi ma shar/da las skyid na skyid dus med/pho brang nang du bu nor 'dzoms/yab chen kun bzang bde chen dang dbyer med la bkra shis kyi mgul dar 'di 'bul lo//yang na/ mi rgyud la bltas nas gnyen sgrigachu bgrod la bltas nas zam pa brgyab/rigs rgyud la bltas nas dar 'then/nga'i lag tu yod pa'i dar dkar 'di/dar rtse la bkra shis rtags brgyad yod/dar dkyil rgyal srid sna bdun yod/ 167

dar gsham la mu tig 'dzabs dzob yod/rgyu de gsum 'dzoms pa'i dar dkar 'di/de ring yab chen khyed la 'bul/tshe ring lha dang mnyam pa shogargyu nor klu ltar 'khor bar shogaba'igumagadar 'dulari'ibashad pa/oṃ su sti/ bde legs su 'phel gyur cigaphun sum tshogs pa'i rin chen g.yu khri'i stong /bkra shis gos bzang las grub 'bol gdan la/yum chen a ma mi 'gyur brtan par bzhugs/'bras chang bsil ma bdud rtsi'i btung snod 'di/shar phyogs rgyal khab chen po'i bang mdzod nas/thon pa'i bkra shis dkar sang yu ring yin/'di'i nang byur bur bdud rtsi'i bcud/bde legs btung ba'i phyogs 'di dgyes bzhes nas/rtag tu bde skyid glu len bkra shis shogarab dkar bkra shis rtags mdzes dar dkar 'di/yum chen a ma'i bde legs rgyan du 'bul/168 yang na/ lko swa sti/ bde legs su 'phel gyur cig

yum chen nyid ni ma pham g.yu mtsho 'dra/ca co'i sgrogs 'dabs med pa mer re bzhugs/rgyan gos bzhes pas bkrags dang ldan/yum chen lha gcig kun bzang dang dbyer med la/bkra shis kyi mgul dar legs pa gcig 'bul lo/bag59sdog ma'ibashad sda/oṃ su sti/ bde legs su gyur cig gus zhabs che zhing kha la nyan/zhabs tog sgrub cing rnam 'gyur yagagayog mo 'dzoms pa skyid dang dbyer med la/bkra shis kyi mgul dar 'di 'bul lo//bag g.yog ma ni bu mo'i khyim nas btang ba'i bag ma'i skyo rogs bu mo gcig yod pa der zer ba yin/ bag g.yog ma mang che ba mna' ma'i gcen mo gcung mo lta bu gtong ba dang / la las mna' ma'i sru mo/ a nee sogs gtong ba'i srol yang yod/ sngar mi tshang che gras nyung shas kyis bag g.yog la g.yog mo btang nas bag g.yog de'ang mna' ma dang mnyam du bu mo 'gro yul gyi khyim tshang la bdag pa'ang yod 'on kyang spyir bag g.yog ma gnas skabs bu mo'i skyo rogs su bsdad nas phyir log 'gro yi yod/169

— mna' ma skyel mkhan byibashad pa/rgya gar bal bod skad bsgyur lo tsā ba/sgos mkhas mkhas dbang thon mi sam bho ṭa/sam bho ṭa yis lus ngag dka' spyad kyis/rgya gar dang li yul gnas mchog nas/chos zab rgyas mdo rgyud mang po zhigabyang kha ba'i yul 'dir spyan drangs ltar/gtsang dbus 'gyur dgon chen zhing gnyis la/dpal bkra shis lhun po'i nye 'dabs kyi/yid bzhin nor bus gang ba'i khang gsar nang /nor bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po ni/gdan 'dren pa lo tsā blon po la/tshonor bsam 'phel deng 'dir spyan drangs pa'i/legs gsol gyi bkra shes dar dkar 'bul/yang na/ oṃ su sti/ bde legs su 'phel gyur cigs gtsang mkhas shing sa bcud sbad/mig gi yul du bzhugs tshor dkar ba 'dugarna ba'i yul du gsung bshad snyan pa 'dugabazhugs gral yongs la zhal so dkar ba 'dug170 bram ze zla ba bzang po dang dbyer med la bkra shis kyi mgul dar

gcig 'bul lo/ /bar 'amalhang dga' pa'ibashad la/oṃ su sti/ bde legs su 'phel gyur cigabade bar shog pa'i ring lugs bla na med/zhu chen bsgyur med tshig bur gnas 'dug pas/skad gnyis smra ba bee ro ka cog sogs lo tsā ba chen po rnams dang dbyer med la mgul dar gcig 'bul lo/yang na/ oṃ su sti/ bde legs su 'phel gyur cigargya bod gnyis kyi lo tsā ba/kha lag bar gyi thur ma bzhin/chu phan tshun bar gyi zam pa yin/phye sgo gsar pa'i g.ya' shing yin/rgya skad bod la bsgyur mkhan yin/bod skad rgya la bsgyur mkhan yin/rgya dar dri med a shel de/sems bzang snying dga' ba'i rgyan du 'bul/ga'u am phrag tu bcug pa'i rtsi hrug byug med par/g.yu 'brug sngon mo ldir ba bzhin/bzhugs gral 'di ru zhal shob kyi lo ma 'ur chem chem ldirsha /'a

ta'/mkhu'ibashad pa/a khu lags dang nang gi nor bu 'dra/lho tshong byang dang byang zog lho la drangs/zas nor g.yag rtas phyi nang khor yangs bkang /nor bus bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dar dkar 'bul/bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs/spoyo dang rmosa'ibashad pa/spo bo nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/sngon rabs 'od 'bum 'phro ba'i rten du 'bul/bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs/rmo bo a phyi nang gi nor bu la/dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rten du 'bul/bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs/mazha rganagazhon gyibashadari/a ne lags dang byu ru'i mchod rten 'dra/172 dam chos bstan pa 'dzin pa'i ngang la bzhugs/

bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs/a ne gzhon pa gung sman rgyal mo 'dra/gung sman rgyal mo'i bka' drin 'khyer dus med/ma mo lu gu'i dpe bzhin byams skyong gnang rogs gnang /bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs/sras mo'ibashad pa/sras mo nyid dang rgya gar rma bya 'dra/rma bya sgro mdongs ngoms shing lus 'gyur mkhas/sgro mdongs chos kha dwangs la kha mdog mdzes/sgro mdongs rang mdangs rgyas pa'i ngang la bzhugs/bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs/lhadapon gyi shad pa/khyim 'dir phywa g.yang ma lus kun/gnas 'dir kha ba babs ltar 'gugs mdzad pa'i/dmar ser na bza' bzhes pa'i lha dpon la/bstan 'gro'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i dar dkar 'bul/bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs/173

mna' ma'ithob kyibashad pa/dngos rdzas nor skal gnang ba'i yab chen la/bka' drin rgyun chad med pa'i spyan mnga' nas/dngos rdzas 'dod yon thams cad ster ba'i yab/khyad par bka' drin 'khor med yab chen la/dkar 'jam lha yi gos bzang 'di 'bul lo/bkra shes bde legs phun sum tshogs/skyela'ajibashad pa/dngos grub sgo skyes phebs pa'i skyel dpon khyed/'chad rtsod rtsom la 'jug pa mkhas shing mdzangs/glu gar gnyis kyi phyogs la 'gran zla bral/legs bshad gtam gyi phyogs la nyams re bzang /mi yi seng ge khyed la mjal dar 'bul/bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs/(spyi'i 'gro stangs la mna' ma skyel bar 'gro mkhan ni mna' ma'i phu bo'am nu bo 'gro ba dang / skyel rogs dkar nye zhal bde la bab chags tshul mthun nyams myong can zhig khrid 'gro yi yod/ spyir mna' ma skyel mkhan la de ra'i pha 'gro srol med pa dang /mna' ma'i pha de thugs spro la phebs kyang skyel bsu mkhan phyin tshar ba'i nyin gnyis pa'am gsum pa tsam la 'gro ba mang )174

bsu mi'i shadari/klu rgyal dga' bo 'jog pa'i bzhugs yul nas/nor bu pang du bzhes pa'i bsu dpon khyed/nor bu'i byin rlabs thugs rje'i smon lam gyis/khams gsum dbang du 'dus pa'i dar dkar 'bul/bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs/(bsu mi ni spyir bu'i yab 'gro srol med par bu'i a zhang ngam srun mched nye gras gcig dang bar mi'am yang na dkar ba nye ba gcig rogs par khrid nas 'gro ba mang /)khrunga'adren ma'ibashad pa/sman khrung zhu ma dbyangs can lha mo khyed/gzugs mdzes pa lho rong rma bya 'dra/ldem 'khyug pa lcang gling 'jol mo 'dra/gsung snyan pa rgya gling pi wang 'dra/snyan 'gyur sgra dbyangs khrol ba'i dar dkar 'bul/bkra shes bde legs phun sum tshogs/gong gsal gyi gnyen bshad de rnams gtsang gi yul gru mang por dar khyab che ba ma zad dbus kyi yul gru 'ga' shas su'ang dar khyab yod/ zhib phra'i bshad pa'i nang don rnams yul lung mi 'dra ba dang / gtong mkhan gyi mi mi 'dra ba/ gtong yul gyi gnas tshul mi 'dra bar brten nas 'a~X ba

'gro ba yod rung spyi'i cha nas 'gro stangs gcig mtshungs yin/ yul 'ga' shas su gnyen ston dngos gzhi'i brgyud rim nang lha 'dogs zhes pa'i byed sgo zhig spel srol yod pa'ang khyim des dar 'dzugs lha gsol byed pa dang / bu dang bu mo de min rten 'brel mdzad sgo'i sku mgron tshang ma khang pa'i stong du phebs thog lha dpon nam a lags kyis chos kyi byed sgo spel te mna' ma de bu'i khyim gyi lha rnams la rtsis sprad khul byed kyi yod pa dang / skabs de dus skyel mis dar lcog gi bshad pa gong gsal ltar gtong srol yod/ 'on kyang yul la lar lha 'dogs byed srol med pas dar lcog gi bshad pa mi gtong ba dang / yul mang por chu dang lci ba'i bshad pa gtong srol med la skabs dībs skyel bsu mkhan gyi shes tshad mi 'dra bas bshad pa rgyas bsdus sna tshogs da/ rten 'brel dngos gzhi'i nyin mjug ma der yul mang por grol ston gra rgyas spel srol yod par grol bsang du 'bod/ de yang rten 'brel mdzad sgo'i nyin mjug ma'i phyi dro sgo ra'i dbus su khri lcog brgyab/ de'i steng du gro so phye mar dang chang phud bzhag bsang phung la me spar/ bu dang mna' ma/ yab yum spun mched dang sku mgron lhan rgyas kyis bsang phung bskor te rnam thar gtong ba dang smyo gi ki sro swo lha gsol lo/ de ring gnam la skar ma bzang sa la nyi ma dro/ bar la dus tshod bzang / sngon ma'i lo la mchod gtor byas/ phyi ma'i lo la gtang rag phul/ khyad par yul phyogs 'di la gnas pa thams cad la mi nad phyags nad ma yong zhig dmag 'khrug mu ge ma langs shog 'gro 176 sto

ba'i lam la bar chad ma gtong zhig btab nas smin pa'i lo la smon tshig zhu/ki ki swo swo lha gsol lo/ zhes lha rgyal 'then nas rten 'brel dngos gzhi mjug sgril bar byed/rten 'brel gyi dus tshod ring thung ni dud tshang de'i 'byor pa che chung dang /thonaskyed kyi dal brel/ rten 'brel snga lan mang nyung bcas la gzhigs nas nyin gsum nas bcu yi bar du mdzad sgo spel mkhan sna tshogs yod/ dus tshang che gras gtam 'dod can la las rten 'brel mdzad sgo zla phyed tsam spel mkhan yang re zung mthong rgyu yod/ 6 bag ma zhag gsum dpon mo yin/ bag ma lo gsum g.yog mo yin/’ zhes pa'i gtsang khul gyi gtam dpe dang / da lta'i bar lha sa khul du rten 'brel mdzad sgo nyin gsum byed srol yod pa la gzhigs na gna' srol la rten 'brel mdzad sgo nyin gsum rang las byed srol med pa 'dra la/ phyis su dud tshang che gras 'ga' shas kyis tsa 'jig rten lto gos gtam gsum ’ zhes pa ltar gtam stong pa 'dod nas rten 'brel mdzad sgo rgyas spel byas stabs sngar yod kyi dus chod ring thung cung 'tshams pa de la'ang 'gyur ba byung nas bag med rgyas bza' rgyas 'thung gi mdzad sgo zhig la gyur yod/lnga/ lta skor dang gnyen 'phrad/bu mo mna' mar ster nas zla ba gcig lhag tsam phyin pa'i rjes bu mo'i a mas bu mor lta bar 'gro srol yod/ bu mo'i ster skal rnams skabs sdo bsta mo

mna' mar gtong skabs mnyam du ster srol med par dus tshod nges can song rjes lha len byas mi zhes ster skal rnams sprad kyi yod/ de lta bu yin na bu mo'i a ma bu mo'i shig gos (brje len byed ched kyi gos kyi don )skyel bar 'gro zer ba dang / ster skal rnams mna' ma skyel skabs chabs cig tu sprad yod na/ bu mor lta skor la 'gro zer srol yod/ de dus bu mo'i a mas gzab mchor sprad nas bu mo'i gyon gos dang nam rgyun bu mos dga' ba'i zas sne bcas khyer nas bu mor lta bar 'gro la/ bu'i khyim du slebs rjes mna' ma'i ma la sne len gang legs zhu ba dang / mna' ma'i a ma bsdad pa'i ring mna' ma de thag ring phyi las la ma btang bar a ma dang mnyam du sdod du 'jug de'i ring ma yis khyim tshang gi 'cham mthun dang / bu des byams skyong brtse zhen ji 'dra yod med sogs 'dri ba dang / bu mos ma byung ba dang ma 'grig pa'i sa la rang gi nyams myong gi thog nas bya lugs byed lugs kyi slob ston byed kyi yod/ bu mos a ma la sems ngal dang dus rgyun bshad mi phod pa'i gtam gang yod shod pa dang / a ma brgyud nas mna' ma'i re 'dod dang bsam 'char rnams bu dang bu'i yab yum la shod kyi yod/ spyir a ma bu'i khyim tshang du zla ba gcig /yas g.yon sdod pa mang la/ gza' 'khor gcig gnyis sdod mkhan yang da/ bu mo mna' mar ster nas lo gcig phyin pa'i mtshams su bu mo pha khyim du gnyen 'phrad la gtong srol yod/ gnyen 'phrad ces pa ni gtso bo bu mo de rang gi pha ma dang gnyen nye spun mched mjal bar yong pa yin/ yul la lar 178

skyo log dang gnyen log kyang zer srol yod/ de dus bu mo'i khyo bo de bu mo skyel bar yong ba dang / bu mo'i pha ma spun mched la sprod ched kyi lag rtags yang mi nyung tsam khyer dgos la/ de bu mo'i pha khyim du nyin gsum bzhi sdod kyi yod/khyo bo de rang gi mna' ma'i pha khyim du sdod ring bu mo'i pha mas slob gso sna tshogs skyon pa'i srol yod/ khyo bo rang khyim la log phyin rjes bu mo zla ba gcig yas mas rang gi pha khyim du sdod kyi yod/ gnyen 'phrad la gtong min dang /dus gang la gtong / dus tshod ring thung gtong tshang ma bu'i pha ma rnams la rag las pa yin/ 'di nas gnyen ston gyi rgyud rim cha tshang rdzogs so/ /drug gnyen bshad dang gnyen ston rig rtsed las 'phros pa'i bsams gzhigs/gong du bshad zin pa ltar bod kyi gnyen sgrig mdzad ston ni thun mong ma yin pa'i bod mi rigs rang nyid kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i mdzad sgo zhig yin/bod rigs ni glu gar la mkhas la spro nyams ldan pa dang / rnam rig bkra zhing brtson 'grus che ba/ kha zhe gnyis su med pa'i blo dkar can gyi lo rgyus ha cang ring ba'i mi rigs zhig yin la/ rig gnas phun sum tshogs pa'i ya rabs gus zhabs ldan pa'i mi rigs shig kyang yin/ de ltar rlabs che ba'i mi rigs 'di'i gnyen sgrig mdzad sgo'i nang kun gyis longs su spyod pa'i dmangakā /da

rig rtsed phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod/de'i nang mi nor dngos gsum gyi bshad pa ni dga' ston 'di'i dmigs bsal gyi rig rtsed byed sgo zhig yin/ de la tshigs su bcad pa'i sgo nas rtsom bris byas pa mang zhing / lhug ma dang spel ma'ang yod pa gong gsal ltar dang / a khu ston pa'i gtam rgyud nang tsa dmangs kyi blo gros padma las/ snyan pa'i dri zhim 'di ru ldang mi ①zhes smras pa ltar/ dmangs kyi blo gros las byung ba'i bshad pa'i brjod tshig rnams snyan zhing 'jebs la/ ri mo ltar mdzes pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ brjod bya'i nang don la mtshon na'ang bod kyi yul gyi khyad chos mtshon pa dang lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul mtshon pa sogs ha cang phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod/ de yang dper na/ bu mo gdan 'dren skabs yar bzhengs bskul gyi brda sbyor bshad pa la 6 pha bzang gi bu mo yar bzhengs shig ma bzang gi bu mo yar bzhengs shig lha yul skyid pa'i zhing stod bde khang du/ pha yab chen gangs ri te si 'dra/ de la dgongs te bu mo yar bzhengs shig yum chen a ma ma pham g.yu mtsho 'dra/ de la dgongs te bu mo yar bzhengs shig tshe gang gtan grogs gangs la nyi shar 'dra/ de la dgongs te bu mo yar bzhengs shig phu na rta lug 'bri g.yag bsam mi khyab/de la dgongs te bu mo yar bzhengs shig mda' na sa khang 'bru yi bang mdzod yod/ de la dgongs te bu mo yar bzhengs shig zhes pa ni bu mor bu'i phyogs /bye0 mokhu ston pa'i sgrung 〉wa(bod kyi rtsom rig rtsal 〉1985lo'i du deg2par gsal/

ngo sprod mdor tsam byas pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ yang sgos de nas shes thub par bod yul der phu na 'brog pa gnas shing phyugs rigs dkar nag phra gsum gyis khengs/ mda' ru zhing pa so nam gyi las la brtson zhing bang mdzod 'bru yi bkangs pa dang bcas yul gyi dge mtshan thon khungs sogs mdor bstan pa yin/ yang dper na/ bu'i khyim gyi sgo skas nang gi sgrig chas dang bcas pa'i bshad pa la/6 i bde legs su gyur cig bkra shis nyams su dga' ba'i lha tshogs kyi 'jig rten khams kun bde legs kyi snang ba bzang pos sa kun khyab pa des/ mi nor yongs kyi bsam pa grub/ de ring sa gzhi la nyi ma dro/ gnam la skar ma bzang / bar du dus tshod kyi gza' skar phun sum tshogs pa'i skabs 'dir/ mkhar dkar po'i mdun sa gru bzhi la/ sgo mo phyi sgo gcig dang nang sgo gcig bar sgo tsan dan smug po'i sgo/ them pa sngon po g.yu la bcol/ ru bzhi smug po'i zong la bcol/ sgo 'bor dngul dkar me long yin/skas 'dzigs tsan dan dkar dmar las byas pa de/ 'jogs bzhin bskyod pas steng du 'ja' 'od kyis gur phub 'og na gcan gzan gyi lpags pa'i gdan bting / bar du rin chen lnga las grub pa'i snod bzang po'i nang /mchod chang a rag bdud rtsi mtsho ltar bskyil/ de sngar yang 'khyil la dang yang 'khyil/ rgyab mdzes pa'i dar gos kyi yol ba mdun dkar po'i gser cog dngul cog rna bar snyan pa'i glu gar/ pi wang/ gling bu sogs thos pa tsam gyis yid dbang 'phrog pa'i gnas khang bzang po nor gyi bdag po rnastu /sa

sras kyi bang mdzod lha mi'i longs spyod 'dod rgya'i dpal dang ldan pa g.yang chags kyi khang bzang 'di lta bur slobs pa shin tu skal ba re bzang 0zhes pa lta bur ma gzhi bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel dang bzang ba brjod pa'i 'ud shob rab btags kyi rgyan spros yod nges kyang / me med par du ba dang / gzugs med par grib ma yong don med pas bod ljongs su sngar nas gser dngul sogs rin chen sna lnga dang / dar gos rigs bzang tsan dan sogs longs su spyod mus yin pa ma zad sa der ri dwags gcan gzan sogs shin tu mang po gnas yod pa shes thub/lo rgyus kyi deb ther 〈rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long sminang du gsal ba'i blon po mgar gyis rgya bza'i gos kyi gong ba nas mda'i ltong gis bzung nas gdan 'dren skabs blangs pa'i glu ni 'di ltar tsa e ma ngo mtshar che/ lha gcig kong jo khyed/ bdag gi tshig la gson/ bkra shes nyams su dga'/ bod kyi rgyal khams na/ rin chen lnga las grub/ rgyal po'i pho brang nang / mi rje lha yis mdzad/ srong btsan sgam po de/ rigs gzugs dpal gyis brjid/ mthong na sems yid 'phrog thugs rje chen po lags/ rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs/ 'bangs rnams bka' la nyan/ rgyal blon 'khor 'bangs rnams/dga' skyid glu ru len/ chos kyi nyi ma shar/ dpal gyi sgron me btegs/ ri la shing sna tshang / sa gzhi yangs pa la/ 'bru sna lnga yi tshogs/ go mtshams med pa 1༷2 bod kyi gna' rab gyi chang sa'i lugasakhros 〉nang gsal/

skyes/ gser dngul zangs lcags sogs/ rin chen du ma yod/ gnag rta lug gsum rgyas/ dga' skyid de ltar yod/ e ma ngo mtshar che/ lha gcig kong jo gson mi duzhes pa 'dir yang gong gi khyad chos de ltar ldan yod/gong du brjod pa'i dpe mtshon de gsum las bod kyi yul gyi spyi'i chags tshul ngo sprod byung yod/ de yang shel ltar 'tsher ba'i dkar po'i gangs ri dang / g.yu ltar sngo ba'i mtsho mo/ shin tu stug pa'i nags tshal gyis brgyan pa'isnan ljongs 'dir/ phu na gnag rta lug gsum dang ri dwags kyi tshogs mang ba/ mda' ru sa zhing rgya che ba ri la rtse shing nags tshal bzang ba/ gang sar rin chen gser dngul sogs nor bu'i thon khungs bzang ba zhig yin par go thub/ dper na/ rgya bza' kong jo btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mor rdzong skabs rgya nag rgyal pos bu mo la sems gso gtong skabs bod kyi yul gyi khyad chos legs par bshad yod de yang 6 nga yi mig dang 'dra ba'i bu mo khyod/ bod ces bya ba kha ba can gyi yul/ yul las khyad par 'phags pa de yin te/ gangs ri rang bzhin mchod rten grub pa'i gnas/ mtsho bzhi g.yu yi maṇḍal bkram pa 'dra/ ya mtshan gser gyi me tog rgyas pa'i gling / bsil la mdzes pa lha gnas gzhal yas khang / chu bo bzhi 'bab shing rtsi nags kyis mdzes/ 'bru sna lnga 'khrungs rin chen sna tshogs byung / rkang bzhis kun khyab rtsi thog mar la spyod/ de ltar ngo mtshar che ba'i gnas mchog der miXzhes pa lta ཿ /ཿswā (ཿklo /sdu ཿṭā ṭā shātā )rshatā /sdu//— 183

bu'o/ /lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul mtshon pa'ang dper na/ btung ba rgya ja'i bshad pa la/6 dngul rkyan nang la ja 'dren yod/ ja 'di yi 'byung khungs bshad pa na/shar rgya nag bkra shes ri bo nas/ tshong dpon nor bu bzang po gcig lag do kurma bkra shis gnyis/ rgya drel mi nyag mtshal mo gsum/ rgya nag po'i ja g.yang 'bebs pa'i dus/ nyi ri'i gseb kyi shog dkar ja/ sribs ri'i gseb kyi shog nag ja/ nyi sribs bar gyi shog dmar ja/ ja rab ja yi bla med de/ rgya ja me tog g.yang 'dzin gcig sil 'bru ja yi dpon po gnyis/can shel ja yi dpa' pho gsum/ 'bru thang ja yi ma chen bzhi/ lha bya ja yi g.yog mo lnga/ ko tshe ja yi g.yog po drug rdza chu bsil ma de dang bdun/ 'bri mar ser po de dang brgyad/ byang tshwa dkar po de dang dgu/ dgu ser ja yi dgu dkrugs brgyab/ miXzhes pa'i ja yi bshad pa las nga tshor gsal bshad byung bar/ bod rigs kyi rgyun gtan 'tsho ba'i nang med thabs med pa'i ja yi 'byung khungs rgya nag yin pa shes pa dang / snga mo 'grim 'grul ji ltar byed pa go shes thub pa ma zad ja de'i skye sa nyi zer phog pa'i sa yin na de'i 'dab ma dkar ba dang / nyi zer ma phog pa'i gnas yin na ja'i 'dab ma nag pa dang /nyin srib bar du skyes pa zhig yin na de yi 'dab ma dmar ba yin pa yang blor rtogs thub pa dang / ja bsrub ma zhig bzo ba la sdeb sbyor gang 'dra byed sdu (jo mo glang ma 〉1985lo'i dus deb dang por gsal/

dgos min sogs ja yi shes bya rnams ngo sprod byas yod/ bshadapa 'di nas lo rgyus thog bod rgya mi rigs gnyis bar gyi ja rta brje res byed pa'i tshong las bzang po yod pa shes thub/bu mo'i bzhon rta'i bshad pa la ra rta 'di rta ngo ma shes na/ gyi ling gi gnam rta dkar po yin/(a ce )rgya bza'i chibs chen yin/ steng lha gnas gnang ba'i lha rta dkar po yin/ la la 'gro ba'i la rta 'di la zhu/ 'og klu nas gnang ba'i chu rta ngang pa yin/ chu la 'gro ba'i chu rta 'di la zhu/ bar btsan nasaganang ba'i btsan rta rkyang po yin/ thang la 'gro ba'i thang rta 'di la zhu/sngon dus lha cig kong jos chibs/ kha dro g.yang chags kyi rta zhig yin/ da lta rigs bzang gi bu mos chibs/ kha dro g.yang chags kyi bag rta 'di la zhu/’ zhes pa'i bshad pa 'di'i nang chos lugs nang gi sa steng sa bla sa 'og gsum dang rang byung khams kyi ri chu rlung gsum dang legs par sbyar nas don dngos rta yi nus pa bshad pa ste/ de yang / la ni mtho ba gnam gyi ka ba dang 'dra bas la la 'gro dus rta po rnams lha rta dang mtshungs/ rgya tsho'i gting na klu yul yod par sems pas gyi ling rnams chu la 'gro dus klu yul gyi rta dang 'dra/ bar ni cimi yul sgang 'di yin par rtsi bas ri chu'i bar gyi thang gis tshab byas nas thang rta yin zhes brjod nas don dngos rta yi nus pa brjod pa ni ri chu klung gsum 'dzom pa'i bod yul 'di 'gro 'ong 'grim 'grul byed par/ rta yis gtso byas nor phyugs la brten dgos pa shes thub/ gna' bo'i bod kyi gtam dper 6 mkhas pa'i gshog pa yon tan yin/ skya bo'i gshog pa rta 1sdu/ga

yin/mi zhes pa ltar bod yul du 'gro 'ong byed pa'i skabs 'gros ldan rta rnams 'dab chags mkha' la 'phur ba'i gshog pa lta bur brtsis mthong chen po byed kyi yod pa'ang dmangs kyi ngag rgyun du/tsa 'gro na rta thog sdod na gdan thog zhes grags/ yang bshad pa 'di nas nga tshor gsal bshad byung bar bod rgya mi rigs gnyis bar gyi mthun sgril gyi 'go tshugs pa'i mtshan rtags/ phan tshun rig gnas kyi mtshams sbyor zam pa/ rgya bza' kong jo bod yul du chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mor phebs pa'i dus su/ 'jig rten na gnam gru dang / me 'khor rlangs 'khor sogs kyi ming tsam yang med pa'i dus su kong jo nyid rlabs chen bya ba'i slad du la chu klung gis chod pa'i bshul ring la 'gros ldan rta por brten nas phebs pa ha cang gsal bar shes thub/ (lha cig kong jo'i rnam thar sminang 6 lha cig kong jo nyid rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i bu mo nyi shu rtsa lnga (dang bcas )rang rang gi rta la bzhon nas bod du byon mi①zhes gsal ba des kyang ra sprod thub bo/bu mo'i ster dngos rnams phyar ba bting pa'i steng du bsgrigs nas gnyen yig klog par rtsom pa'i sngon bsu'i bshad pa la tsa rma su ste/ bde legs su gyur cig rta bdun bdag po dro 'jam nyi ma dang / bsil zer rgyal po dkar gsal zla ba gnyis/ rgyu skar rgyal po tho rengs dkar chen gsum/ rten 'gil dbang gis dgung sngon dbyings su mjal/ de la brten nas 'dzam /bye6 rgyal rabasagasal ba'i me long sminang gsal/

gling mun pa gsal/ 'dzam gling mun pa gsal ba'i bkra shes shog za hor mkhan po bo dhi sa twa dang / o rgyan chen po padma 'byung gnas gnyis/ bod kyi rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gsum/ smon lam dbang gis bod yul dbus su mjal/ bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun grub lha khang bzhengs/ de la brten nas bod yul bde skyid dar/ bod yul bde skyid dar ba'i bkra shes shog dpal rtsal sna dgu 'dzom pa'i lha sras dang / mdzangs gsum grogs nang mthun pa'i sras mo gnyis/ gtso bo'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i lha mo gsum/ sngon las dbang gis bzhugs gral 'di ru mjal/ de la brten nas bu nor longs spyod 'phel/ bu nor longs spyod 'phel ba'i bkra shes shog zhes pa'i nang / dang por rang byung khams kyi smag rum bcom pa'i nyi zla skar gsum gyi nus pa brjod pas nam zhar 'gyur med brtan la bsod nams 'phel ba'i smon 'dun dang /gnyis par lo rgyus thog gi mes po'i rlabs chen mdzad rjes brjod yod la/gsum par skabs su babs pa'i bag ston nyin pho mo zung gnyen sgrig byas pa las mi rabs rjes ma 'phel ba dang 'tsho rten longs spyod 'phel ba'i bkris rten 'brel zhus yod/ de'i dum mtshams gnyis pa las nga tshor lo rgyus kyi gnad don chen po zhig gsal bshad thub pa ni/ gna' dus btsan po'i skabs kyi bod kyi rig gnas lag rtsal gcig tu bsdus pa dang / phyi phyogs kyi lag rtsal yang spyad yod pa'i rin thang bla na med pa'i bsam yas lha khang de chos rgyas khri srong lde btsan gyi gangs can la dbang bsgyur ba'i skabs rgya gar gyi mkhan chen zhi ba tsho dang / slob dpon padma 'byung gnas lhag par du 1sdushān
