po sku ngo ma bcas kyi sne khrid dang thabs jus mdzad nas rang rigs kyi mes po rnams kyis bsam yas lha khang de bzhengs pa blor rtogs thub/ kha rgyun du ra lha khang de'i jus gzhi 'god mkhan ni zhi ba 'tsho yin pa dang / sa yul 'dems mkhan patshi 'byung gnas yin pa/ sa sgo phye nas rmang gzhi 'ding mkhan btsan po sku ngo ma yin par grags ’ pa ltar dang / lha khang de bzhengs nas grub pa ni sangs rgyas chos lugs de gangs can gyi ljongs su rtsa ba tshugs pa'i mtshon rtags gal chen zhig yin/ lha khang de bzhengs pa nas bzung 6 bod la rab byung btsun pa'i sde byung ba dang / 'chad grwa dang bsgyur grwa la sogs pa yang tsugs te/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bstan bcos mang po bod yig tu bsgyur par brten/ bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi khrod du sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi shan zhugs pa cung mang po yod/’ ༷pa bston du med/ bsam yas gtsug lag khang de ni bod rigs mi dmangs kyi blo rig las byung ba dang / des skabs de'i bod kyi 'dzugs skrun dang rig gnas sgyu rtsal gyi chu tshad mtshon gyi yod par brten bod kyi lo rgyus nam mkha' yang pa'i dbus su bsam yas lha khang zhes nyi zla ltar bkra ba'o/ /gong gi dpe mtshon de rnams las/ bod dang mi rigs gzhan bar gyi lo rgyus thog gi dpal 'byor gyi brje len dang rig gnas kyi brje res ji byas tshang ma mngon sum gson rjen du dmangs kyi ngag gi me long las lham me lham mer /byeci mgur glu'i lo rgyus 〉nang gsal/

'char ba 'di dang 'di 'dra ba dag ni lo rgyus zhib 'jug gi bya bar shin tu sman pa'i dpyad gzhi gson pa char/ chu/ me/ rlung sogs 'byung khams rkyen ngan gyis nam yang 'jig par ma btub pa'i ngo mtshar can zhig yin pa gor ma chags/gong du bshad zin pa'i mi nor dngos gsum gyi bshad pa 'di rnams phud/ da dung 'das pa'i lo zla'i nang rgyun gtan 'tsho ba dang / dga' ston gyi mdzad sgo gzhan gyi nang du'ang kun gyis longs su spyod pa'i dmangs khrod rig rtsed 'bras dkar gyi bshad pa dang / gzhas dang zhabs bro/ shags gtam gleng ba sogs ha cang phun sum tshogs pa zhig gnyen ston skabs longs suspyod pa'i srol yod/ de'i nang gi 'bras dkar gyi bshad pa ni smra ba'i sgo nas gtam dang glu gzhas spel mar 'jo ba dang / lag gis pad skor dang /rkang pas zhabs bro 'khrab nas gsar du sgrig pa'i pho mo gzhon nu gnyis la bkra shis rten 'brel zhu ba'i bod rang gi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig rtsal zhig yin la/de ni bod rigs mi dmangs rnams kyis gzigs 'dod dang gsan 'dod shin tu che ba'i rig gnas rgyu rtsal zhig yin/yang/ shags gtam gleng res byed pa ni bzhugs gral gyi tshogs phyogs gnyis su gyes nas/ phyogs gcig gis dri ba dris pa dang gzhan pa des lan 'debs par byed pa'i rig pa 'gran tshul zhig yin pas nang don ni lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul dang / chos kyi shes bya/ rig gnas kyi skor dang / rgyun gtan 'tsho ba'i shes bya phun sum tshogs par mchis so/ / 189

dga' ston 'di'i nang dbyangs su gyer ba'i glu gzhas gtso bo ni chang gzhas (zhib phra'i 'gro stangs kho bos rtsom 'bri byas pa'i 〈bod kyi sa ma 'brog khul gyi lus rtsal dang rig rtsed sminang gsal )yin pas mi re re'i go gnas dang na tshod/ skyes 'bras byad bzhin/ gshis rgyud bzang min sogs la bstun nas glu len par byed kyi yod/ lhag par du sems pa dkar la blo rig bkra ba'i bod rigs bu mo rnams ni glu gzhas la shin tu mkhas la ngag ha cang snyan pas glu dbyangs blangs na dpyid kyi pho nya la'ang skyengs pa ster ba zhig yod pa ma zad/ bu mos gzhas mi shes na bzhugs bral du ha cang nyams dma' zhing ngo gnong pa'i yul la brtse yi yod pas bod rigs bu mo rnams gzhas btang rgyur ha cang dga' po yod / de rnams tshang ma sngar shul rgyun 'dzin gyi rmang gzhi'i thog skabs de rang la babs pa'i gnas tshul la rang gi blo gros kyi rtsal la brten nas gson nyams ldan zhing spro snang dod pa'i gzhas tshig gsar gtod byed kyi yod pa de yang 2 pho re re'i kha nas gtam re btang/ mo re re'i kha nas glu re blangs ’ ༷zhes pa ltar yin pas gcig nas mes po rnams kyi mdzad pa'i rtsom rtsal las rim bzhin snying bcud rnams len pa dang / yang sgos rang nyid kyis de la 'dzin pa'i bsam pa dang gdeng 'jog mtshon pa ma zad rang rang gi blo rtsal rig stobs 'phel ba'i khyad chos bzang po ldan yod/yang zhabs bro'i nang nas/ stag shar gzhon pa rnams kyi zhabs bro ni /pyi)(bya sprel gtamargyud 〉nang gsal/

'khrug cing jig sgra che ba/ pho nyid kyi shed stobs chel brjid tso ldan pa/rtsal dang ldan pa'i lus kyi khyad chos dang dpa' zhing brtulaphod pa/ blang dor la mkhas pa'i blo yi khyad chos mtshon pa/ sman chung bu mo rnams kyi zhabs bro ni 'khrol cha dod la dig sgra chung ba sman bu mo nyid kyi mdzes shing lta na sdug pa/sgeg cing ldem la sked skabs phra ba'i lus kyi khyad chos dang / mdzangs la rig pa bkra ba/ ya rabs gus zhabs ldan pa'i blo yi khyad chos ldan yod/dmangs khrod 'bras tshis nang 6 stag shar gzhon pa'i zhabs bro/ zhabs bro thug sgra rdig sgra/ a ne btsun ma'i zhabs bro/ zhabs bro mgo ril pad togasman chung bu mo'i zhabs bro/ zhabs bro ldam me ldem me/ mizhes pa las bod kyi zhabs bro'i nyams 'gyur mngon par shes thub pa ma zad bag ston mdzad sgo 'di nas bod ljongs ni glu gar gyi rgya mtsho yin zhes brjod par bcos ma'i dri mas ma sbag pa ra sprod gsal po thub bo/ gzhan yang da dung sho rtsed dang khrung bkag rig rtsed kyang mdzad sgo 'di'i rig rtsed gtso bo yin rung 〈bod kyi sa ma 'brog khul gyi lus rtsal dang rig rtsed sminang zhib par bshad zin pas 'dir skyar zlos kyi dgos pa ma mchis so/ /mdor na/ dga' ston 'di'i nang rang gi dka' bas bsags pa'i nor rdzas kyi nus pa dang gzugs dbyibs/ kha mdog 'byung khungs sogs dang khyim mi'i yon tan la bstod pa gtong ba dang / phan tshun shags gtam gyi thog nas rig pa 'gran pa/ pi wang/ sgra snyan/ gling bu/ glu gzhas/'bras dkar gyi bshad pa sogs ni rang rang gi blo gros rtsal las byusdu sdu'i

'bras bu brjod tshig snyan la brjod bya'i don dang ldan pa/ sgyu rtsal gyi snying pos phyug pas nyan byed la spro dga'i dpal ster ba dang / rkang pa'i zhabs bro dang lag gi pad skor/ gdong gi 'dzum mdangs sogs lus kyi g.yo ba'i gar stabs kyis dmangs kyi 'dren byed yul du mtshar ba'i snying po sbyin pa sogs khyad 'phags kyi rang bzhin ldan yod/ gnyen sgrig mdzad sgo 'di nas bod mi dmangs kyi blo gros dang / bsam pa'i 'du shes gsal por mtshon la bod kyi dmangs khrod rig gnas kyi dmigs bsal khyad chos 'od stong 'phro ba de'ang mtshon gyi yod/ der brten bod kyi gnyen sgrig ston mo ni rig rtsed kyi byed sgo ches mchog tu gyur pa zhig yin/ des mang tshogs kyi bsam blo'i ngal ba sel ba dang / dmangs kyi shes rgya che ru gtong ba'i nus pa bzang po zhig thon gyi yod la/ khyad par gnyen ston gyi byed sgo brgyud pha mes kyis 'jog gnang ba'i ngag las ngag brgyud du byung ba'i dmangs khrod sgyu rtsal mang po zhig rgyun 'dzin dang / dar spel yong rgyur 'khor yug yag po zhig bskrun gyi yod/ de lags kyang / spyi tshogs bya 'phur ba ltar gong 'phel 'gro mgyogs pa'i da lta'i dus skabs su/ phun sum tshogs la thun mong min pa'i bod kyi dmangs khrod sgyu rtsal dar yul gyi bod mi'i dngos po'i 'tsho ba 'phel rgyas 'gro ba dang dus mtshungs bsam pa'i rig gnas 'tsho ba'ang phun sum je tshogs su phyin nas deng rabs kyi sgra phab 'khor lo dang / rlung 'phrin/ brnyan 'phrin sogs mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i nang rgyun spyod yo byad du gyur dang 'gyur mus yin la/ des lo ngo stong1 ༵༵ mang po'i nang pha tsha bu brgyud kyis rgyun 'dzin byas pa'i gzhas dang /

zhabs bro/ gtam dpe/ sgrung / shags gtam/ bshad pa sogs 'chad nyan byed pa'i dar srol je zhan du gyur ba dang / dmangs khrod kyi sgrung pa dang /gzhas pa gzhas ma/ gtam dpe mkhas can/ bshad par byang chub pa sogs sgyu rtsal pa je nyung du 'gro ba ma zad/ de tsho'i shul 'dzin pa 'tshar longs yong ba'i 'khor lug la'ang phog thug thebs nas dmangs khrod sgyu rtsal dag ngag nas ngag brgyud kyis rgyun 'dzin byed rgyur 'gog rkyen chen po bzos yod/gzhi rkang deng rabs can myur bgrod byed pa'i dus 'dir dmangs khrod sgyu rtsal pa'i dran shes la brten nas nyar tshags byed pa dang / ngag thog nas khyab spel byed pa'i srol rgyun dmangs khrod rig rtsal gyi khyab spel 'gro lugs de lta bu ngam shugs rim rgud kyi tshul du 'gro bzhin yod pa ni spyi tshogs spyi'i 'phelaphyogs yin na/ bod kyi srol rgyun dmangs khrod sgyu rtsal rnams kyang lo rgyus kyi las dbang de las thar thabs med/ da lta nga tsho'i mig mdun du'ang sna sun mi nyung ba zhig phog myong ba ni/ dmangs sgrung dang / dmangs gzhas/bshad pa mang po zhig ni dmangs khrod sgyu rtsal pa tshe las 'das pa dang mnyam du ming gi lhag mar gyur dang 'gyur mus yin/ srol rgyun gnyen ston ni gong gsal ltar dmangs khrod kyi sgyu rtsal du ma skyes 'tshar dang gtan gnas yong ba'i skye khams mchog tu gyur ba zhig yin pas srol rgyun de rgyun 'dzin thub na bod kyi dmangs khrod sgyu rtsal rnam grangs mang po'i skye khams la srung skyob thub nges lags pas rang re tshang mas phyar ba gru 'degs kyis shugs snon rgyag rgyu gal 'gangs che bar mthong ngo /193

mjug byang /〈bod kyi gnyen srol rags gleng 〉'di smyug 'dzin pas yun ring dpyad gzhi'i yig cha 'tshol bsdu dang / lhag don dmangs khrod du brtag dpyad zhib tshags byas pa'i rjes/ dmangs srol rig pa'i gzhung lugs gzhir brten nas bod kyi gnyen srol gyi gnad don khag la dpyad pa lam tsam byas yod/'dir mjug bsdu ba'i go skabs dang bstun nas deb chung 'di'i skor la da dung dgos nges kyi gsal bshad 'ga' byed rgyu la/ deb chung 'di'i nang bkod pa'i dpe mtshon mang po zhig ni nye lam rang nyid kyi spyi tshogs brtag zhib kyiganas gzhi gtso bo gnyis yod pa ste/ lha sa grong khyer mal gro gong dkar rdzong rgya ma shang dang gzhis rtse sa gnas pa snam rdzong bkra shar shang dge 'khor khul gyi gnas tshul yin gshes/ dbus dang gtsang gi sa khul de gnyis su spyi tshogs brtag zhib byed ring rgya ma khul gyi gnam gang lags dang / bgres song rta mgrin lags/ dge 'khor khul gyi pha shar pha khu spen dgos lags dang mig tshe lags bcas kyis gtsos pa'i khul gnyis kyi rgya che'i ngal rtsol mang tshogs kyis rgyab 'uskyor rogs ram gang legs gnang byung la/ deb chung 'di'i nang 'dikā ༵'i gnyen bshad mang che ba ni dge 'khor pha shar pa rdor lags kyis

gsungs pa bzhin yi ger bkod pa dang / bshad pa 'ga' shas shig ni sku zhabs bsod rnams chos dar lags kyis bcoms bsdu gnang ba'i (lha sa khul gyi gnyen sgrig lam srol nyidang / de min (bod kyi gna' rabs kyi chang sa'i lugs srol 〉zhes pa/ 〈spang rgyan me tog〉dus deb bcas las kha gsab byas pa yin pas/ 'dir gong gsal gyi bgres song rnams dang deb kyi rtsom pa po rnams la snying dbus nas bka' drin che zhu rgyu yin/ gzhan yang nga tshos zhib phra'i dpe mtshon mang po zhig gi khyim tshang dang mi sger gyi ming ngo ma dngos su ma bkod par khul der spyi tshogs brtag zhib byed skabs kyi dud tshang gi ang rim bzhin bkod pa 'di'ang do bdag gi gsang ba sbas khul lags pas klog pa por dgongs 'gal med pa zhu rgyu dang / de bzhin lo gnyis kyi sngon du phran nas brtsams pa'i 〈bod kyi dmangs srol gyi blang dor gsal ba'i sgron me 〉zhes pa'i deb de'i nang bkod zin pa'i gnyen sgrig gi 'dzem bya dang phu nu'i mna' ma mnyam bsu'i skor gyi nang don nyung shas kyang deb chung 'di'i nang bod kyi gnyenasrol gyi nang don cung cha lag tshang ba zhig yong slad skyar zlos su bkod yod pa 'dir dmigs su gsal bshad zhu rgyu yin/ bod dbus gtsang gi lugasasrol gtso bor byas pa'i 〈bod kyi gnyen srol rags gleng 〉'di mdor bsdus pos rtsom 'bri byas zin rung / rang nyid ni skyes stobs kyi sdong rtsa phra la sbyangs stobs kyi yal 'dab dben pa/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gyi 'bras bu smin med pa'i shes byas dbul ba'i mu to ba zhig yin pas deb chung 'di'i nang nor 'khrul gyi cha dang / zhan cha mang du mchis nges pas mkhyen ldan smyug 1rnyi/na

mkhan pos thugs kyi kun gsal nas phyag sor gyi lus phra g.yos te skyon brjod kyi gnam lcags dkar 'jam shog bu'i 'dzin mar stsol la/ dus kun du gna' bzang deng spyod dang / snyig dor bcud len ji ltar bya dgos pa'i thad dge ba'i phyag rtsom gang ga'i rgyun ltar yod pa zhu'o/ /

sbyom /spya 'gan chikhur pa/ sbyolaṣṭha zlo chosatha mtsho/gardom/pa//dkyiganyesduXnasdu//gleng /sbye/khro ༷ ༷༷/kā/ sdiX snye bye/ tram̐ lha /bye ṭī/ /spya swākā rdoswā sgri/ kyang //bye bye rgyeX/sna/// byebye yo khye st+ri ༷nā zloX trī ldarnyi shāspya shātā kung si/byebye ༷༷ 7 thengs/༷sdi/ stu pa/ byi( tāswā shārdo tram̐ shā sbyo/pa/rinagong 58sa97//1—mi/5—09895—875588bod 50)

ཿdzāḥtā shām ཿ sgyu cho ༷༷ ru ci rā sdu ga du tshoḥ — /rā/ji ༷ ༷waX shā sgyu ༷ ༷ 3 — sku chozlo/rītsarurnyes 42 zhurdorsha/ma'i43 snyemariri 〉snye rmechi jistarashā'idu sgore dī zhi ca tre //shā /tsa lha rgya pa /ci mi / cho rdo 4 tsho rtse li tshoX (tsho ji ga tsho ri ༷ la/ rilha mi sna snrori ༵༷༷ ci ci'irdzo —74tshangacho 76cho 75344 pa // ci ri ci 18 7 —7 03—09 95 mi sdu/ 0rdo19//〉 〉
